note: Shared glossary for all Cantar de mio Cid texts. Old Spanish forms are glossed with their dictionary form (or modern Spanish equivalent) and a terse meaning; = introduces the modern Spanish spelling.

glossary.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go') · also de + infinitive after a verb: començar de 'to begin to' (compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'), piénssanse de 'set about' (piénssanse de armar), aver de 'to have to' (lo que ha de far 'what he has to do') · also de — 'within' of a time limit (De aquestos quinze días, most likely 'within these fifteen days'; sense uncertain); de veluntad 'willingly'; de + superlative partitive (de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment') · also de — 'with, from' of the means or source (diziendo de la boca 'saying with his mouth'; de cuer les pesa 'it grieves them from the heart') · also de que 'of whom, of which' (relative after a noun; de moros de que non avien sabor 'of Moors they had no taste for') · de firme 'steadfastly, with a will' (de firme robavan el campo); de + noun of material, 'in' (de plata seys çientos marcos 'six hundred marks in silver'); of possession, 'belonging to' (de vos son 'are yours'); fartos de lidiar 'sated with fighting'; pagado de 'pleased with' · also de — dé, may he give (present subjunctive 3rd sg. of dar, printed without accent; que vos de dent buen galardón 'that he may give you a good reward for it'; = dé) · also tanto … de + adjective, 'so (very)' (tanto son de traspuestas 'so far gone are they')
glossary.los: el — the (masc. pl.); them (object pronoun) · also los que 'those who' (demonstrative use before a relative); los — him, them as object of consejar (commo los consejava 'as he advised them') · also los de 'those of' (con los de Castejón 'with the men of Castejón')
glossary.sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus) · also los sos 'his own men' (possessive with article as noun; en todos los sos 'among all his men')
glossary.fuertemientre: fuertemientre — strongly, hard, mightily (= fuertemente) · also fuertemientre — earnestly, strictly (dixoles fuertemientre 'he charged them strictly', Pidal 'les dijo encarecidamente'; = encarecidamente)
glossary.tornava: tornar — he/she turned (imperfect); tornar = to turn, return
glossary.la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
glossary.cabeça: cabeça — head (= cabeza; ç sounded ts)
glossary.i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
glossary.estávalos: estar + los — he-was + them: 'was … them' (estava + enclitic los)
glossary.catando: catar — looking at, beholding (gerund; archaic for mirar)
glossary.vío: veer — he saw (strong preterite of veer 'to see'; = vio, here two syllables ví-o)
glossary.abiertas: abierto — open (fem. pl.; past part. of abrir)
glossary.e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it') · also e — pleonastic 'and' joining two names of the one person (a Dios e al padre 'to God, the Father'; Pidal 'conjunción e pleonástica', cf. v. 300)
glossary.sin: sin — without · also sin — 'besides, apart from' (sin las peonadas 'besides the foot-soldiers'); sin falla 'without fail'; sin dubda
glossary.alcándaras: alcándara — perch, rack (for clothes or hunting birds; Arabic loan)
glossary.pielles: piel — fur, pelt, fur garment (pl. pielles = pieles)
glossary.mudados: mudado — moulted (of a hawk: having shed feathers in captivity, i.e. trained and valuable)
glossary.mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
glossary.çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
glossary.ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain) · also ca non — 'and not that' (Pidal 'y no que'; cuédanse que es almofalla, ca non vienen con mandado 'they think it is an army, and not that they come with a message')
glossary.mucho: mucho — much, greatly · also mucho — very, intensifying a predicate (mucho es mañana 'it is much too early, too soon') · also mas mucho — 'more' (mucho as a comparative = más: mas mucho fue provechosa 'was more profitable'; Pidal)
glossary.avié: aver — he had (imperfect of aver = haber, here a full verb 'to have, hold') · also impersonal 'there was' (mucho avié grant plaça 'there was a very great space'; = había) · also avié — auxiliary 'had' + participle, pluperfect (avié dado 'he had given'; = había dado) · also poco avié que — 'a short time before' (impersonal, of time; poco avié quel ganara 'it was little time since he had won him'; = hacía poco)
glossary.fabló: fablar — he spoke (preterite; = habló, note f-)
glossary.bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water') · also bien — 'right, all the way' before a preposition of place (de las Asturias bien a San Çalvador 'as far as San Salvador')
glossary.mesurado: mesurado — measured, restrained, with mesura (courtly self-command)
glossary.grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had') · en grado tener 'to be thankful for' (en grado vos lo tengo 'I thank you for it')
glossary.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'with' of instrument (a dientes las tomó 'with his teeth he took them'; = con) · also prender a espolonada — 'to begin the attack, charge' (priso a espolonada, Pidal 'comenzó el ataque'); pendón a corças 'a banner with (a device of) roe-does' (a = 'with', likely)
glossary.tí: tú — thee (stressed object pronoun; = ti, old accentuation)
glossary.padre: padre — father · el Padre santo, God the Father
glossary.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more') · also que — 'so that, lest' introducing purpose/result (que por miedo non dexen nada; por tal lo faze … que no lo ventasse nadi); after después/mientra 'after, while' (después que, mientra que) · also que — than, after a comparative (mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him') · also que — what (indirect interrogative; dezir vos he que faze 'I shall tell you what he does'; = qué) · also que — how, exclamative before an adverb (Dios, que bien los sirvió! 'God, how well he served them!'; = qué)
glossary.en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment' · also en — 'among' (en todos los sos 'among all his men') · also en + infinitive 'in (doing)' (en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward'); en çinco días 'in five days'
glossary.me: me — me, to me · also reflexive 'myself' (fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied')
glossary.an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do' · also future auxiliary after an infinitive, the split future (ve[e]rme an 'they will see me'; = me verán)
glossary.buolto: bolver — stirred up, brewed, plotted (past part. of bolver = volver; bolver traición 'to weave treachery')
glossary.pienssan: pensar — they think; pensar de + inf. 'to set about (doing)' (epic formula)
glossary.aguijar: aguijar — to spur (one's horse), ride hard
glossary.las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
glossary.exida: exida — going out, departure (= salida; Latin exire)
glossary.bivar: Bivar — Vivar, the Cid's home village just north of Burgos
glossary.ovieron: aver — they had, they got (strong preterite of aver; = hubieron) · also ovieron a + inf. — 'they had to, were obliged to' (ovieron a enbiar 'they had to send'; = tuvieron que enviar) · also ovieron de + inf. — 'they came to, they did' (ovieron de arrancarlos 'they routed them'; aver de + infinitive)
glossary.diestra: diestro — right, on the right side (fem.)
glossary.burgos: Burgos — Burgos, chief city of Old Castile
glossary.siniestra: siniestro — left, on the left side (fem.; ill-omened)
glossary.meçió: meçer — he shook (preterite of meçer 'to shake'; = meció)
glossary.y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
glossary.engrameó: engramear — he tossed, shook (the head) — rare epic verb
glossary.tiesta: tiesta — head (cf. French tête; Latin testa)
glossary.albricia: albricia — good tidings! reward-for-good-news (Arabic al-bishāra); here a defiant cry
glossary.alvar: Alvar — Álvar (Fáñez), the Cid's kinsman and lieutenant ('Minaya')
glossary.echados: echar — cast out, thrown (past part. pl.); echados somos 'we are banished'
glossary.somos: seer — we are (1st pl. of seer = ser)
glossary.tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth')
glossary.mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part') · also mas — 'more' comparative (que es mas ondrada 'which is more honored'; = más)
glossary.roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
glossary.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings') · also por — 'in requital for, to avenge' (nos vengaremos aquesta por la del león 'we shall avenge this one for the lion affair'); por muertas 'for dead, as dead'; por lo que 'for what, on account of what'
glossary.entróve: entrar — he entered (entró + archaic paragogic -e restored for the assonance)
glossary.pendones: pendón — pennon, lance-banner (men are counted by lances)
glossary.exien: exir — they went out (imperfect of exir 'to go out'; = salían)
glossary.lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative) · also lo — neuter article 'what is' (lo to 'what is yours'); pleonastic 'it' (lo an, lo han a far; por tal lo faze 'for that reason he does it')
glossary.veer: veer — to see (= ver; two syllables) · also to review, inspect (troops) (mandó ve[e]r sus yentes 'had his men mustered'; Pidal: 'revistar') · also ir veer 'to go and attack' (iremos ve[e]r aquella su almofalla; Pidal 'atacaremos aquel su ejército')
glossary.plorando: plorar — weeping (gerund; older pl- form of llorar — the poem uses both)
glossary.tanto: tanto — so much, so great · tanto quanto + subjunctive 'as long as' (tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live') · also tanto — 'so many' before a masc. sg. noun used collectively (tanto palafré, tanto buen pendón 'so many a palfrey, so many a good banner'; = tantos) · also dos tanto — 'twice as much' (que vos meresca dos tanto 'that I may deserve it of you twice over'; = el doble)
glossary.avien: aver — they had (imperfect 3rd pl.; = avían/habían) · also aver — they had (auxiliary of the pluperfect before the participle; non gelo avien logrado 'they had not achieved it'; = habían)
glossary.el: el — the (masc.) · also el — 'he who' before a relative (el qui quisiere, el que es sobre Fenares); el before a fem. noun beginning with a vowel (el espada = la espada; el algara = la algara) · also el de + place name 'he of, the one from' (mio Çid el de Bivar)
glossary.dizían: dezir — they were saying (imperfect of dezir = decir)
glossary.una: uno/una — one, a (fem.) · also a una — together, as one (adverbial; hivan a una compaña 'they went together'; a una grant ondrança 'together with great honor'; = juntos) · also en una conpaña — 'together, in company' (en una conpaña tornados son amos 'both have come back together'; cf. a una)
glossary.dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
glossary.qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also qué — how (exclamative before an adverb: qué bien pago 'how well he paid')
glossary.si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda) · also si non — 'except, but for' (si non a estos cavalleros 'except these knights'; = salvo) · also si — 'so', optative, = sí, with the present subjunctive in an adjuration (si vos vala el Criador 'so may the Creator help you')
glossary.oviesse: aver — he had, he might have (imperfect subjunctive of aver; = hubiese)
glossary.conbidar: conbidar — to invite, take in as guest (= convidar)
glossary.le: le — to him, him (dative pronoun) · also le — him, as direct object (leísmo; si ellos le prenden 'if they take him'); dative (non se le dava 'did not surrender to him') · also le — dative of separation, 'from him' (que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'); dative 'for him' (ques le non spidiés 'who does not take leave of him')
glossary.ien: ien — they would (auxiliary of the split conditional: conbidar le ien = le convidarían; from avién)
glossary.don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection') · 'whereof, with which' (Pidal 'de lo cual'; don yo sea pagado 'whereof I may be satisfied') · also don — when, where (= donde, of time; Don llegan los otros 'when the others come up')
glossary.alfonsso: Alfonsso — Alfonso (VI, king of León and Castile)
glossary.avie: aver — he had (imperfect; unaccented spelling beside avié) · also aver — impersonal temporal 'it had been' (passado avie tres años 'three years had passed'; = hacía/habían pasado) · also avie — impersonal 'there was' (non avie recabdo 'there was no reckoning'; = había)
glossary.antes: antes — before; antes de 'before' · also antes que — 'before' (conjunction; antes quel prendan 'before they take him') · also antes — 'rather' (antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body')
glossary.dél: de + él — from him, of him (contraction)
glossary.su: su — his, her, its · also su — their (aquella su almofalla 'that host of theirs')
glossary.carta: carta — letter, written decree · also 'written deed, charter' (escripta es la carta 'the charter (of peace) is written'; por carta 'in writing')
glossary.con: con — with · also con — 'with the help of' (con Dios 'with God's help'; verlo hemos con Dios 'we shall see it with God's help') · also con — 'up to, as high as' (las ramas pujan con las nuoves 'the branches climb up to the clouds', Pidal 'suben hasta las nubes')
glossary.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo está 'every precaution is taken' (Pidal: 'hay toda clase de precauciones'; en Medina todo el recabdo está) · also non avie recabdo — there was no counting or reckoning (de los colpes de las lanças non avie recabdo 'the lance blows could not be reckoned'; sense uncertain, from the 'account, reckoning' sense; Pidal gives no note here) · also recabdo — answer, reply, heed (el una al otra nol torna recabdo 'neither gives the other heed or answer'; sense taken from context, Pidal gives no note)
glossary.seellada: seellar — sealed (past part. fem.; seello < Latin sigillum, modern sello)
glossary.diessen: dar — they should give (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = diesen)
glossary.aquel: aquel — that one, whoever · also aquel — that (demonstrative adjective; aquel día de cras 'tomorrow'; aquella mayor az 'that biggest line')
glossary.gela: ge + la — it to-him (ge = old dative 'to him/her', later se: modern se la)
glossary.diesse: dar — he should give (imperfect subjunctive; = diese)
glossary.sopiesse: saber — he should know (imperfect subjunctive of saber; = supiese)
glossary.vera: vero — true (fem.; vera palabra 'true word, sure truth')
glossary.averes: aver — goods, possessions, wealth (aver as noun, pl.)
glossary.más: más — more; e más 'and moreover' · non más 'no more, nothing more'; por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more' · also más por espacio — 'later, at more leisure' (más 'further'; por espacio 'in good time')
glossary.cara: cara — face · also de cara 'face to face, facing the enemy' (lidiando de cara 'fighting face to face')
glossary.aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day') · also 'even though' (= aunque; aun de lo que diessen oviessen grand ganançia, Pidal's reading)
glossary.demás: demás — besides, in addition · also los demás — 'the rest, all the others' (Todos los demás 'all the others'; = los demás)
glossary.cuerpos: cuerpo — body · also en cuerpos — in only the clothing next the body (páranlas en cuerpos, Pidal 'las dejan a cuerpo')
glossary.yentes: yente — people, folk (= gente; y- from Latin g-)
glossary.cristianas: cristiano — Christian (fem. pl.; las yentes cristianas = 'everyone')
glossary.ascóndense: asconder + se — they hide themselves (asconden + enclitic se; = esconderse)
glossary.nada: nada — nothing; por nada 'for anything (in the world)'
glossary.campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
glossary.adeliñó: adeliñar — he made straight for, headed to (preterite)
glossary.así: así — thus, so; así como 'as soon as' · also así commo — as, just as (así commo semeja 'as it seems'; = así como)
glossary.puorta: puorta — door (older uo-diphthong spelling of puerta)
glossary.fallóla: fallar + la — he-found-it (falló + enclitic la; fallar = hallar, note f-)
glossary.del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada) · also del — 'from, for, because of' (cause; del gozo 'from the joy'; del çerviçio 'for the service')
glossary.assí: assí — thus, so (= así) · also assí — so greatly, so much (Pidal 'de tal modo, mucho'; assí envergonçó 'was so abashed') · also assí commo 'as soon as' (Assí commo descavalga 'as soon as he dismounts'; = así como, en cuanto)
glossary.pararan: parar — they had arranged, agreed (pluperfect in -ra; parar 'to arrange, settle')
glossary.quebrantás: quebrantar — he should break (apocopated imperfect subjunctive = quebrantasse)
glossary.abriessen: abrir — they should open (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = abriesen)
glossary.vozes: voz — voice (pl.; a altas vozes 'at the top of their voices')
glossary.les: les — to them · also les — 'from them', dative of removal or injury (les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; viédales exir 'forbids them to go out')
glossary.querién: querer — they wished, would (imperfect 3rd pl.; = querían)
glossary.tornar: tornar — to return; tornar palabra 'to answer a word' · also tornar — 'to give back' (tornar nos la ha doblada 'will give it back to us doubled'; infinitive + enclitic + ha, future); to turn (round), transitive (mandó tornar la seña 'he had the banner turned about')
glossary.aguijó: aguijar — he spurred (preterite) · also aguijar — he spurred on, pressed on (intransitive; aguijó cabadelant 'he spurred ahead'; Aguijó mio Çid 'the Cid pressed on')
glossary.se: se — himself/herself/itself (reflexive pronoun) · also se — passive 'is, are' (cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = se, passive-reflexive) · also se — ethic/intensive dative 'for himself, with his own eyes' (él se lo vío con los ojos 'he saw it himself')
glossary.llegaua: llegar — he drew near (imperfect; copyist's u-for-v spelling of llegava)
glossary.ferídal: ferida + le — a blow to-it (ferida 'blow, stroke', = herida, note f-; + enclitic l(e))
glossary.dava: dar — he gave (imperfect) · also dar se — 'to give itself up, surrender' (Alcoçer non se le dava 'Alcocer did not surrender to him')
glossary.era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser) · era + past part. 'had' (ser as pluperfect auxiliary with intransitives; Minaya assí era llegado 'Minaya had arrived')
glossary.ojo: ojo — eye; a ojo 'in plain sight'
glossary.parava: parar — she placed, stationed (imperfect; se parava 'she stood forth')
glossary.ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already' · also ya — 'would', reduced imperfect of aver as conditional ending, 3rd sg., after infinitive + clitic (pagar se ya 'would be satisfied'; = -ía)
glossary.buena: bueno — good (fem.); en buen(a) '(born/girded) in a good hour' — the poem's honorific formula
glossary.çinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl. of çeñir; Latin cinxistis)
glossary.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de) · also non ha qui + inf. — 'there is no one to' (impersonal ha 'there is'; non ha qui tomallos 'there is no one to take them'; = no hay quien) · also ha — of time elapsed, 'it is, it has been' (Pocos días ha … que 'it is a few days since'; = hace)
glossary.vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you') · also vos — stressed 'you' after a preposition (parto de vos 'I part from you'; abiltaredes a vos 'you will dishonor yourselves')
glossary.osariemos: osar — we would dare (conditional 1st pl.; = osaríamos)
glossary.coger: coger — to take in, shelter (here = acoger) · also coger — to take up, strike (a tent: coger la tienda)
glossary.perderiemos: perder — we would lose (conditional 1st pl.; = perderíamos)
glossary.casa: casa — house; also settlement, town (Burgos la casa 'the town of Burgos') · also casar — he marries (off) (present 3rd sg.; él vos casa 'it is he who marries you off'; = casa)
glossary.mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil') · also mal — adverb 'sorely, ill' (por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart') · also tener a mal — 'to take amiss' (non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it amiss') · also mal — evil, bad (adjective, apocopated malo, before a noun; mal galardón 'an evil reward'; = mal)
glossary.ganades: ganar — you gain (2nd pl. present; = ganáis)
glossary.vala: valer — may he avail, protect (present subjunctive; vos vala 'may he keep you') · also vala — may he help (sí vos vala el Criador 'so may the Creator help you'; = ayude)
glossary.vertudes: vertud — power, virtue (= virtud; sus vertudes santas 'his holy powers')
glossary.dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
glossary.tornós: tornar + se — she turned back (tornó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s) · also tornarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin' (tornós a sonrisar 'he broke into a smile', perhaps 'smiled again'; the Cid the subject) · also he turned (toward) (tornós a essa part 'he turned that way', the Cid the subject) · also tornós — he turned back (the -s from se; Por el rastro tornós Félez Muñoz 'back along the trail Félez Muñoz turned'; masc. subject, not 'she')
glossary.vede: veer — he sees (older present vede, Latin videt; MS reads vee)
glossary.partiós: partir + se — he departed (partió + -s(e); partirse 'to take one's leave')
glossary.dela: de + la — from the (copyist's run-together spelling)
glossary.aguijaua: aguijar — he spurred (imperfect; copyist's u-for-v spelling of aguijava)
glossary.santa: santo — Saint (fem.); Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos · santa — holy (adjective; santa Trinidad 'the Holy Trinity', santa María madre 'holy Mary, (thy) mother', the Virgin) · also Santa María — the church (cathedral) of Valencia, Don Jerome's see, where the drums are to be hung (colgar los han en Santa María madre del Criador)
glossary.maría: María — Mary; Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos · also Santa María — Albarracín (Teruel), held by the Aben Razín (Pidal; por Santa María vos vayades passar) · also Santa María — the church (cathedral) of Valencia, Don Jerome's see (colgar los han en Santa María)
glossary.fincó: fincar — he planted, set firm (preterite; fincar los inojos 'to kneel') · also fincar — he stayed, remained (el Campeador fincó con su mesnada 'the Cid stayed with his troop'; = quedó)
glossary.inojos: inojo — knee (= hinojo; fincar los inojos 'to kneel')
glossary.coraçón: coraçón — heart (= corazón) · also por coraçón 'willingly, heartily, with a will' (lo an por coraçón) · also de coraçón 'heartily, with a will' (adóbanse de coraçón 'they arm with a will')
glossary.rogava: rogar — he prayed (imperfect) · also rogar — he was asking, requesting (lo quel rogava 'what he was asking of him'; = rogaba, pedía)
glossary.fecha: fazer — made, done (past part. fem. of fazer = hacer; = hecha, note f-)
glossary.arlançón: Arlançón — the Arlanzón, the river of Burgos
glossary.cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year') · also de cabo — 'again, anew' (que los cometamos de cabo 'that we attack them again'; = de nuevo) · also a cabo de — at the end of, after (a cabo de tres sedmanas 'after three weeks') · also cabo — side, flank (del otro cabo 'from the other side'); fasta a cabo 'to the end' (de la cabeça fasta a cabo 'from head to tail'); a cabo 'to the end, along' (van a cabo, of men riding with the Cid; the shade is not certain); cabo — head, chief (de las otras es cabo 'it is the chief of the others') · also a cabo de — 'at the edge of, on the outskirts of' (of place: a cabo del albergada 'at the edge of the camp'; = a la orilla de)
glossary.fincava: fincar — he planted, pitched (imperfect) · also 'it remained, stayed' (imperfect 3rd sg.; todo el quinto a mio Çid fincava 'the whole fifth stayed with my Cid'; = quedaba) · also fincar los ojos 'to fix the eyes (on)' (los ojos le fincava 'he kept his eyes fixed on him'; = clavaba los ojos)
glossary.çinxo: çeñir — he girded (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Latin cinxit)
glossary.commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing') · commo que 'as one who' (commo que ira a de rey … es echado 'as one who has the king's anger and is cast out') · also commo — 'as soon as, when' (commo gelo a dicho 'as soon as he told it him'); 'since, as' (commo fío por Dios 'as I trust in God')
glossary.fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form) · also ir — he should go (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., the preterite stem of seer shared with ir; que f[o]sse con Minaya 'that he should go with Minaya'; = fuese) · also seer — I were (imperfect subjunctive 1st sg.; commo si fosse delant 'as if I were present')
glossary.montaña: montaña — wild country, wilderness (not only 'mountain') · also forest, woodland (Pidal: 'bosque, selva'; en medio d'una montaña)
glossary.l: le — to him (elided before vowel: l'an = le han) · also 'l = el, the article cut after a vowel (todo 'l día 'all the day')
glossary.conpra: conpra — buying, purchase (= compra) · also comprar — he/she buys (present 3rd sg.; = compra), as in non lo conpra, 'he does not buy it'
glossary.quantas: quanto — as many as (fem. pl.; = cuantas)
glossary.son: seer — they are (3rd pl.) · also son — perfect auxiliary of intransitives and passive auxiliary (todos son exidos 'have all gone out'; nombrados son; son derramadas 'are scattered')
glossary.osarien: osar — they would dare (conditional 3rd pl.; = osarían)
glossary.al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el) · also a + el before an infinitive 'on, upon' (al exir de Salón 'on leaving the Jalón'; = al salir) · al 'the other thing, the rest' in al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later' · also por al 'otherwise, for any other reason' (non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'); a mí mandedes al 'order me something else', give me another charge (the likelier reading of a terse line)
glossary.menos: menos — least, less · menos fallar — to find missing, to miss (de los sos menos non fallaron 'of their own men they missed no more than fifteen') · also a menos de — 'without, short of' (a menos de batalla non pueden den quitar 'short of a battle they cannot get clear of it')
glossary.dinarada: dinarada — a penny's-worth (what one dinero buys)
glossary.martín: Martín (Antolínez) — a knight of Burgos, companion of the Cid, who provisions him on his exile and negotiates the loan from Raquel and Vidas · also río Martín — the river Martín, in Aragon (el val de río Martín 'the valley of the river Martín'; = río Martín)
glossary.antolínez: Antolínez — surname of Martín Antolínez, the Burgalese knight who aids the Cid
glossary.burgalés: burgalés — a man of Burgos (noun/adj.; el Burgalés, an epithet of Martín Antolínez)
glossary.conplido: conplido — complete, accomplished (past part. used as adj.; = cumplido, a term of praise)
glossary.abástales: abastar + les — he supplies them (abasta, present 3rd sg. of abastar 'to supply, provide', + enclitic les)
glossary.vino: vino — wine (noun); also venir — he came (strong preterite 3rd sg.; por en vino a aquesto, 'that is how he came to this pass')
glossary.él: él — he (stressed subject pronoun) · also él — 'him, it' after a preposition, of a thing (a él vino; en él fincaredes 'in it', i.e. in Castejón) · also él — 'him' after a preposition, of a person (con él dos cavalleros 'with him two knights')
glossary.todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision') · also todo — adverbial 'wholly, all over' before an adjective (todo suzio 'all filthy')
glossary.conducho: conducho — provisions, victuals (Latin conductus; covers everything an army eats)
glossary.ovo: aver — he had (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = hubo; here perfect auxiliary, ovo bastidos = 'he had furnished') · ovo de + inf., little more than a plain past (las manos se ovo de untar 'his hands were smeared'); dont a ojo los ovo 'as soon as he had them in sight' · also aver — he had, possessed, felt (plain verb of possession with a noun object; tanto ovo el pavor 'so great was the fear he had')
glossary.bastidos: bastir — furnished, equipped (past part. masc. pl., still agreeing with its object, los … bastidos)
glossary.pagós: pagar + se — he was pleased, was satisfied (pagó + -s(e): -se shrinks to -s after a stressed vowel; = pagóse)
glossary.van: ir — they go (present 3rd pl.) · also ir + gerund 'keep going' (passando van 'they go on passing') · also ir + infinitive 'go to' (le van çercar 'they go to besiege him'; se van tornar 'they go back')
glossary.so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira') · lo so — 'what is his, his own' (neuter article + possessive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle') · also so — their (so consejo 'their counsel', so vino 'their wine'; = su)
glossary.odredes: oír — you will hear (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = oiréis; the minstrel's aside to his listeners)
glossary.dicho: dezir — said (past part.; a dicho = ha dicho, 'he has said')
glossary.canpeador: Campeador — spelling variant with n for m (copyist's spelling) of Campeador, the Cid's epithet
glossary.ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora) · also una grant ora — a long while (Pidal 'un gran rato'; = un buen rato)
glossary.fostes: seer — you were (archaic 2nd pl. preterite of ser, used respectfully to one person; = fuestes)
glossary.noch: noche — night (apocopated form of noche; cf. anoch)
glossary.yagamos: yazer — let us lie down, let us spend the night (present subjunctive/hortative 1st pl.; Latin iacere)
glossary.vayámosnos: ir + nos — let us go away (hortative vayamos + reflexive enclitic nos, the stem-final -s retained before the pronoun; = vayámonos)
glossary.matino: matino — morning (= la mañana; al matino 'in the morning')
glossary.seré: seer — I shall be (future 1st sg. of ser)
glossary.he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he) · also he — and (a spelling of e; he de fijas de mio Çid 'and of the daughters of my Çid')
glossary.ira: ira — wrath; en ira del rey = to be formally cast into the king's disgrace and exile, a legal idiom, not a mere figure of speech
glossary.alffons: Alfonso — Alfonso VI, king of Castile and León (copyist's shortened spelling, cf. alfons, alfonsso)
glossary.metido: meter — put, cast (past part.; seré metido = 'I shall be put/cast') · also meterse — to have thrust oneself in, entered (en mis heredades … es metido 'has entered my estates', ser as perfect auxiliary)
glossary.vusco: vusco — you (old fused form, con vusco = con vos, 'with you'; cf. convusco)
glossary.o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away')
glossary.çerca: çerca — near; here adverbial, çerca o tarde = 'sooner or later' (= cerca) · also çerca — siege, encirclement (noun; en çerca 'under siege'; = cerco) · also çercar — he besieges (present 3rd sg.; bien la çerca mio Çid 'my Çid besieges it well'; = cerca)
glossary.querer: querer — to want, wish (infinitive; head of the split future querer m'a = me querrá, 'he will want me')
glossary.m: me — me, to me (elided form of me before a vowel, querer m'a = me querrá)
glossary.quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar) · tanto quanto 'as long as'; por quanto … ha 'for all that there is' (por quanto en el mundo ha) · also en quanto — 'as far as, insofar as' (En quanto podemos 'as far as we are able'; = en cuanto)
glossary.no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
glossary.preçio: preçiar — I value, prize (present 1st sg.; = aprecio)
glossary.un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
glossary.figo: figo — fig (= higo); non preçiar un figo, 'not to value at a fig', an idiom of contempt for something worthless
glossary.sodes: seer — you are (2nd pl. present, used respectfully to one person; = sois; old -edes ending, cf. odredes, vedes, catedes)
glossary.lança: lança — lance (= lanza); ardida lança, 'bold lance', stands for the bold man who wields it
glossary.doblar: doblar — to double (infinitive; split future doblar vos he = os doblaré)
glossary.soldada: soldada — wages, pay (of a retained man; from sueldo)
glossary.espeso: espender — spent (past part.; = gastado; Latin expendere)
glossary.veedes: veer — you see (2nd pl. present, old -edes ending; = veis)
glossary.trayo: traer — I carry, bring (present 1st sg.; = traigo)
glossary.huebos: huebos — need (Latin opus); huebos (me) ser/aver = 'to have need (of)'
glossary.serié: seer — it would be (conditional 3rd sg.; = sería)
glossary.mi: mi — my (unstressed possessive) · also mi — me (stressed pronoun after a preposition; por mi 'on my behalf'; = mí)
glossary.compaña: conpaña — company, retinue (= compañía; spelling variant with m of conpaña)
glossary.fer: fazer — to do, make (short infinitive form; = hacer; fer lo he = lo haré, split future)
glossary.avrié: aver — there would be, he/it would have (conditional 3rd sg.; = habría)
glossary.consejo: consejo — counsel, advice · also consejo — help, remedy (si non das consejo 'if you give no help'; Pidal 'si no nos das ayuda')
glossary.bastir: bastir — to build, rig up, equip (the verb for Martín Antolínez's honest provisioning at v. 68, now used of the counterfeit chests)
glossary.dos: dos — two · also do + se, 'when/where … (they)' (Dos fallan con los moros 'when they come upon the Moors', Pidal 'cuando se encuentran'; = cuando se encuentran) · also do + se, 'where … (he might)' with a subjunctive (non vido … dos alçasse 'he saw nowhere he might hide', Pidal 'donde se escondiese')
glossary.inchámoslas: inchir + las — let us fill them (hortative inchamos + enclitic las; inchir = hinchir 'to fill', Latin implere)
glossary.d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another') · also d — 'about, concerning' (D' iffantes de Carrión yo vos quiero contar 'of the Infantes of Carrión I wish to tell you'; = de)
glossary.guadalmeçí: guadalmeçí — tooled, gilded leather of the costliest kind (Arabic loan, from Ghadāmes; cf. guadameçís)
glossary.enclaveadas: enclavear — studded, nailed (past part. fem. pl.; = enclavadas)
glossary.guadameçís: guadalmeçí — gilded leather (spelling variant without l, the same word as guadalmeçí)
glossary.vermejos: vermejo — bright red, crimson (masc. pl.; = bermejo)
glossary.raquel: Raquel — one of the two Jewish moneylenders of Burgos who take the pawned chests
glossary.vidas: Vidas — the other of the two Jewish moneylenders of Burgos, partner of Raquel
glossary.vayádesme: ir + me — go for me (vayades, 2nd pl. imperative/subjunctive of ir, old -ades ending, + enclitic me)
glossary.compra: conpra — buying, purchase (spelling variant with m of conpra)
glossary.ayrado: ayrar — angered, placed in disgrace (past part.; = airado; el rey me a ayrado, 'the king has turned his wrath on me', the legal condition of ira)
glossary.aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have') · also aver — to have (infinitive; aver … de + inf. 'to be bound to', split conditional aver vos lo iedes de far 'you would be bound to do it') · also aver as the first half of a split conditional (aver la yemos 'we would have it'; = la habríamos)
glossary.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida) · also es — that (apocopated esse = ese, demonstrative; en es alcaz 'in that pursuit', por es logar 'through that place')
glossary.enpeñar: enpeñar — to pledge, pawn (infinitive; = empeñar; split future enpeñar gelo he = se lo empeñaré)
glossary.gelo: ge + lo — it to him/them (ge, ancestor of modern se, + lo; = se lo)
glossary.fore: seer — it may be (future subjunctive 3rd sg. of ser; = fuere)
glossary.guisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable, right (past part. used as adj.)
glossary.lieven: llevar — let them carry (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = lleven)
glossary.cristianos: cristiano — Christian(s) (masc. pl.); moros nin cristianos / cristianos alone idiomatically = 'anyone at all'
glossary.véalo: veer + lo — may he (the Creator) see it (present subjunctive vea + enclitic lo)
glossary.santos: santo — saint (masc. pl.); los sos santos 'his saints' · also adjective, holy (los santos padres 'the holy fathers')
glossary.fago: fazer — I do, make (present 1st sg.; = hago)
glossary.detardava: detardar — was delaying (imperfect 3rd sg.; = tardaba, se retrasaba)
glossary.passó: passar — he passed, crossed (preterite 3rd sg.; = pasó)
glossary.castiello: castiello — castle (= castillo; here the castle quarter of Burgos) · also the castle of Castejón (el castiello dexó en so poder)
glossary.entrava: entrar — he was entering (imperfect 3rd sg.) · also entrava — 'he entered', narrative imperfect (En las azes primeras … entrava 'into the foremost ranks he rode')
glossary.demandava: demandar — he was asking after, inquiring for (imperfect 3rd sg.)
glossary.uno: uno — one; en uno = 'together, as one' · el uno ... el otro 'the one ... the other' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró) · also lo uno … lo otro 'one part … the other part' (neuter; lo uno adebdan e lo otro pagavan 'part they owe and part they paid')
glossary.cuenta: cuenta — count, reckoning, account · also non son en cuenta 'they are not in the count': past counting, or not reckoned in (= no se cuentan)
glossary.ganados: ganar — gained, earned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with its object, as with ovo bastidos; avien ganados = habían ganado) · also ganados — gains, spoils (noun, masc. pl.; Pidal 'ganancias': los ganados que fizo 'the gains he made'; = ganancias) · also ganados — as a noun, winnings, spoils (todos los ganados 'all the booty'; Pidal's note: 'ganancias', v. 481) · also ganado — cattle, beasts (masc. noun, pl.; los ganados fieros 'the wild beasts'; noun, not the past participle; = ganados)
glossary.guisa: guisa — manner, fashion; a guisa de 'in the fashion of' · a vuestra guisa 'as you see fit, in your own way' (prended a vuestra guisa 'take as you please') · also de guisa que 'in such a way that' (de guisa irán por ellas que … 'in such a manner will they go for them that …'; = de modo que) · also a fea guisa 'in a shameful fashion' (sácanlos de las huertas mucho a fea guisa 'they drive them out most shamefully')
glossary.menbrado: menbrado — prudent, shrewd (lit. 'mindful', from membrar 'to bear in mind')
glossary.caros: caro — dear, beloved (masc. pl.; not 'expensive' here)
glossary.poridad: poridad — secrecy, privacy, confidence (= puridad); en poridad 'in confidence' · also poridad — secret council, secret plan (aviendo su poridad 'holding their secret talk'; con esta poridad 'with this secret plan')
glossary.fablar: fablar — to speak (infinitive; = hablar, note f-)
glossary.querría: querer — I would like, would want (conditional 1st sg.)
glossary.detardan: detardar — they delay (present 3rd pl.; cf. detardava)
glossary.apartaron: apartar — they drew aside, withdrew (preterite 3rd pl., reflexive se apartaron)
glossary.manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding · a las manos 'for the hands' (pidió agua a las manos 'asked for water to wash his hands'); bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', busy eating · also a las manos tomar 'to take by the hand' (a las manos les tomó, Pidal 'los tomó de la mano')
glossary.descubrades: descubrir — you (may) reveal, betray (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = descubráis)
glossary.moros: moro — Moor (masc. pl.); a moros nin a cristianos, 'to any living soul' (merism)
glossary.siempre: siempre — always, forever; por siempre 'for ever'
glossary.faré: fazer — I shall make (future 1st sg.; = haré)
glossary.seades: seer — you may be (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = seáis)
glossary.menguados: menguado — diminished, in want, needy (past part./adj. pl.)
glossary.parias: paria — tribute paid by the Muslim taifa kingdoms to Castile (pl.)
glossary.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also se fo acomendar 'went to commend himself' (ir); fo de noch 'it was night' (ser de + noun, 'night had come'); fo desenparada (passive, 'was abandoned') · also fo — went (ir; mañanas fo Minaya 'in the morning Minaya went'); fo de moros 'it came from the Moors' (ser de + noun of origin; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — it was, ser + adjective predicate (Buena fo la de Valençia 'good was the (capture) of Valencia'; Pidal restores f[o]) · also fo — was (the man) of, belonged to (ser de of a vassal; el que de Albar Fáñez fo 'he who was Álvar Fáñez's man'; = fue)
glossary.entrado: entrar — entered, gone in (past part.; f[o] entrado = 'had gone in', a ser + participle periphrasis)
glossary.priso: prender — he took (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = prendió, tomó) · also prender a espolonada — 'to begin the attack, charge' (priso a espolonada, Pidal 'comenzó el ataque')
glossary.sobejanos: sobejano — excessive, abundant beyond measure (masc. pl. adj.)
glossary.retovo: retener — he kept back, retained (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = retuvo)
glossary.dellos: de + ellos — of them, from them (contraction)
glossary.algo: algo — something; the poem's discreet word for money, wealth · also algo — somewhat, something (algo vidie 'he saw something', i.e. something of what pleased him); que él preçiava algo, 'which he prized not a little' (sense uncertain)
glossary.tiene: tener — he has (present 3rd sg.) · also tener en cuenta — 'he takes account of, counts' (non tiene en cuenta 'he does not keep count'; = tiene en cuenta)
glossary.esmerado: esmerar — refined, assayed, purified (past part.; of gold, the costliest kind)
glossary.dexado: dexar — left, left behind (past part.; = dejado)
glossary.palaçios: palaçio — great hall, manor-house (pl.; = palacio, here not 'royal palace')
glossary.aquellas: aquel — those (fem. pl.; here referring back to the chests) · also aquellas que 'those which, those who' (de sus compañas, aquellas que avien dexado 'those they had left behind')
glossary.levar: levar — to carry, carry off (= llevar)
glossary.sinon: sinon — if not, otherwise, but rather (= sino, si no)
glossary.ventado: ventar — scented out, got wind of (past part.; a hunting word, 'nosed out')
glossary.dexar: dexar — to leave (infinitive; = dejar; split future dexar las ha = las dejará)
glossary.mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping' · a mano 'by hand, hand-picked' (escollechos a mano 'chosen by hand') · dar de mano 'to let go, release' (Pidal 'soltar'; darvos e de mano 'I will let you go')
glossary.prestalde: prestar + le — lend to him! (imperative prestad + enclitic le, with Old Spanish metathesis -dl- > -ld-; = prestadle)
glossary.sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.) · also 'let it be' as a hortatory subjunctive (aquí sea la batalla 'let the battle be here')
glossary.metedlas: meter + las — put them! (imperative meted + enclitic las)
glossary.salvo: salvo — safety, safe-keeping (noun; en vuestro salvo 'in your safe keeping') · also adjective, safe, saved (por end es salvo de mal 'for that reason he is saved from evil') · en so salvo — in his own hands, in safekeeping (Pidal's note on lo tenien en so salvo: 'en su poder', 'en seguridad'; = en su poder)
glossary.fedes: fe — pledged faiths (Pidal's restored older plural of fe 'faith, troth'; meted las fedes = 'pledge your faith')
glossary.catedes: catar — you may look into, inspect (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending; catar here = 'to look into, inspect')
glossary.seiense: seer + se — they were sitting (themselves) (seíen + enclitic se, periphrastic with gerund: seiense consejando = 'sat taking counsel')
glossary.nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison) · also nos — stressed 'us' after a preposition (daxadas seredes de nos 'you will be abandoned by us'; sobre nos 'upon us'); stressed repeated subject (mártires seremos nos 'we shall be martyrs')
glossary.avemos: aver — we have (present 1st pl.; = hemos) · avemos de + inf. 'we must' (mucho avemos de andar 'we have far to go'); avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also perfect auxiliary aver + participle (avemos preso 'we have taken') · also avemos a + inf. 'we are to' (a dexar avemos 'we are to leave')
glossary.ganar: ganar — to gain, earn · also 'to capture, take (a fortress)' (Alcoçer cueda ganar 'he expects to take Alcocer') · also ganar — to till, work the land (Pidal, like Old French gaignier; non se treven ganar 'they dare not work their fields'; = labrar)
glossary.gañado: ganar — gained, earned (past part.; = ganado, here spelled with ñ)
glossary.qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien) · also qui — who? (interrogative; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = quién) · also qui after a negative — 'anyone who, one to' (non ha qui tomallos 'there is nobody to take them'; = quien)
glossary.trae: traer — he carries, brings (present 3rd sg.) · also trae mal — 'treats badly, harries' (el salido de Castiella así los trae tan mal 'the exile from Castile treats them so badly')
glossary.monedado: monedar — coined, minted (past part. used as adj.; aver monedado = 'wealth in coin')
glossary.prendámoslas: prender + las — let us take them (hortative prendamos + enclitic las)
glossary.metamos: meter — let us put (hortative subjunctive 1st pl.)
glossary.dezidnos: dezir + nos — tell us! (imperative dezid + enclitic nos; = decidnos)
glossary.pagado: pagar — satisfied, pleased; also paid (past part.; será pagado = 'he will be content with')
glossary.ganançia: ganançia — gain, profit, interest (= ganancia) · also booty, spoils of war (de ganançia 'as booty'; feremos grand ganançia 'we shall take great spoils')
glossary.respuso: responder — he answered (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = respondió)
glossary.myo: mio — my (unstressed possessive, variant spelling of mio)
glossary.ssea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; spelling variant of sea)
glossary.aguisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable (past part. used as adj.; variant of guisado) · also ready, prepared (ser + part., impersonal: Ya es aguisado 'now all is arranged')
glossary.pedir: pedir — to ask, request (infinitive; split future pedir vos a = os pedirá)
glossary.poco: poco — little · also a poco que — 'shortly after' (a poco que viniestes 'a little after you came')
glossary.acógensele: acoger + se + le — they gather to him, flock to him (acógense + enclitic le, reflexive and dative both glued to the verb)
glossary.partes: parte — part, quarter, direction (pl.); de todas partes 'from every quarter'
glossary.menester: menester — need; a menester = ha menester, 'he has need of'
glossary.marcos: marco — mark (a unit of weight for silver, pl.)
glossary.dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos) · also dar salto 'to make a dash, sally' (salto davan); dar çevada 'to give barley, feed the horses' · also dar — to give way, yield (oviéronse a dar 'they had to give way'; = ceder, rendirse) · also to strike, deal blows (les conpieçan a dar 'they begin to strike them')
glossary.gelos: ge + los — them to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + los; = se los) · also ge = 'to them' (que gelos diessen 'that they should give them to them', the knights) · also ge 'from him', dative of separation (gelos reçibe 'he receives them from him')
glossary.hemos: aver — we will/shall (1st pl. future auxiliary; restored by Pidal in the split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos)
glossary.vedes: veer — you see (2nd pl. present, old -edes ending; = veis)
glossary.entra: entrar — it comes in, enters (present 3rd sg.)
glossary.pressurado: apresurar — hurried, pressed for time (past part.; = apresurado)
glossary.dedes: dar — you may give (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = deis)
glossary.faze: fazer — is done, is made (present 3rd sg.; = hace) · also fazer — he does, makes (active present 3rd sg.; por tal lo faze mio Çid 'for that reason Mio Cid does it'; = hace)
glossary.después: después — afterward, then · also después que — since, seeing that (causal; después que de moros fo 'since it came from Moors')
glossary.desso: desso — of that, with that (= de eso)
glossary.pago: pagar — I am content, satisfied (present 1st sg., reflexive me pago) · also pagar — he paid (preterite 3rd sg., unaccented spelling, = pagó; qué bien pago a sos vassallos 'how well he paid his vassals')
glossary.tred: trer/traer — come! come along! (2nd pl. imperative, old form, intransitive sense of traer; = venid)
glossary.contado: contar — renowned, esteemed (past part. used as a standing epithet of the Campeador) · also of others: un Burgalés contado, 'a renowned man of Burgos' (Martín Antolínez) · also contado — counted, reckoned out (plain past part. of contar; so derecho contado 'his due share, counted out'; = contado)
glossary.meterlas: meter + las — to put them (infinitive meter + enclitic las)
glossary.sepan: saber — may know, should know (present subjunctive 3rd pl.)
glossary.pagamos: pagar — we are content, satisfied (present 1st pl., reflexive nos pagamos)
glossary.archas: arca — chest, coffer (pl.; spelling variant with ch of arcas)
glossary.aduchas: aducir — brought (irregular past part. fem. pl. of aducir)
glossary.prendet: prender — take! (2nd pl. imperative, variant spelling of prended)
glossary.seyesçientos: seysçientos — six hundred (spelling variant of seysçientos/seiscientos)
glossary.caualgó: cavalgar — he rode, mounted (preterite 3rd sg.; copyist's u-for-v spelling of cavalgó; = cabalgó)
glossary.voluntad: voluntad — will, willingness; de voluntad e de grado, a doubled formula, 'willingly and gladly' · God's will (commo fo tu voluntad 'as was your will'); de toda voluntad 'with all one's heart' · also de buena voluntad 'gladly, willingly' (the formula of assent); a toda su voluntad 'wholly to his satisfaction, at his will' · also damor e de voluntad 'with love and good will, gladly' (the formula of assent)
glossary.agua: agua — water · also agua — river (una agua mayor 'a great river'; = río)
glossary.ventassen: ventar — should scent out, get wind of (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; hunting word)
glossary.nado: nacer — born (past part.; = nacido); omne nado, 'man born', an all-inclusive idiom like moros nin cristianos
glossary.afévoslos: afé + vos + los — here/behold them for you (afé, the poem's pointing word, origin disputed, perhaps Arabic hā 'behold', + two enclitic pronouns vos + los)
glossary.besáronle: besar + le — they kissed him (preterite besaron + enclitic le; besar las manos, the formal courtesy owed to a lord)
glossary.sonrrisós: sonrreír + se — he smiled (sonrrisó + -s(e); = sonrrisóse, -se reduced to -s after a stressed vowel)
glossary.avédesme: aver + me — you-have … me (avedes, 2nd pl. present of aver, old -edes ending, + enclitic me; = habéis + me, perfect auxiliary; avédesme olbidado = 'you have forgotten me', a host's mock-reproach)
glossary.exco: exir — I go out, I leave (present 1st sg. of exir; = salgo; cf. exien)
glossary.quem: que + me — that to me (= que me, worn down to a single consonant, cf. nol)
glossary.semeja: semejar — it seems, appears (present 3rd sg.; = parece)
glossary.avredes: aver — you will have (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = habréis)
glossary.mientra: mientra — while, as long as (= mientras)
glossary.vivades: vivir — you may live (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = viváis)
glossary.seredes: seer — you will be (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = seréis)
glossary.pleyto: pleyto — covenant, agreed terms, bargain (Latin placitum; = pleito)
glossary.parado: parar — settled, arranged (past part.; el pleyto a parado = 'has settled the agreement')
glossary.sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route) · also 'before, against (a town to be besieged)' (sobre Alcoçer iva posar 'went to camp before Alcocer') · also sobre — 'besides, in addition to' (Sobre aquesto todo 'on top of all this') · also sobre — around (Pidal 'alrededor de', comp. v. 1053; fincan sobre so señor 'they stand around their lord') · also sobre — 'upon, to' of the target of an act (atan malos enssienplos non fagades sobre nos 'do not set such evil examples upon us')
glossary.gelas: ge + las — them for/to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + las; = se las) · also ge 'to them' (non gelas do yo 'I do not give them to them')
glossary.guardarien: guardar — they would guard (conditional 3rd pl.; = guardarían)
glossary.fasta: fasta — until, as far as (= hasta)
glossary.assil: assí + le — thus to him (assí + enclitic l(e))
glossary.dieran: dar — they had given (pluperfect in -ra; = habían dado) · also non ge los dieran en don 'they had not given them to him as a gift' (= no se los habían dado)
glossary.fed: fe — pledged faith, troth (Pidal's restored older form of fe) · also fer (fazer) — do! (imperative 2nd pl. of the short verb fer; atales cosas fed 'do such things'; = haced)
glossary.auien: aver — they had (imperfect 3rd pl., copyist's u-for-v spelling; = avían/habían)
glossary.catassen: catar — they should look into, inspect (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.)
glossary.fossen: seer — they should be (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. of ser, Pidal's older form; = fuesen; cf. fosse)
glossary.dinero: dinero — penny (a small coin, the unit of smallest denomination)
glossary.malo: malo — bad; un dinero malo, 'one bad penny' — a debased coin, naming the smallest thing worth mentioning
glossary.carguen: cargar — let them load (present subjunctive used as imperative, 3rd pl.)
glossary.levaldas: levar + las — carry them off! (imperative levad + enclitic las, with metathesis -dl- > -ld-; = llevadlas)
glossary.ponedlas: poner + las — put them! (imperative poned + enclitic las)
glossary.convusco: con + vusco — with you (fused form; cf. con vusco, v. 75)
glossary.adugamos: aducir — let us bring, fetch (hortative subjunctive 1st pl.)
glossary.mover: mover — to move, set out (infinitive; a mover [h]a = ha de mover, 'he has to set out', aver a + infinitive for obligation)
glossary.ante: ante — before; ante que 'before (that)' · also ante — because of, at (of the cause, like Latin prae; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of the drums')
glossary.cante: cantar — may crow, may sing (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
glossary.gallo: gallo — cock, rooster; ante que cante el gallo, 'before the cock crows'
glossary.cargar: cargar — to load; al cargar de las arcas, 'at the loading of the chests'
glossary.veriedes: veer — you would have seen (conditional 2nd pl.; = veríais; the minstrel's aside to the audience)
glossary.podien: poder — they could, were able (imperfect 3rd pl.; = podían)
glossary.somo: somo — top, summit; en somo 'on top'
glossary.maguer: maguer — although (a rare word, of Greek origin)
glossary.grádanse: gradar + se — they rejoice, take pleasure (reflexive present 3rd pl.; = se alegran)
glossary.monedados: monedar — coined, minted (past part. pl.; cf. monedado sg.)
glossary.visquiessen: vivir — they might live (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., strong irregular form; = viviesen)
glossary.refechos: refazer — restored, set up again, made rich (past part. pl.)
glossary.manol: mano + le — hand + to him (enclitic le reduced to l)
glossary.besada: besar — kissed (past part. fem., agreeing with mano; ha besada = 'has kissed')
glossary.cinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl., respectful to one person; = ceñisteis)
glossary.ides: ir — you go (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = vais)
glossary.ondrada: ondrar — honored, splendid (past part. fem. used as adj.; = honrada)
glossary.aya: aver — I may have (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = haya) · also aya — he may have (present subjunctive 3rd sg., same form as 1st; de Dios aya su graçia 'may he have God's grace', optative; = haya)
glossary.plazme: plazer + me — it pleases me (plaze + enclitic me; = me place)
glossary.daquí: de + aquí — from here (contraction); daquí = 'from now on'
glossary.mandada: mandar — promised, pledged; ordered (past part. fem.)
glossary.aduxier: aducir — (if) I/he shall bring (future subjunctive 1st/3rd sg., apocopated for aduxiere; = trajere)
glossary.contalda: contar — count it! (imperative contad + la with metathesis of -dl- to -ld-; = contadla)
glossary.ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun) · also ellos = e + los — 'and the', the conjunction run onto the article (ellos co[m]des gallizanos 'and the Galician counts'; ellos 'they', in apposition, also possible; reading uncertain)
glossary.medio: medio — middle; en medio de 'in the middle of' · also medio — 'the half' (noun; el medio echó en campo 'he threw the half onto the field'; = la mitad)
glossary.palaçio: palaçio — hall, palace; the main room of a house (= palacio)
glossary.rançal: rançal — a fine linen cloth (= ranzal)
glossary.tod: todo — all, the whole (apocopated before a vowel)
glossary.primer: primero — first (apocopated masc. before a noun)
glossary.colpe: colpe — blow, stroke, instance (= golpe); a tod el primer colpe 'at the very first go'
glossary.notólos: notar + los — he counted them (notó, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic los)
glossary.martino: Martino — Martín (Antolínez), with the -o form of the name (don Martino)
glossary.peso: peso — weight; sin peso 'without weighing' · also peso — it grieved (preterite 3rd sg. pesó, accent unprinted; de cuer peso esto al buen rey 'this grieved the good king at heart'; = pesó)
glossary.fablava: fablar — he was speaking (imperfect 3rd sg.; = hablaba)
glossary.mereçía: mereçer — I/he deserved (imperfect 1st/3rd sg.; = merecía); also modest 'I would deserve'
glossary.entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together' · also entre — entrar, may it enter (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; ante que entre la noch 'before night comes on'; = entre)
glossary.ixieron: exir — they went out (preterite 3rd pl.; = salieron)
glossary.démosle: dar + le — let us give him (present subjunctive 1st pl. demos + enclitic le)
glossary.buscado: buscar — sought; procured, brought about (past part.)
glossary.mereçedes: mereçer — you deserve (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = merecéis)
glossary.darvos: dar + vos — to give you (infinitive + enclitic vos) · also darvos — dar + vos, first half of a split future 'I shall give you' (darvos he mis fijas 'I shall give you my daughters'; darvos [he] mulas; = os daré)
glossary.queremos: querer — we wish, we want (present 1st pl.)
glossary.dado: dado — gift, present (noun; Latin datum) · also dar — given, dealt (past part.; tres colpes le avié dado 'he had dealt him three blows'; = dado)
glossary.fagades: fazer — you may make (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; = hagáis) · also fazer — after commo 'so that' (commo vós lo fagades 'so that you will do it'; subjunctive, = hagáis)
glossary.dámosvos: dar + vos — we give you (present 1st pl. damos + enclitic vos)
glossary.mereçer: mereçer — to deserve; to earn back, repay (infinitive; first half of a split future in mereçer no' lo hedes)
glossary.hedes: aver — you have (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = habéis); auxiliary of the split future, mereçer no' lo hedes 'you will repay us'
glossary.atorgar: atorgar — to grant, consent to (infinitive; = otorgar; first half of a split future)
glossary.gradeçiólo: gradeçer + lo — he thanked (him/it) (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = agradeció)
glossary.gradó: gradar — he was glad, took pleasure (preterite 3rd sg.; gradó exir 'he was glad to go out')
glossary.exir: exir — to go out, leave (infinitive; = salir)
glossary.espidiós: espedirse — he took leave (espidió + enclitic reflexive se, preterite 3rd sg.; = se despidió)
glossary.exido: exir — gone out (past part.; exido es 'has gone out', ser as perfect auxiliary)
glossary.nasco: nacer — he was born (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
glossary.reçibiólo: reçibir + lo — he received him (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = lo recibió)
glossary.abiertos: abierto — open (masc. pl.; past part. of abrir)
glossary.venides: venir — you come (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = venís)
glossary.vea: veer — may I/he see (present subjunctive 1st/3rd sg.; = vea)
glossary.ayades: aver — you may have (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hayáis)
glossary.vayamos: ir — let us go (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortative; = vayamos)
glossary.san: santo — Saint (apocopated before a name; = san)
glossary.pero: Pero — Peter (San Pero = San Pedro, the saint of the monastery) · also Pero — Pedro, Per Vermudoz (don Pero, the Cid's vassal)
glossary.cardeña: Cardeña — San Pedro de Cardeña, the Benedictine monastery near Burgos where Ximena is lodged
glossary.veremos: veer — we shall see (future 1st pl.; = veremos)
glossary.menbrada: menbrado — prudent, sensible (fem.; lit. 'mindful', from membrar 'to bear in mind')
glossary.dalgo: de + algo — of something; fija dalgo 'daughter of something', well-born (= hidalga)
glossary.mesuraremos: mesurar — we shall measure, keep within measure (future 1st pl.); mesuraremos la posada, probably 'we shall cut our stay short' (sense uncertain)
glossary.quitaremos: quitar — we shall leave, give up (future 1st pl.; quitar el reynado 'leave the kingdom')
glossary.plazdo: plazdo — term, time limit, appointed day (= plazo)
glossary.dichas: dezir — said, spoken (past part. fem. pl.; = dichas)
glossary.cogida: coger — taken up, struck (past part. fem.; la tienda es cogida 'the tent is struck')
glossary.conpañas: conpaña — company, retinue, band of followers (pl.; = compañas)
glossary.cavalgan: cavalgar — they ride, mount (present 3rd pl.; = cabalgan)
glossary.tornó: tornar — he turned (preterite 3rd sg.) · also tornar — he went back, returned (el otro tornó a Albar Fáñez 'the other went back to Minaya')
glossary.santigua: santiguar — he crosses himself, blesses (present 3rd sg.; la cara se santigua 'crosses his face')
glossary.válanme: valer + me — may they help me (present subjunctive 3rd pl. + enclitic me; = válganme)
glossary.tus: tu — your (2nd sg. possessive, pl.) · tus — frankincense (Latin tus; oro e tus e mirra 'gold and incense and myrrh')
glossary.gloriosa: glorioso — glorious (fem.; used as address to the Virgin)
glossary.aquí: aquí — here; d'aquí 'from here' · also 'then, at this point' (aquí dixo el comde 'then the count said')
glossary.quito: quitar — I leave, give up (present 1st sg.) · also quitar — 'I release, pardon, lift the ban on' (a vos quito, Minaya 'I pardon you, Minaya'; = perdono) · also quito — free, quit, cleared (adjective, of a debt or charge; quito se va Minaya 'Minaya goes away free of charge'; Latin quietus; = libre, exento)
glossary.pues: pues — since, then; pues que 'since' · also pues + future subjunctive 'when, once' (pues fueren en vuestro poder 'when they are in your power')
glossary.vertud: vertud — power, might, virtue (= virtud) · vertud fezist muy grant 'you wrought a very great miracle, deed of power'
glossary.ayude: ayudar — may she help (present subjunctive 3rd sg.) · ayudar — may he help (que me ayude a rogar, of St Peter)
glossary.acorra: acorrer — may she succour, come to the aid of (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
glossary.fiziéredes: fazer — (if) you do, should do (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hiciereis)
glossary.complida: complir — fulfilled, accomplished (past part. fem.; = cumplida) · also complido — full, perfect, accomplished (adjective, fem.; = cumplida)
glossary.mando: mandar — I promise, vow; I order (present 1st sg.) · also mandar — he ordered (preterite 3rd sg., unaccented spelling of mandó; el Campeador a los sos lo mando 'the Campeador ordered his men'; = mandó)
glossary.debdo: debdo — debt, obligation (= deuda); aver en debdo 'to be bound by a vow'
glossary.faga: fazer — may I/he make, cause (present subjunctive 1st/3rd sg.; = haga); faga cantar 'have sung'
glossary.cantar: cantar — to sing; cantar missas 'to say masses' (infinitive)
glossary.spidiós: espedirse — he took leave (espidió + enclitic reflexive se, preterite 3rd sg., with e- dropped; = se despidió)
glossary.caboso: caboso — accomplished, excellent (adj., also used alone as a noun, 'the excellent one')
glossary.cuer: cuer — heart (Latin cor; = corazón) · also de cuer — from the heart, deeply (de cuer les pesa 'it weighs on them deeply')
glossary.veré: veer — I shall see (future 1st sg.; = veré) · also veer con — to see to (a matter) with (lo veré con el Çid 'I shall take it up with the Cid')
glossary.castigar: castigar — to instruct, advise (infinitive; castigar los he = 'I shall instruct them', split future) · tornan de castigar 'they go back to giving instruction' (tornar de + inf. 'to do again')
glossary.abrán: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl.; = habrán); abrán a far 'they will have to do' · also abrán de + inf. 'will have to, are bound to' (a bien abrán de venir 'will come to good'; = habrán de)
glossary.far: far — to do (apocopated infinitive of fazer; = hacer)
glossary.quisiere: querer — shall wish (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quisiere)
glossary.tomar: tomar — to take (infinitive) · to seize, catch (en su tierra le pudies tomar 'could seize him in his land') · also tomar — to accept (non gelo quiso tomar 'he would not accept it from them'; = aceptar)
glossary.incal: incaler — it matters (present 3rd sg., impersonal, apocopated; a mi non m'incal 'it does not matter to me', = importa)
glossary.sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of') · also sol — so + l, 'under the' (so 'under', Latin sub, + el before a vowel): del sol espada 'from under the sword' (the likeliest reading; the construction is uncertain) · also Sol — doña Sol, one of the Cid's two daughters (personal name) · also sol — so + el, 'under the' (metiós sol esçaño 'he got under the bench'; here the sense is clear)
glossary.quiera: querer — may (it) wish, be about to (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quiera) · also bien querer 'to wish well, be kindly disposed' (que bien nos quiera 'who wishes us well')
glossary.rayar: rayar — to dawn, to send out rays (infinitive)
glossary.tornavas: tornar + se — he turned back (tornava + enclitic reflexive se, imperfect 3rd sg.; = se tornaba)
glossary.quel: que + le — who ... him (que + enclitic/elided le) · that ... to him (quel creçe conpaña 'that company grows for him')
glossary.sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid') · also por sabor que — 'out of the desire (that)' (por sabor que avía de algún moro matare 'out of the longing I had to kill some Moor') · also aver sabor — to long for, to wish (lo que avía sabor 'what I longed for'; a qui yo ovier sabor 'to whomever I please', Pidal 'quisiere') · also mal sabor — pain, distress (don ellas an mal sabor 'from which they have pain'); sin sabor — 'without pleasure, without mercy' (májanlas tan sin sabor 'they beat them so without mercy'; sense perhaps)
glossary.quieren: querer — they wish, are about to (present 3rd pl.) · also querer — they love, hold dear (que vos quieren sin hart 'who love you without guile')
glossary.crebar: crebar — to break (infinitive; = quebrar); crebar albores 'dawn to break'
glossary.sancho: Sancho — the abbot of San Pedro de Cardeña
glossary.cristiano: cristiano — Christian, devout believer · also cristiano with non — no one (Pidal 'nadie'; non la tolliesse dent cristiano 'that no one should take it from there'; = nadie)
glossary.rezaba: rezar — he was praying, reciting (imperfect 3rd sg.)
glossary.matines: matín — matins, the early-morning office of prayer (pl.; = maitines)
glossary.abuelta: abuelta — together with, at the same time as (a + vuelta; = a vuelta de)
glossary.doña: doña — lady (title; Latin domina, fem. of don)
glossary.pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing' · also pro — profit, advantage, benefit (grant pro les fazié 'he did them great good, was of great profit to them') · also pro — useful, of worth (adjective; en lo al non es tan pro 'in other things he is not so worthy')
glossary.tú: tú — thou, you (2nd sg. subject pronoun; used in prayer to God)
glossary.val: valer — help! (imperative 2nd sg., apocopated for vale; = vale) · val — valley (noun, = valle; el val de río Martín 'the valley of the river Martín') · also valer — he helps, avails (present 3rd sg., apocopated for vale; si no nos val 'if he does not help us'; = vale) · also valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg., apocopated; que mill marcos d'oro val 'which is worth a thousand marks of gold'; = vale)
glossary.llamavan: llamar — they were calling, knocking (imperfect 3rd pl.; = llamaban)
glossary.sopieron: saber — they learned, found out (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = supieron)
glossary.mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word' · also past part. 'granted, assigned' (el quinto que me avedes mandado 'the fifth you have granted me') · also past part. 'ordered, charged' after aver (que a mí lo ovo mandado 'who had charged me with it'); with gelo he mandado 'I have promised it to him' (Pidal 'otorgado, o prometido') under 'granted'
glossary.dieron: dar — they gave (preterite 3rd pl.; dar salto 'to leap')
glossary.salto: salto — leap, jump · also dash, sally (dar salto 'to make a sortie'; non osa ninguno dar salto a la çaga 'none dares to dash at the rearguard') · also salto — assault, sudden attack (de mi salto, Pidal 'que yo les asalte'; = asalto)
glossary.gradéscolo: gradecer + lo — I thank (God) for it (present 1st sg. gradesco + enclitic lo; = lo agradezco) · also gradéscolo a — I thank (someone) for it (Gradéscolo a mio Çid 'I thank my Çid for it')
glossary.adobaré: adobar — I shall prepare, provide (future 1st sg.; = adobaré)
glossary.dovos: dar + vos — I give you (present 1st sg. do + enclitic vos; = os doy)
glossary.algún: alguno — some, any (apocopated before a noun; = algún)
glossary.visquiero: vivir — (if) I live, should live (future subjunctive 1st sg., on the strong stem visqu- of the preterite visque; = viviere)
glossary.seervos: seer + vos — to be … to you (infinitive + enclitic vos, first half of a split future: seervos han = os serán)
