glossary.aquestos: aqueste — these (masc. pl., 'aqueste' = este with prefixed aque-; aquestos dos reyes 'these two kings'; = estos)
glossary.fáriz: Fáriz — a Moorish 'king', commander with Galve of the army sent against the Çid; fictional, says Pidal (the name perhaps Arabic Fāris)
glossary.galve: Galve — a Moorish 'king', commander with Fáriz of the army sent against the Çid; fictional, says Pidal
glossary.çercar: çercar — to besiege, surround (infinitive; le van çercar 'they go to besiege him', ir + infinitive; = cercar)
glossary.fincaron: fincar — they planted, pitched (preterite 3rd pl.; fincaron las tiendas 'they pitched the tents'; = hincaron, plantaron)
glossary.prendend: prender — they take up (present 3rd pl.; prendend las posadas 'they take up quarters'; the final -d is probably an unetymological spelling, = prenden)
glossary.creçen: creçer — they grow, increase (present 3rd pl.; = crecen)
glossary.virtos: virtos — uncertain word, probably 'forces, hosts' (pl.; creçen estos virtos 'these forces grow'; perhaps from Latin virtus; the exact sense is doubtful)
glossary.arrobdas: arrobda — sentry, watch, patrol (pl.; las arrobdas que los moros sacan 'the watches the Moors post'; = rondas, centinelas)
glossary.sacan: sacar — they put out, post (present 3rd pl.; las arrobdas … sacan 'the patrols they send out'; = sacan) · also sacar — to drive out, haul out (de las tiendas los sacan 'they drive them out of their tents'; = los sacan)
glossary.enbueltos: enbuelto — wrapped, clad (past part. masc. pl.; enbueltos en armas 'clad in arms'; = envueltos)
glossary.muchas: mucho — many (fem. pl.; muchas son las arrobdas 'many are the watches'; = muchas)
glossary.almofalla: almofalla — encampment, host, army camp (Arabic al-maḥalla; = hueste, campamento)
glossary.tuellen: toller — they take away, cut off (present 3rd pl.; les tuellen el agua 'they cut off their water'; = quitan)
glossary.batalla: batalla — battle (= batalla; exir a batalla 'to sally out to battle')
glossary.vedava: vedar — he forbade (imperfect 3rd sg.; firme gelo vedava 'he firmly forbade it to them'; = vedaba, prohibía)
glossary.toviérongela: tener + ge + la — they held it in siege on him (tovieron, strong preterite 3rd pl., + ge = le, the Çid, + la, the referent loose — probably the town or the siege; toviérongela en çerca 'they kept him besieged'; = se la tuvieron)
glossary.quarta: quarto — fourth (fem.; la quarta sedmana 'the fourth week'; = cuarta)
glossary.queríe: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe spelling of -ié; la quarta queríe entrar 'the fourth (week) was about to begin'; = quería)
glossary.acordar: acordar — to take counsel, agree (infinitive; tornós a acordar 'he set to take counsel'; = acordar) · 'to bring (him) round, persuade' (nol pueden acordar 'they cannot persuade him')
glossary.queramos: querer — we may wish (present subjunctive 1st pl.; que nos queramos ir 'if we should want to go', que + subjunctive as a condition; = queramos)
glossary.consintrán: consentir — they will allow (future 3rd pl.; no nos lo consintrán 'they will not allow us it'; = consentirán)
glossary.poderes: poder — power, forces, strength (noun, pl.; grandes son los poderes 'great are the forces'; = poderes)
glossary.dezidme: dezir + me — tell me (dezid, imperative 2nd pl., + me; = decidme)
glossary.prestar: prestar — to be worth, avail (infinitive; cavallero de prestar 'a knight of worth'; = valer)
glossary.gentil: gentil — noble, fair, excellent (Castiella la gentil 'noble Castile'; = gentil)
glossary.acá: acá — here, hither (adverb; exidos somos acá 'we have come out to here'; = acá)
glossary.lidiáremos: lidiar — (if) we fight (future subjunctive 1st pl., -re; si con moros non lidiáremos 'if we do not fight the Moors'; = lidiemos, archaic lidiáremos)
glossary.ay: aver — there is, there are (impersonal, present of aver, with y 'there' attached; algunos ay de más 'there are some more besides'; = hay)
glossary.passe: passar — it may pass, may go (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; que non passe por al 'let it not pass by other means, let it be done so'; = pase)
glossary.vayámoslos: ir + los — let us go at them (vayamos, present subjunctive 1st pl. hortative, + enclitic los; = vayámoslos)
glossary.ferir: ferir — to strike, attack (infinitive; vayámoslos ferir 'let us go and strike them'; = herir)
glossary.ondrástesvos: ondrar + vos — you have honoured yourself (ondrastes, preterite 2nd pl., the polite vos to Minaya alone, + reflexive vos; = os honrasteis)
glossary.iedes: aver — you would (conditional ending 2nd pl., -iedes, split from its infinitive aver: aver vos lo iedes de far = os lo habríais de hacer, 'you would be bound to do it'; Pidal: far stands for ondrar, 'for you were sure to honour yourself')
glossary.manda: mandar — he orders (present 3rd sg.; manda echar 'orders (them) put out'; = manda) · also mandar — he rules, governs (of a place; del que Valençia manda 'of him who rules Valencia'; = gobierna)
glossary.echar: echar — to cast out, put out (infinitive; los manda echar 'orders them put out'; = echar) · also echar pregón — to have a proclamation cried (pregón mandó echar) · echar(se) sobre — to throw oneself upon, lay siege to (sobrellas va echar)
glossary.piénssanse: pensar + se — they set about (present 3rd pl. + reflexive; piénssanse de adobar 'they set about getting ready'; = se ponen a)
glossary.adobar: adobar — to equip, make ready (infinitive; = adobar, aderezar)
glossary.querie: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., unaccented spelling of querié; el sol querie apuntar 'the sun was about to rise'; = quería) · also querer — he wanted, loved (imperfect 3rd sg.; cavalleros que querie de coraçón 'knights he loved from the heart'; tántol querie 'he loved him so much'; = quería)
glossary.apuntar: apuntar — to begin to show, to dawn (infinitive; el sol querie apuntar 'the sun was about to rise'; = apuntar, asomar)
glossary.armado: armar — armed (past part.; armado es mio Çid 'my Cid is armed', ser as auxiliary; = armado)
glossary.contar: contar — to tell, recount (infinitive; commo odredes contar 'as you will hear told'; = contar)
glossary.iscamos: exir — let us go out (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; todos iscamos fuera 'let us all go out'; = salgamos)
glossary.raste: rastar — may remain, stay behind (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; que nadi non raste 'that no one stay behind'; probably from Latin restare; = quede)
glossary.pedones: pedón — foot-soldier (pl.; the old form of peón, Latin pedonem; dos pedones solos 'only two foot-soldiers'; = peones)
glossary.solos: solo — alone, only (masc. pl.; dos pedones solos 'only two foot-soldiers'; = solos)
glossary.guardar: guardar — to guard (infinitive; por la puerta guardar 'to guard the gate'; = guardar)
glossary.muriéremos: morir — (if) we die (future subjunctive 1st pl., -re; si nos muriéremos en campo 'if we die in the field'; = muramos, archaic muriéremos)
glossary.entrarán: entrar — they will enter (future 3rd pl.; en castiello nos entrarán 'they will enter the castle for us/against us'; = entrarán)
glossary.vençiéremos: vençer — (if) we win (future subjunctive 1st pl., -re; si vençiéremos la batalla 'if we win the battle'; = venzamos, archaic venciéremos)
glossary.creçremos: creçer — we shall grow (syncopated future 1st pl.; creçremos en rictad 'we shall grow in wealth'; = creceremos)
glossary.rictad: rictad — wealth, riches (Pidal 'riqueza'; creçremos en rictad 'we shall grow in wealth'; = riqueza)
glossary.tomad: tomar — take! (imperative 2nd pl.; la mi seña tomad 'take my banner'; = tomad)
glossary.tener: tener — to hold, keep (infinitive, first element of the split future tener la edes 'you will hold it'; = tener) · also tener las armas — to play at arms, exercise in them and show skill (Pidal: 'jugar las armas')
glossary.edes: aver — you (will) have (2nd pl. of aver, -edes ending; second element of the split future tener la edes 'you will hold it'; = tendréis)
glossary.arth: art — guile, deceit (arth, a spelling of art; Pidal 'mal arte, engaño'; sin art 'loyally, without guile'; = arte, engaño)
glossary.aguijedes: aguijar — you spur, hasten (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -edes; non aguijedes 'do not spur on, do not charge'; = aguijéis)
glossary.mandar: mandar — to command (infinitive); in si yo non vos lo mandar future subjunctive 1st sg. (= mandare, 'unless I order you'; = mande)
glossary.besó: besar — he kissed (preterite 3rd sg.; al Çid besó la mano 'he kissed the Cid's hand'; = besó)
glossary.viéronlo: veer + lo — they saw it (vieron, strong preterite 3rd pl., + enclitic lo; = lo vieron)
glossary.tornáronse: tornar + se — they turned, set (to) (tornaron, preterite 3rd pl., + reflexive se; tornáronse a armar 'they set to arming themselves again'; = se volvieron) · also tornar + se — they went back, returned (tornáronse al palaçio 'they went back to the palace')
glossary.armar: armar — to arm (infinitive; tornáronse a armar 'they set about arming'; = armar)
glossary.roído: roído — noise, din (= ruido; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of drums')
glossary.atamores: atamor — drum (pl.; also atambor, from Arabic, with the article al- assimilated; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of the drums'; = tambores)
glossary.quebrar: quebrar — to break, shatter (infinitive; la tierra querié quebrar 'the ground was about to split'; = quebrar)
glossary.armarse: armar + se — to arm oneself (infinitive + reflexive; veriedes armarse moros 'you would see Moors arming'; = armarse)
glossary.az: az — battle line, rank, battalion (Latin acies; entrar en az 'to fall into line'; = hilera, escuadrón)
glossary.parte: parte — part, side (de parte de los moros 'on the Moors' side'; = parte) · also partir (se) — he parts, leaves (present 3rd sg. of partir, with non se le: que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'; = se aparta) · also partir — it divides, separates (present 3rd sg., transitive; la sierra, que las otras tierras parte 'the sierra that divides the other lands'; = separa) · also parte — share, place, footing (with dar: dovos … parte 'I give you a place', Pidal 'os doy acogida en mi reino'; = parte, acogida)
glossary.cabdales: cabdal — chief, principal (pl.; dos señas cabdales 'two chief banners'; = principales)
glossary.mezclados: mezclar — mixed, jumbled (past part. masc. pl.; los pendones mezclados 'the pennons intermingled'; = mezclados)
glossary.podrié: poder — he could (conditional 3rd sg., -ié ending; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = podría)
glossary.azes: az — battle lines, ranks (pl.; las azes de los moros 'the Moorish battalions'; = hileras, escuadrones)
glossary.yas: ya + se — already … themselves (ya + reflexive se cut to s; yas mueven 'they are already moving'; = ya se)
glossary.mueven: mover — they move, advance (present 3rd pl.; yas mueven adelant 'already they move forward'; = mueven)
glossary.quedas: quedo — quiet, still (adj. fem. pl.; quedas seed 'stay still'; = quedas, quietas)
glossary.derranche: derranchar — may break rank, dash out (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non derranche ninguno 'let no one break out'; probably = rompa filas)
glossary.mande: mandar — I command, I order (present subjunctive 1st sg.; fata que yo lo mande 'until I order it'; = mande) · also mandar — may he grant, ordain (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; el Criador lo mande 'may the Creator so ordain'; = mande)
glossary.endurar: endurar — to endure, bear, hold back (infinitive; non lo pudo endurar 'could not bear it'; = aguantar)
glossary.conpeçó: començar — he began (preterite 3rd sg.; conpeçó de espolonar 'he began to spur'; = comenzó)
glossary.meter: meter — to put, set (infinitive; vo meter la vuestra seña 'I go to put your banner'; = meter)
glossary.aquella: aquel — that (fem. sg.; aquella mayor az 'that largest battle line'; = aquella)
glossary.mayor: mayor — larger, greater (aquella mayor az 'that greatest line'; = mayor) · also Mayor — part of the place name Mont Mayor, Montemayor (the Portuguese town, Pidal) · also la mayor — 'the great', standing epithet of Valencia (Valençia la mayor)
glossary.acorrades: acorrer — you help (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -ades; commo la acorrades 'how you succour it, i.e. the banner'; = acorráis, socorráis)
glossary.caridad: caridad — charity, mercy; por caridad 'for charity's sake, I beg you' (= caridad)
glossary.rastará: rastar — it will remain (future 3rd sg.; non rastará por al 'it shall not be otherwise', Pidal 'no quedará de otro modo'; = quedará)
glossary.espolonó: espolonar — he spurred (preterite 3rd sg.; espolonó el cavallo 'he spurred the horse'; = espoleó)
glossary.metiól: meter + l — he drove, set (him) (metió, preterite 3rd sg., + elided enclitic l(o), probably the horse; metiól en el mayor az 'he drove it into the largest line'; = lo metió)
glossary.danle: dar + le — they give him (dan, present 3rd pl., + enclitic le; danle grandes colpes 'they deal him great blows'; = le dan)
glossary.falssar: falssar — to pierce, break through (armour, shield) (infinitive; nol pueden falssar 'they cannot pierce him'; = falsear, quebrantar)
glossary.valelde: valer + le — help him (valed, imperative 2nd pl., + enclitic le, with d and l transposed; = valedle, ayudadle)
glossary.enbraçan: enbraçar — to take (the shield) on the arm by its straps (present 3rd pl.; enbraçan los escudos 'they take their shields on their arms'; = embrazan) · also enbraçar — to wind (the mantle) round the arm as a shield (enbraçan los mantos 'they wrap their cloaks on their arms')
glossary.coraçones: coraçón — heart (pl.; de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'; = corazones)
glossary.abaxan: abaxar — to lower (present 3rd pl.; abaxan las lanças 'they lower their lances'; = bajan; modern abajar survives only as a rare, dialectal word)
glossary.abueltas: a bueltas de — together with, along with (adverbial phrase, a + bueltas 'turns', from bolver; abueltas de los pendones 'together with the pennons'; the el is Pidal's restoration; = a vueltas de, junto con)
glossary.enclinaron: enclinar — to bend, incline (preterite 3rd pl.; enclinaron las caras 'they bent their faces (down)'; = inclinaron)
glossary.suso: suso — up, above (adverb, Latin sursum; de suso de los arzones 'above the saddle-bows'; no modern equivalent, closest arriba)
glossary.arzones: arzón — saddle-bow, the raised front or back of the saddle (pl.; = arzones)
glossary.ívanlos: ir + los — iban 'they were going' (imperfect 3rd pl.) + los 'them' (object pronoun split out); ir + infinitive, 'were going to, set about' (ívanlos ferir 'they went to strike them'; = los iban a herir)
glossary.llama: llamar — he calls, cries out (present 3rd sg.; A grandes vozes llama 'he calls at the top of his voice'; = llama)
glossary.feridlos: ferir + los — ferid 'strike!' (imperative 2nd pl.) + los 'them' (object pronoun split out); = heridlos
glossary.fieren: ferir — they strike, attack (present 3rd pl.; fieren en el az 'they strike into the line'; = hieren)
glossary.seños: seños — one each (distributive, plural only; Latin singulos; seños moros 'a Moor apiece'; de seños colpes 'with one blow each'; = sendos)
glossary.tornada: tornada — turn, return, wheeling back (noun, from tornar; a la tornada 'on the return (charge)'; = vuelta) · a la tornada 'on (your) return' from a journey (A la tornada, si nos falláredes aquí 'on your return, if you find us here')
glossary.tantos: tanto — so many (masc. pl.; tantos pendones 'so many pennons'; a la tornada … otros tantos 'as many more'; = tantos)
glossary.tantas: tanto — so many (fem. pl.; tantas lanças 'so many lances'; = tantas)
glossary.premer: premer — to press down, lower (infinitive, Latin premere; premer e alçar 'to lower and raise' the lances; no modern simple verb, cf. apremiar, oprimir, closest apretar)
glossary.tanta: tanto — so many, so much (fem. sg. used collectively; tanta adágara 'so many a shield'; = tanta)
glossary.adágara: adágara — small round or heart-shaped shield, buckler (word of Arabic origin, ad-daraqa; = adarga)
glossary.foradar: foradar — to pierce, bore through (infinitive, Latin forare; adágara foradar 'to pierce shields'; = horadar)
glossary.loriga: loriga — coat of mail, hauberk (= loriga, now only a historical term; cota de malla is the usual word)
glossary.desmanchar: desmanchar — to break the mail of (a hauberk) (infinitive; Pidal 'desmallar', to break the links or plates of the hauberk; loriga falssar e desmanchar 'hauberks pierced and their mail broken'; = desmallar)
glossary.blancos: blanco — white (masc. pl.; pendones blancos 'white pennons'; = blancos)
glossary.salir: salir — to come out, emerge (infinitive; salir vermejos en sangre 'to come out red with blood'; = salir)
glossary.mafómat: Mafómat — Muhammad, the Moors' battle-cry (llaman Mafómat 'they call on Muhammad'; = Mahoma)
glossary.santi: santi — saint (old form before a saint's name, from Latin sancti as in Sancti Iacobi, which survives fused in Santiago; santi Yagüe 'Saint James'; = santo, san)
glossary.yagüe: Yagüe — James, Iago (from Latin Iacobus; santi Yagüe = Santiago, Saint James, patron of Spain and the Christians' battle-cry; = Yago, Jacobo, in Santiago)
glossary.cadien: caer (old cader, Latin cadere) — they were falling (imperfect 3rd pl., -ié ending; = caían)
glossary.quál: quál — how, what a (exclamative; ¡quál lidia bien! 'how well he fights!'; = cuál, here cómo)
glossary.lidia: lidiar — he fights (present 3rd sg.; = lidia, closest lucha)
glossary.exorado: exorado — gilded, adorned with gold (adj., Latin exauratus; arzón exorado 'gilded saddle-bow'; probably so; no modern equivalent, closest dorado)
glossary.arzón: arzón — saddle-bow (sg.; sobre exorado arzón 'upon the gilded saddle-bow', i.e. in the saddle; = arzón)
glossary.diaz: Díaz — Díaz (patronymic 'son of Diego'; Ruy Diaz, the Cid's name, = Ruy Díaz; same as díaz, here without accent)
glossary.çorita: Çorita — Zorita, the place held by Minaya (que Çorita mandó 'who held Çorita'); Pidal finds Álvar Fáñez as lord of Zorita in documents of 1097 and 1107 — taken to be Zorita de los Canes on the Tagus (Guadalajara)
glossary.muño: Muño — personal name (Muño Gustioz, a vassal of the Cid; = Munio, an old name; Nuño is probably related)
glossary.gustioz: Gustioz — patronymic 'son of Gustio' (Muño Gustioz, the Cid's retainer, brought up in his household; = Gustioz, no modern form)
glossary.criado: criado — one brought up in a lord's household, foster-son, retainer (past part. of criar used as noun; so criado 'his foster-son, reared in his house'; modern criado = servant)
glossary.martin: Martín — Martín (personal name; Martin Muñoz, governor of Mont Mayor; same as martín, here without accent)
glossary.muñoz: Muñoz — patronymic 'son of Muño' (Martín Muñoz, Félez Muñoz; = Muñoz)
glossary.mont: Mont — mount, hill (Latin montem; = monte); Mont Mayor, the place Martín Muñoz held: Montemayor, a Portuguese town he governed for Alfonso VI, according to Pidal · also Mont Real — Monreal, name of the place above which the Cid's hill stands (Pidal: Monreal del Campo, on the Jiloca); see real · also Mont Alván — Montalbán, town in Teruel (a Mont Alván; = Montalbán) · also mont — wood, wild wooded country (apocopated monte, common noun; en aqueste mont 'in this wood'; = monte)
glossary.albaroz: Albaroz — patronymic 'son of Álvaro/Álbar' (Álbar Albaroz = Álvar Álvarez; = Álvarez)
glossary.aragón: Aragón — Aragon, the kingdom/region east of Castile (el bueno de Aragón 'the good (man) from Aragon'; = Aragón)
glossary.félez: Félez — personal name, Félez Muñoz, nephew of the Cid; the name is probably from Latin Felix (= Félix; Félez is not a modern name)
glossary.sobrino: sobrino — nephew (= sobrino; so sobrino 'his nephew')
glossary.adelante: adelante — onward, further on (adverb; desí adelante 'from there on, further'; = adelante)
glossary.acorren: acorrer — they come to help, rush to aid (present 3rd pl.; acorren la seña 'rally to the banner'; bien lo acorren 'they help him well'; = socorren, acuden a; modern acorrer is archaic)
glossary.matáronle: matar + le — mataron 'they killed' (preterite 3rd pl.) + le dative of possession 'on him' (matáronle el cavallo 'they killed his horse under him'; = le mataron el caballo)
glossary.quebrada: quebrar — broken (past part., fem. sg., agreeing with lança; la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; = quebrada, rota)
glossary.metió: meter — he put (preterite 3rd sg.; metió mano 'laid hand to'; = metió) · also meterse — he went into, hid himself (en un monte espesso … se metió 'he went into a thick wood'); dentro las metió 'he brought them inside'
glossary.víolo: veer + lo — vio 'he saw' (preterite 3rd sg.) + lo 'it, him' (object pronoun split out; = lo vio)
glossary.acostós: acostar + se — acostó 'he approached' (preterite 3rd sg.) + se (reflexive; acostarse a 'to draw up beside'; modern acostarse means 'to lie down', so = se acercó)
glossary.aguazil: aguazil — Moorish officer, vizier or commander (Arabic al-wazīr; here a Moorish chief; = alguacil, modern 'bailiff, constable')
glossary.tenié: tener — he had, was mounted on (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; que tenié buen cavallo 'who had a good horse'; = tenía) · also tener — he held, kept under his power (en su mano tenié a Çelfa 'he held Çelfa in his hand'; = tenía) · also se tenié — he had with him (reflexive; e él se tenié çiento 'and he had a hundred of his own'; = tenía consigo)
glossary.diol: dar + le — dio 'he gave' (preterite 3rd sg.) + l(e) 'to him' (enclitic; diol tal espadada 'gave him such a sword-stroke'; = le dio)
glossary.espadada: espadada — sword-stroke, blow with a sword (noun; = espadazo)
glossary.cortól: cortar + le — cortó 'he cut' (preterite 3rd sg.) + l(e) 'him' (enclitic; = le cortó)
glossary.ival: ir + le — iva 'he was going' (imperfect 3rd sg.) + l(e) 'to him'; ir + infinitive 'was about to' (ival dar el cavallo 'he was going to give him the horse'; = le iba a dar)
glossary.abré: aver — I shall have (future 1st sg., syncopated; de vos abré grand bando 'from you I shall have great support'; = habré)
glossary.bando: bando — party, side, backing (Germanic word; abré grand bando 'I shall have great support'; modern bando = faction, also proclamation)
glossary.cometamos: cometer — let us attack (present subjunctive 1st pl., after a menester que 'it is necessary that'; cometer 'to attack'; modern cometer means 'to commit', so closest acometer, acometamos)
glossary.fuerças: fuerça — force, might; pl. forces, strong troops (por estas fuerças 'through these forces', i.e. among these hosts; = fuerzas)
glossary.alcança: alcançar — he overtakes, catches (present 3rd sg.; a los que alcança 'those whom he overtakes'; = alcanza) · also alcança — pursuit, chase (noun, from alcançar; en alcança 'in pursuit'; cade en alcança 'goes in pursuit'; = alcance, persecución)
glossary.valos: ir + los — va 'he goes' (present 3rd sg.) + los 'them'; ir + gerund 'goes on doing' (valos delibrando 'he goes on dispatching them'; = los va librando, despachando)
glossary.delibrando: delibrar — dispatching, killing (gerund; Pidal 'despachar, matar'; from Latin de + liberare; modern deliberar means 'to deliberate', so closest despachando, matando)
glossary.fallen: fallir — they fail, miss (present 3rd pl. of fallir 'to fail', not hallar 'to find'; los dos le fallen 'two of them miss him'; = fallan)
glossary.únol: uno + le — uno 'one' + l(e) 'him' (el únol ha tomado 'the one has caught him'; = el uno le)
glossary.tomado: tomar — taken, caught, hit (past part.; ha tomado 'has caught (him)'; = tomado)
glossary.bolvió: bolver — he turned (preterite 3rd sg.; bolvió la rienda 'he turned his rein'; = volvió)
glossary.írsele: ir + se + le — ir 'to go' (infinitive) + se (reflexive: irse 'to go away') + le (dative 'from him', 'on him'); por írsele del campo 'so as to slip away from the field'; = para irse
glossary.rancado: rancar — routed, driven off (past part., = arrancado; Old Spanish rancar 'to pull out, uproot', here 'to rout'; rancado es el fonssado 'the host is routed'; modern rancar does not exist in this sense)
glossary.fonssado: fonssado — army, host (Latin fossatum 'ditch, entrenched camp'; in medieval Castile also a military expedition and the service owed for it; rancar el fonssado, Pidal 'vencer al ejército'; = hueste, ejército)
glossary.dio: dar — he gave, struck (preterite 3rd sg.; un colpe dio 'he struck a blow'; = dio) · dar a + inf. 'to give (something) to be …-ed' (Dio a partir estos dineros 'he had this money shared out') · also dar — he dispatched, sent (Pidal: 'despachó, envió'; Dio tres cavalleros 'he dispatched three knights'; = envió)
glossary.carbonclas: carbonclas — carbuncles, red gems set in the helmet as ornament (fem. pl., from Latin carbunculus; Pidal 'carbunclos' o rubíes; = carbunclos, carbúnculos)
glossary.echógelas: echar + ge + las — echó 'he threw' (preterite 3rd sg.) + ge (= le 'to him', before an object pronoun; = se) + las 'them' (the carbuncles); echógelas aparte 'he knocked them off aside'; = se las echó
glossary.gel: ge + lo — ge (= le 'to him'; = se) + l(o) 'it' (non gel osó esperar 'did not dare wait for it (a second blow)'; probably so; = se lo)
glossary.esperar: esperar — to wait for, await, withstand (infinitive; non gel osó esperar 'did not dare to wait for it'; = esperar)
glossary.arrancado: arrancado — routed, driven off (past part. of arrancar, 'to pull out, uproot', here 'to rout'; arrancado es el rey 'the king is routed'; = arrancado, derrotado) · also arrancar — won (of a battle; una lid a arrancado 'he has won a battle'; = ganado)
glossary.cristiandad: cristiandad — Christendom, the Christian people (= cristiandad; tan buen día por la cristiandad 'such a good day for Christendom')
glossary.della: de + ella — 'from/of her/it' (contraction); della e della part, 'from the one and the other side', i.e. from all sides (= de ella, here de una y otra parte) · also della yaquanto — 'somewhat of it' (de + ella + yaquanto, Pidal 'algo': cofia … fronzida della yaquanto, the coif gathered a little)
glossary.alcaz: alcaz — pursuit, chase (verbal noun of alcançar; en alcaz 'in pursuit'; modern alcance means 'reach', closest persecución)
glossary.cogieron: coger — they took in, received, admitted (preterite 3rd pl.; nol cogieron allá 'did not take him in there'; modern coger means 'to take, catch', here = acogieron)
glossary.para: para — toward, to (para Cataluyuth 'toward Calatayud'; = para)
glossary.cataluyuth: Cataluyuth — Calatayud, the same name as Calatayuth with two syllables transposed (th is a spelling of final -d; the t is Pidal's restoration); = Calatayud
glossary.íval: ir + le — iva 'he was going' (imperfect 3rd sg.) + l(e) 'him, after him' (íval en alcaz 'he went after him in pursuit'; = le iba)
glossary.duró: durar — it lasted (preterite 3rd sg.; = duró) · also durar — he spent, took (time) (en ganar aquellas villas mio Çid duró tres años; Pidal 'tardó, empleó, gastó')
glossary.segudar: segudar — to pursue (infinitive; Pidal 'perseguir'; used as a noun, el segudar 'the pursuit'; no modern segudar, = perseguir, as a noun persecución)
glossary.mynaya: Minaya — spelling of Minaya with y (see minaya), the title by which the Cid's kinsman Álvar Fáñez is called
glossary.daquestos: de + aquestos — of these (preposition de + aquestos, masc. pl. of the reinforced demonstrative aqueste; daquestos moros 'of these Moors'; = de estos)
glossary.tajador: tajador — cutting, sharp (adjective, from tajar 'to cut'; espada tajador 'a cutting sword'; = cortante)
glossary.sangriento: sangriento — bloody, blood-stained (masc. sg.; sangriento trae el braço 'he carries his arm bloody'; = sangriento)
glossary.dize: dezir — he says (present 3rd sg.; Dize Minaya 'Minaya says'; = dice)
glossary.lid: lid — battle, fight (fem. noun; lid campal 'pitched battle'; vençiemos la lid 'we won the battle'; = lid, now literary, closest batalla, combate)
glossary.campal: campal — of the field, pitched (adjective, from campo; lid campal 'a battle in the open field'; = campal)
glossary.yazen: yazer — they lie (present 3rd pl.; yazen muertos 'they lie dead'; = yacen)
glossary.dexados: dexar — left (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with the object after a 'has'; pocos bivos a dexados 'he has left few alive'; = dejados)
glossary.andava: andar — he was going, was riding (imperfect 3rd sg.; Andava mio Çid sobre so buen cavallo 'the Cid was riding on his good horse'; = andaba)
glossary.cofia: cofia — coif, the close cap worn under the helmet or hood of mail (cofia fronzida 'the coif wrinkled/gathered'; = cofia)
glossary.fronzida: fronzir — gathered, drawn up in folds (past part. fem., agreeing with cofia; la cofia fronzida, Pidal 'fruncida sobre la cara', the coif drawn up about the face; = fruncida) · also fronzida trahe la cara 'he has his face gathered', Pidal: understood of the coif gathered about the face (fruncida)
glossary.barbado: barbado — bearded, having a full beard (adjective from barba; cómmo es bien barbado 'how well bearded he is'; = barbado)
glossary.almófar: almófar — hood of mail worn over the head and neck (word of Arabic origin; almófar a cuestas 'the mail hood thrown back on the shoulders'; = almófar)
glossary.cuestas: cuesta — back, shoulders (fem. pl. here; a cuestas 'on the back', with the hood hanging behind; modern cuesta usually 'slope'; = a cuestas)
glossary.commos: commo + se — how … (themselves) (commo 'how' + reflexive se cut to s; commos van allegando 'how they come gathering'; = cómo se)
glossary.allegando: allegar — gathering, coming together, drawing near (gerund; se van allegando 'they come gathering, assembling'; = allegándose, juntándose)
glossary.albergada: albergada — encampment, camp (noun from albergar 'to lodge'; Pidal 'campamento'; esta albergada 'this camp'; = campamento)
glossary.robado: robar — plundered, stripped (past part.; la an robado 'they have plundered it'; = robado)
glossary.largos: largo — abundant, ample, generous (masc. pl.; averes largos 'plentiful goods'; = largos) · also largos — 'many, wide, extensive' (de largos reynos 'of many kingdoms', Pidal 'muchos reinos'; = muchos, vastos)
glossary.moriscos: morisco — Moorish (adjective, masc. pl.; used without its noun: de los moriscos 'of the Moorish ones', i.e. the Moors' horses; = moriscos)
glossary.llegados: llegar — arrived, come (past part. masc. pl. after the auxiliary seer; quando son llegados 'when they have come'; = llegados)
glossary.ffallaron: fallar — they found (preterite 3rd pl.; ff- is a scribal spelling of initial f-, in medieval hands often standing for capital F; = hallaron)
glossary.alegreya: alegreya — joy, gladness (noun; grand alegreya 'great joy'; = alegría)
glossary.fallaron: fallar — they found (preterite 3rd pl.; = hallaron); fallar menos 'to find missing, to miss', Pidal 'echar de menos' (menos non fallaron 'they did not miss')
glossary.avién: aver — they had (imperfect 3rd pl., perfect auxiliary forming the pluperfect; que y avién fallado 'that they had found there'; = habían)
glossary.fallado: fallar — found (past part.; avién fallado 'they had found'; = hallado)
glossary.tornados: tornar — turned back, returned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with los 'them'; a los moros dentro los an tornados 'they have put the Moors back inside'; = vueltos, devueltos) · also tornar — turned back, returned (intransitive, with ser; tornados son 'they have turned back'; = vueltos)
glossary.dineros: dinero — money, coin (masc. pl.; estos dineros 'this money'; = dineros)
glossary.caen: caer — they fall (to), come as one's share (present 3rd pl.; al Çid caen cient cavallos 'a hundred horses fall to the Cid'; = caen)
glossary.cient: cient — hundred (apocopated before a noun; cient cavallos 'a hundred horses'; = cien)
glossary.pagó: pagar — he paid, rewarded (preterite 3rd sg.; qué bien pagó a todos sus vassallos 'how well he paid all his vassals'; = pagó)
glossary.encavalgados: encavalgado — mounted man, horseman (past part. used as a noun, masc. pl., opposed to peones 'foot-soldiers'; = encabalgados)
glossary.aguisa: aguisar — he arranges, sees to, provides for (present 3rd sg.; bien lo aguisa 'he arranges it well'; = dispone, prepara; aguisar is now obsolete)
glossary.riqueza: riqueza — wealth, riches (fem. sg.; D'aquesta riqueza 'of this wealth'; = riqueza)
glossary.desta: de + esta — of this (preposition de + demonstrative fem. sg.; desta batalla 'of this battle'; = de esta)
glossary.quiérol: quiero + le — I want to him (querer 1st sg. present + dative pronoun le with e elided after the verb; quiérol enbiar 'I want to send him'; = le quiero)
glossary.enfrenados: enfrenar — bridled, fitted with a bridle (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with cavallos; muy bien enfrenados 'very well bridled'; = enfrenados)
glossary.colgando: colgar — hanging (gerund; espadas … colgando 'swords hanging'; = colgando)
glossary.fina: fino — fine, pure (fem. sg., agreeing with plata; plata fina 'fine silver'; = fina)
glossary.uesa: uesa — high boot (Pidal's gloss 'bota alta', a boot used as a sack for small objects when clothes had no pockets; una uesa lleña 'a boot full'; = huesa, obsolete in this sense)
glossary.lleña: lleña — full (fem. sg., agreeing with uesa; una uesa lleña 'a boot full'; = llena; the -ñ- is a spelling variant)
glossary.mingua: minguar — it lacks, is wanting (present 3rd sg.; que nada nol mingua 'so that nothing is wanting to it'; = menguar, whence mengua 'lack') · also mingua — want, lack (noun; aver mingua de pan 'to be short of bread'; = mengua)
glossary.quitedes: quitar — you pay (for), discharge (present subjunctive 2nd pl. used as a command, old -edes ending; quitedes mill missas 'have a thousand Masses paid for'; Pidal glosses 'paguéis')
glossary.romaneçiere: romaneçer — (if) it remains over (future subjunctive 3rd sg., -iere; Pidal: romanecer and remanecer, 'quedar, sobrar'; lo que romaneçiere 'whatever remains over'; = sobrare)
glossary.daldo: dad + lo — give it (imperative 2nd pl. dad with object lo, the d and l reversed: dadlo > daldo, metathesis; daldo a mi mugier 'give it to my wife'; = dadlo)
glossary.rueguen: rogar — let them pray, may they pray (present subjunctive 3rd pl., after que of wish; que rueguen por mí 'may they pray for me'; = rueguen)
glossary.noches: noche — night (fem. pl.; las noches e los días 'nights and days'; = noches)
glossary.contados: contar — counted, picked out (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; por ir con él omnes son contados 'men are counted off to go with him'; = contados)
glossary.acordando: acordar — taking counsel (gerund; se acordando con los sos 'taking counsel with his men', the reflexive se before the gerund; = acordándose; cf. tornós a acordar) · also acordar — instructing, admonishing (transitive gerund; a los sos vassallos … los acordando 'instructing his vassals', Pidal 'previniendo o aleccionando'; = aleccionando)
glossary.nuestros: nuestro — our (masc. pl.; nuestros amigos 'our friends'; = nuestros)
glossary.podedes: poder — you can (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; bien les podedes dezir 'you may well tell them'; = podéis)
glossary.valió: valer — he helped, aided (preterite 3rd sg.; Dios nos valió 'God helped us'; = valió)
glossary.vençiemos: vençer — we won (preterite 1st pl. with the ending -iemos; vençiemos la lid 'we won the battle'; = vencimos)
glossary.falláredes: fallar — (if) you find (future subjunctive 2nd pl., -áredes, not an indicative; si nos falláredes aquí 'if you find us here'; = hallareis)
glossary.sopiéredes: saber — (wherever) you learn, may learn (future subjunctive 2nd pl., on the strong preterite stem sop- of sope, sopo; do sopiéredes que somos 'wherever you learn that we are'; = supiereis)
glossary.indos: id + nos — go … us (imperative 2nd pl. id with the object pronoun nos, d and n transposed, idnos > indos, as dadlo > daldo; the nos is the object of the following infinitive: indos conseguir 'go and overtake us'; = id a alcanzarnos)
glossary.conseguir: conseguir — to follow, catch up with (infinitive; indos conseguir 'go and catch up with us'; modern conseguir means 'to obtain', closest alcanzar)
glossary.guarir: guarir — to save oneself, find safety, survive, get one's living (infinitive; avemos de guarir 'we must save ourselves, live'; = guarecerse)
glossary.angosta: angosto — narrow, scant, wretched (fem. sg., agreeing with tierra; tierra angosta 'a narrow, poor land'; = angosta, closest estrecha)
glossary.bivir: bivir — to live (infinitive; non podriemos bivir 'we could not live'; = vivir)
glossary.cuedo: cuedar — I think, suppose (present 1st sg.; old form of cuidar in its old sense 'to think'; commo yo cuedo 'as I think'; = creo, pienso)
glossary.avremos: aver — we shall have (future 1st pl., syncopated; a ir nos avremos 'we shall have to go', aver a + inf. with the clitic nos set inside the phrase; = habremos)
glossary.mañánas: mañana — in the morning, early (adverbial -s ending on mañana; mañanas fo Minaya 'Minaya set out in the morning'; = por la mañana)
glossary.sobejana: sobejano — excessive, enormous, very great (adjective, fem. sg.; sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'; sobejana es la su ganançia 'enormous is his booty'; no modern form, closest enorme, excesiva)
glossary.aguardavan: aguardar — they were watching, keeping an eye on, waiting for (imperfect 3rd pl.; a mio Çid aguardavan 'they were watching the Cid'; = aguardaban)
glossary.fronteras: frontera — frontier, border region (fem. pl.; moros de las fronteras 'Moors of the border lands'; = fronteras)
glossary.unas: uno — some, certain (indefinite fem. pl.; unas yentes extrañas 'some foreign peoples'; = unas)
glossary.extrañas: extraño — foreign, from elsewhere (adjective, fem. pl., agreeing with yentes; yentes extrañas 'foreign folk'; = extrañas)
glossary.sanó: sanar — he recovered, was healed (preterite 3rd sg.; sanó el rey Fáriz 'King Fáriz recovered'; = sanó)
glossary.consejavan: consejar — they took counsel (imperfect 3rd pl., here reflexive se consejavan 'they consulted together'; con él se consejavan 'they took counsel with him'; = se aconsejaban)
glossary.calatayut: Calatayut — Calatayud, town in the province of Zaragoza (= Calatayud)
glossary.asmado: asmar — reckoned, appraised, agreed (past part., with an 'they have' as perfect: lo an asmado 'they have reckoned/settled it'; = estimado, convenido)
glossary.metudo: meter — put, set down (old past part. in -udo; metudo en carta 'put in writing'; = metido)
glossary.vendido: vender — sold (past part.; vendido les a 'he has sold to them', with a 'has' as auxiliary placed after the participle; = vendido)
glossary.mismos: mismo — own, very (masc. pl., emphatic; sos vassallos mismos 'his own vassals'; = mismos)
glossary.fechos: fazer — made (past part., masc. pl., agreeing with the object; fechos los ha ricos 'he has made them rich'; = hechos)
glossary.fallariedes: fallar — you would find (conditional 2nd pl., infinitive + -iedes ending; non fallariedes un mesquino 'you would not find one poor man'; = hallaríais)
glossary.mesquino: mesquino — poor wretch, needy person (masc. sg.; un mesquino 'a single poor man'; = mezquino, which has since come to mean 'stingy')
glossary.sirve: servir — he serves (present 3rd sg.; Qui a buen señor sirve 'he who serves a good lord'; = sirve)
glossary.deliçio: deliçio — delight, pleasure, comfort (masc. noun; bive en deliçio 'lives in delight'; = deleite, delicia)
glossary.tomáronse: tomar + se — they took themselves, set about (tomaron 3rd pl. preterite + reflexive se, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; tomarse a + infinitive 'to begin to'; tomáronse a quexar 'they began to lament'; = se pusieron a)
glossary.quexar: quexar — to lament, complain (infinitive; tomáronse a quexar 'they began to lament'; = quejarse)
glossary.vaste: ir + te — you go away (vas 2nd sg. present + reflexive te; ¿vaste, mio Çid? 'are you going away, my Cid?'; = te vas)
glossary.nuestras: nuestro — our (possessive fem. pl.; nuestras oraçiones 'our prayers'; = nuestras)
glossary.váyante: ir + te — may they go for you, may they go (before) you (present subjunctive 3rd pl. vayan + dative te; nuestras oraçiones váyante delante 'may our prayers go before you'; = que te vayan, que te acompañen)
glossary.delante: delante — in front, ahead, before (adverb, fuller form of delant; váyante delante 'may they go before you'; = delante)
glossary.fincamos: fincar — we remain, stay (present 1st pl.; pagados fincamos 'we remain satisfied'; = quedamos)
glossary.quitó: quitar — he left, quit, gave up (preterite 3rd sg.; quitó a Alcoçer 'he left Alcocer'; = dejó, abandonó) · also quitar — he parted from, took leave of a person (luégo[l] quitó 'at once he took leave of him'; = se separó de)
glossary.compeçaron: compeçar — they began (preterite 3rd pl., variant of començar; compeçaron de llorar 'they began to weep'; = comenzaron)
glossary.llorar: llorar — to weep (infinitive; compeçaron de llorar 'they began to weep'; = llorar)
glossary.cabadelant: cabadelant — straight on, forward, onward (adverb, cab (= cabo 'head, end') + adelant, apocopated; aguijó cabadelant 'he spurred on ahead'; = adelante, derecho adelante)
glossary.aves: ave — bird; birds as omens, augury (fem. pl.; buenas aves 'good omens', from the old practice of reading birds' flight; = aves, closest agüeros)
glossary.alcocer: Alcocer — Alcocer, spelling of Alcoçer (see alcoçer), the town the Cid sells to the Moors and leaves (pesó a los de Alcocer 'it grieved the people of Alcocer')
glossary.fazié: fazer — he was doing, was bringing about (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; pro les fazié grant 'he did them great good'; = hacía)
glossary.ivas: ir + se — he was going off (iva imperfect 3rd sg. + reflexive se cut to s, as in commos; ivas cabadelant 'he rode on ahead'; = se iba)
glossary.ffincó: fincar — he halted, stopped, remained (preterite 3rd sg., ff- is an f- spelling; ffincó en un poyo 'he halted on a hill'; = se detuvo, se quedó)
glossary.poyo: poyo — hill, rising ground, knoll (Latin podium; poyo que es sobre Mont Real 'the hill above Monreal'; = poyo, closest cerro, colina)
glossary.real: real — royal (adjective; here in the place name Mont Real 'Royal Mount', modern Monreal; = real)
glossary.maravilloso: maravilloso — marvelous, remarkable, extraordinary (masc. sg.; alto es el poyo, maravilloso e grant 'the hill is high, remarkable and great'; = maravilloso)
glossary.teme: temer — he fears (present 3rd sg.; non teme guerra 'it fears no war'; = teme)
glossary.nulla: nulla — no, any (Latin nulla; fem. sg. after a negative or 'without'; a nulla part 'from no side, anywhere'; si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = ninguna)
glossary.daroca: Daroca — Daroca, town in the province of Zaragoza (= Daroca)
glossary.molina: Molina — Molina (de Aragón), town in the province of Guadalajara (= Molina)
glossary.terçera: terçero — third (ordinal, fem. sg.; la terçera Teruel 'the third, Teruel'; = tercera)
glossary.teruel: Teruel — Teruel, city in Aragon (= Teruel)
glossary.ido: ir — gone (past part.; ser + ido as perfect of a verb of motion: ido es a Castiella 'he has gone to Castile'; = ido)
glossary.enpresentava: enpresentar — he was presenting, offering as a gift (imperfect 3rd sg.; los enpresentava 'he was presenting them'; = presentaba)
glossary.vídolos: ver + los — he saw them (vido 3rd sg. preterite + object los, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; = los vio)
glossary.sonrrisava: sonrrisar — he was smiling (imperfect 3rd sg.; fermoso sonrrisava 'he smiled warmly'; = sonreía)
glossary.quin: quin — who? (interrogative pronoun, variant of qui/quien; ¿quin los dio estos? 'who gave these?'; = quién)
glossary.ayrastes: ayrar — you turned your anger on, withdrew your favour from (preterite 2nd pl., -astes ending; Pues quel vos ayrastes 'since you were angered against him'; = airasteis)
glossary.llegava: llegar — it was arriving, was reaching (imperfect 3rd sg.; el mensaje llegava 'the message was reaching (him)'; = llegaba)
glossary.mandólo: mandar + lo — he ordered it (mandó 3rd sg. preterite + object lo, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; mandólo y çercar 'he had him (the Cid; or 'it', the place) besieged there'; = lo mandó)
glossary.tolléronle: toller + le — they took away from him (tollieron 3rd pl. preterite + dative le 'from him', the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; tolléronle el agua 'they cut off his water'; = le quitaron)
glossary.lidiava: lidiar — he was fighting (imperfect 3rd sg.; en campo lidiava 'he fought in the open field'; = lidiaba)
glossary.venció: vencer — he defeated, conquered (preterite 3rd sg.; venció dos reyes 'he defeated two kings'; = venció)
glossary.ondrado: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. as adjective, masc. sg.; rey ondrado 'honored king'; = honrado)
glossary.enbía: enbiar — he sends (present 3rd sg.; enbía esta presentaja 'he sends this gift'; = envía)
glossary.bésavos: besar + vos — he kisses your (besa 3rd sg. present + dative vos, a possessive 'your'; bésavos los piedes 'he kisses your feet'; = os besa)
glossary.piedes: pie — feet (old plural, Latin pedes; los piedes e las manos 'the feet and the hands'; = pies) · also de piedes de cavallo 'at full gallop' (Pidal 'a uña de caballo')
glossary.amas: amos — both (fem. pl., Latin ambas; las manos amas 'both hands'; = ambas)
glossary.acogello: acoger + lo — to receive, take back (infinitive + object lo, the r assimilated to l: acogerlo > acogello; por acogello 'to take him back'; = acogerlo)
glossary.prendo: prender — I take, accept (present 1st sg.; prendo esta presentaja 'I accept this gift'; = tomo; modern prender is 'to seize, arrest')
glossary.sobresto: sobre + esto — besides this, moreover, on top of this (sobre 'upon' + neuter esto, run together; Sobresto todo 'on top of all this'; = además de esto)
glossary.honores: honor — honor, dignity; in feudal use a lordship, fief or office held from the king (pl.; honores e tierras 'honors and lands'; = honores)
glossary.avellas: aver + las — have them! (imperative 2nd pl. aved + object las, the d assimilated to l: avedlas > avellas; honores e tierras avellas condonadas 'your honours and lands, have them restored'; = tenedlas)
glossary.condonadas: condonar — granted, restored (past part. fem. pl.; Pidal: 'conceder, restituir'; avellas condonadas 'have them restored to you'; = restituidas; modern condonar means 'to remit (a debt)')
glossary.venit: venir — come! (imperative 2nd pl., -t for -d like sabet; id e venit 'go and come'; = venid)
glossary.digo: dezir — I say (present 1st sg.; yo non vos digo nada 'I say nothing to you'; = digo)
glossary.quisieren: querer — they shall wish (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; los que lo quisieren far 'those who wish to do so'; = quisieren, now only in legal language, closest quieran)
glossary.huyar: huyar — to help, come to the aid of (infinitive after pora; pora mio Çid huyar 'to help my Cid'; a rare word, the lemma is uncertain (perhaps uviar 'to come to the aid of'), and it is not huir 'to flee'; closest ayudar, socorrer)
glossary.suéltoles: soltar + les — I release, set free (suelto 1st sg. present + dative les 'their'; suéltoles los cuerpos 'I free their persons'; = les suelto)
glossary.quítoles: quitar + les — I release, free from claim (quito 1st sg. present + dative les 'their'; quítoles las heredades 'I free their estates'; = les quito)
glossary.besóle: besar + le — he kissed his (besó 3rd sg. preterite + dative le 'his', the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; besóle las manos 'he kissed his hands'; = le besó)
glossary.natural: natural — natural, rightful, by birth (adjective; señor natural 'a rightful lord, one owed allegiance by birth'; = natural) · also natural — native of a place, true (el Burgalés natural 'the native of Burgos'; amigo natural 'a friend by nature, true-born friend')
glossary.feches: fazer — you do (present 2nd pl., a reduced form of fazedes; esto feches agora 'this you do now'; the sense is clear, the exact derivation less so; = hacéis)
glossary.feredes: fazer — you will do (future 2nd pl., syncopated stem fer-; al feredes adelant 'the rest you will do later'; = haréis)
glossary.nós: nós — we (stressed subject pronoun; con Dios nós guisaremos 'with God we shall arrange it'; = nosotros)
glossary.guisaremos: guisar — we shall arrange, prepare, manage (future 1st pl.; = guisaremos, closest dispondremos, arreglaremos)
glossary.vós: vós — you (stressed subject pronoun, polite/plural; commo vós lo fagades 'as you shall do it'; = vos, vosotros)
glossary.déxenvos: dexar + vos — let them allow you (dexen present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive + dative vos, the -n kept; déxenvos andar 'let them let you travel'; = que os dejen)
glossary.quiérovos: querer + vos — I want (to) you (quiero, present 1st sg., + enclitic vos; Quiérovos dezir 'I want to tell you'; = os quiero)
glossary.pueblo: pueblo — people, population, community (el pueblo de moros 'the Moorish population'; = pueblo)
glossary.yente: yente — people, folk (sg.; = gente; y- from Latin g-; la yente cristiana 'the Christian folk')
glossary.cristiana: cristiano — Christian (fem. sg.; la yente cristiana 'the Christian people'; = cristiana)
glossary.asil: así + le — thus ... it (así 'thus' + enclitic le 'it'; asil dirán por carta 'so they will call it in writing'; = así le)
glossary.dirán: dezir — they will say, they will call (future 3rd pl.; = dirán)
glossary.mucha: mucho — much, a great deal of (fem. sg.; mucha tierra 'much land'; = mucha)
glossary.preava: prear — he was plundering, raiding (imperfect 3rd sg.; mucha tierra preava 'he plundered much land'; = saqueaba, closest)
glossary.río: río — river (río Martín 'the Martín river'; = río)
glossary.saragoça: Saragoça — Zaragoza, city on the Ebro, seat of a Moorish kingdom (= Zaragoza)
glossary.nuevas: nueva — news, tidings (fem. pl.; sus nuevas legavan 'his news was arriving'; = noticias, nuevas) · also nuevas — renown, fame (las nuevas de mio Çid sonando van; Pidal 'renombre, fama') · also nuevas — affairs, doings (las nuevas del cavallero 'the knight's affairs'; Pidal 'los asuntos, los negocios') · also nuevas — exploits, deeds (las nuevas que faze el Campeador; Pidal 'las hazañas que hace') · also grandes son las nuevas 'there is a great stir' (Pidal 'gran actividad o animación hay')
glossary.legavan: llegar — they were arriving (imperfect 3rd pl.; spelling leg- for lleg-; = llegaban)
glossary.sovo: seer — he stayed, he was (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Allí sovo mio Çid 'there the Cid stayed'; = estuvo)
glossary.conplidas: conplido — complete, full (fem. pl.; conplidas quinze sedmanas 'a full fifteen weeks'; = cumplidas)
glossary.tardava: tardar — he was delaying, was late (imperfect 3rd sg., reflexive; que se tardava Minaya 'that Minaya was delaying'; = se tardaba)
glossary.trasnochada: trasnochada — night march, a ride through the night (noun from trasnochar; fizo una trasnochada 'he made a night march'; = trasnochada, closest marcha nocturna)
glossary.desenparava: desenparar — he was abandoning, leaving (imperfect 3rd sg.; todo lo desenparava 'he was abandoning it all'; = desamparaba)
glossary.allén: allén — beyond (preposition with de; allén de Teruel 'beyond Teruel'; = allende)
glossary.pinar: pinar — pine wood, pine forest (el pinar de Tévar 'the pine wood of Tévar'; = pinar)
glossary.tévar: Tévar — Tévar, place name of a pine wood where the Cid camped (el pinar de Tévar; = Tévar)
glossary.metuda: meter — put, placed (past part. fem. sg., old form in -udo, agreeing with the object; metuda lâ en paria 'he has put it under tribute'; = metida)
glossary.lâ: la + a — it + has (la, object pronoun for Saragoça, + a = ha, aver 3rd sg. as perfect auxiliary, run together by Pidal with a circumflex; metuda lâ en paria 'he has put it under tribute'; = la ha; reading uncertain)
glossary.çiñen: çeñir — they gird, wear (present 3rd pl.; que todos çiñen espadas 'all of whom wear swords'; = ciñen)
glossary.asomar: asomar — to appear, come into view (infinitive; vido asomar a Minaya 'saw Minaya appear'; = asomar)
glossary.corriendo: correr — running, at a gallop (gerund; el cavallo corriendo 'the horse galloping'; = corriendo)
glossary.valo: va + lo — he goes ... him (va, present 3rd sg. of ir, + enclitic lo; ir + infinitive; valo abraçar 'he goes to embrace him'; = lo va)
glossary.boca: boca — mouth (besóle la boca 'he kissed his mouth'; = boca)
glossary.encubre: encubrir — he conceals, hides (present 3rd sg.; nol encubre nada 'he hides nothing from him'; = encubre)
glossary.álvar: Álvar — Álvar (given name of Minaya, Álvar Fáñez; = Álvar)
glossary.assi: assí — thus, so (printed assi, unaccented; = así; Minaya Álvar Fáñez assi era llegado 'Minaya had thus arrived')
glossary.llegado: llegar — arrived (past part.; era llegado 'had arrived', ser as perfect auxiliary; = llegado) · also llegar — llegado ha 'has reached' (past part. before aver as perfect auxiliary; fata la çintura el espada llegado ha 'the sword has reached down to the waist')
glossary.diziéndoles: dezir + les — saying to them (gerund + enclitic les; diziéndoles saludes 'bringing them greetings'; = diciéndoles)
glossary.saludes: salud — greeting; news of an absent person (pl.; Pidal: saludes 'noticias de una persona ausente'; diziéndoles saludes de primos 'bringing them news of their cousins'; = saludos, noticias)
glossary.alegría: alegría — joy, gladness (fizo grant alegría 'he showed great joy'; = alegría)
glossary.bivades: bivir — may you live (present subjunctive 2nd pl., optative; bivades muchos días 'may you live many days'; = viváis)
glossary.valedes: valer — you are worth (present 2nd pl.; más valedes que nos 'you are worth more than we'; = valéis)
glossary.mandadería: mandadería — errand, message carried, mission (noun, from mandado/mandadero; tan buena mandadería 'such a good errand'; no modern form, closest mensaje, recado)
glossary.tardó: tardar — he delayed (preterite 3rd sg.; non lo tardó 'he did not delay it'; = tardó)
glossary.escollechos: escoger — chosen, picked (past part. masc. pl., old irregular form; escollechos a mano 'hand-picked'; = escogidos)
glossary.corrida: corrida — raid, foray (noun from correr; fizo una corrida 'he made a raid'; = corrida, closest correría) · also corrida — a run, a display gallop of a horse (fizo una corrida 'he made a run'; Pidal: 'alarde de equitación a galope', Old French eslai)
glossary.trasnochando: trasnochar — riding through the night (gerund; la noch trasnochando 'riding through the night'; = trasnochando)
glossary.alcañiz: Alcañiz — town in Teruel province (= Alcañiz)
glossary.negras: negro — black (fem. pl.; negras las va parando 'he goes leaving them black', i.e. waste, barren: Pidal 'yermas, estériles', as opposed to tierra blanca, sown land; = yermas)
glossary.parando: parar — leaving, putting in a state (gerund; las va parando negras 'he goes leaving them black'; = parando, closest dejando) · also parar mientes 'to set the mind, pay heed' (están parando mientes al … 'they are watching, attending to …')
glossary.preando: prear — plundering (gerund; todo lo va preando 'he goes plundering everything'; = saqueando)
glossary.terçer: terçero — third (apocopated before a noun; al terçer día 'on the third day'; = tercer)
glossary.ixo: exir — he went out, set out (preterite 3rd sg.; don ixo 'from where he set out'; = salió)
glossary.hya: ya — now, already (h- spelling variant of ya; Hya va el mandado 'now the news goes'; = ya)
glossary.monçon: Monçon — Monzón, town in Huesca province (= Monzón)
glossary.huosca: Huesca — city in Aragon (Pidal's Hu[o]sca; = Huesca)
glossary.temién: temer — they feared (imperfect 3rd pl.; non temién ninguna fonta 'they feared no harm'; = temían)
glossary.ninguna: ninguno — no, any (fem. sg., with a negative; non temién ninguna fonta 'they feared no harm at all'; = ninguna)
glossary.fonta: fonta — outrage, affront; harm (Pidal: 'ultraje, afrenta', and 'daño' in general; tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront'; non temién ninguna fonta 'they feared no harm'; = afrenta, ultraje)
glossary.alegres: alegre — glad, happy (pl.; todos son alegres 'all are glad'; = alegres)
glossary.verdad: verdad — truth (dezir vos he la verdad 'I shall tell you the truth'; = verdad) · also non será verdad — 'it shall not be so' (Pidal: 'esto no será así'; esto non será verdad) · also por verdad — truly, indeed (í albergaron por verdad una noch 'they truly lodged there one night')
glossary.mora: morar — he stays, dwells (present 3rd sg.; qui en un logar mora siempre 'he who stays always in one place'; = mora)
glossary.menguar: menguar — to diminish, grow less (infinitive; lo so puede menguar 'what is his may dwindle'; = menguar)
glossary.dexat: dexar — leave (imperative 2nd pl., dexad; dexat estas posadas 'leave these quarters'; = dejad)
glossary.iremos: ir — we shall go (future 1st pl.; iremos adelant 'we shall go onward'; = iremos)
glossary.estonçes: estonçes — then, at that time (= entonces)
glossary.mudó: mudar — he moved, changed (preterite 3rd sg., reflexive; se mudó el Çid 'the Cid moved camp'; = se mudó)
glossary.puerto: puerto — mountain pass (Latin portus; al puerto de Alucat 'to the pass of Alucat'; = puerto)
glossary.alucat: Alucat — place name, a mountain pass (puerto de Alucat; Pidal: today Olocau del Rey, west of Morella, Castellón)
glossary.huesa: Huesa — Huesa, a town of the province of Teruel (Pidal), not Huesca (a Huesa e a Mont Alván; = Huesa)
glossary.alván: Alván — Albán, as in Mont Alván, Montalbán, a town in Teruel (= Alván, in Montalbán)
glossary.aquessa: aquesse — that (fem. sg.; aquessa corrida 'in that foray'; = esa, closest aquella)
glossary.dias: día — day (pl.; diez dias 'ten days'; = días)
glossary.morar: morar — to stay, dwell (infinitive; ovieron a morar 'they had to stay'; = morar)
glossary.salido: salir — gone out, exiled (past part., used as a noun; el salido de Castiella 'the one banished from Castile'; = salido) · also salir — gone out, ended (past part. with es, intransitive perfect; el día es salido 'the day has gone'; = ha salido, ha pasado)
glossary.idos: ir — gone, spread abroad (past part. masc. pl.; son idos 'have gone out'; = idos)
glossary.llegaron: llegar — they arrived (preterite 3rd pl.; llegaron las nuevas 'the news arrived'; = llegaron)
glossary.comde: conde — count (Pidal's co[m]de; al comde de Barçilona 'to the count of Barcelona'; = conde)
glossary.corrié: correr — he was running, raiding (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; quel corrié la tierra toda 'that he was raiding his whole land'; = corría)
glossary.tóvoslo: tener + se + lo — he took it (tovo, strong preterite 3rd sg. of tener, + se + lo; tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront'; = se lo tuvo)
glossary.conde: conde — count (noun; el conde don Remont 'Count Remont'; = conde)
glossary.follón: follón — arrogant, overbearing (adj.; el conde es muy follón 'the count is very arrogant'; the exact shade is uncertain and Pidal gives no note; closest arrogante)
glossary.vanidat: vanidat — vanity, empty boast (fem. noun; dixo una vanidat 'spoke a boast'; = vanidad)
glossary.tuertos: tuerto — wrong, injury (noun, pl.; grandes tuertos 'great wrongs'; = agravios, tuertos)
glossary.cort: cort — court, royal or lordly household (fem. noun; en mi cort 'in my court'; = corte) · also cort — a court summoned as a solemn assembly for judgement (pregonarán mi[e] cort 'they will proclaim my court'; Pidal, note to 2963, the corte pregonada o solemne; = cortes)
glossary.tuerto: tuerto — wrong, injury (noun, sg.; tuerto me tovo 'did me wrong'; = agravio)
glossary.tovo: tener — he held, he did (strong preterite 3rd sg.; tuerto me tovo 'he did me wrong'; = tuvo)
glossary.firióm: ferir + me — struck me (firió, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic m(e); firióm el sobrino 'the nephew struck me'; = me hirió)
glossary.enmendó: enmendar — he made amends for (preterite 3rd sg.; non lo enmendó 'he did not make amends'; = enmendó)
glossary.córrem: correr + me — raids on me (corre, present 3rd sg., + enclitic m(e), dative of the person harmed; córrem las tierras 'he raids my lands'; = me corre)
glossary.desafié: desafiar — I defied, formally challenged (preterite 1st sg.; non lo desafié 'I did not challenge him'; = desafié, formal breaking of feudal ties)
glossary.nil: ni + le — nor ... to him (ni 'nor' + enclitic l(e); nil torné amiztad 'nor withdrew my friendship from him'; = ni le)
glossary.torné: tornar — I returned, gave back (preterite 1st sg.); tornar amistad 'to withdraw friendship', the formal step before defiance (Pidal: 'retirar la amistad'; = torné)
glossary.amiztad: amiztad — friendship (fem. noun; = amistad; Pidal's [a]mi[z]tad, editorial letters; the el before it is the article el for la)
glossary.busca: buscar — he seeks, looks for (present 3rd sg.; quando él me lo busca 'since he seeks it of me'; = busca)
glossary.demandar: demandar — to demand, claim, ask for (infinitive; ir gelo he demandar 'I shall go and demand it of him'; split future ir + ge + lo + he, = se lo iré a demandar; = demandar)
glossary.llegandos: llegar + se — arriving, gathering (gerund llegando + reflexive s(e), Pidal's llegando[s]; a priessa llegandos van 'they keep gathering in haste'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = llegándose)
glossary.allegan: allegar(se) — they gather, assemble (present 3rd pl., reflexive se le allegan 'gather to him'; = se allegan, closest se juntan)
glossary.adeliñan: adeliñar — they head for, make straight for (present 3rd pl.; adeliñan tras mio Çid 'they make straight after my Çid'; = se encaminan, se dirigen)
glossary.tras: tras — after, behind (preposition; tras mio Çid 'after the Cid, in pursuit of'; = tras)
glossary.penssaron: pensar — they set about (preterite 3rd pl.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; penssaron de andar 'they set about marching'; = pensaron)
glossary.alcançaron: alcançar — they overtook, caught up with (preterite 3rd pl.; = alcanzaron)
glossary.cuydan: cuydar — they think, they expect (present 3rd pl., Pidal's cuyda[n]; se le cuydan tomar 'they expect to seize him'; = creen, piensan)
glossary.diçe: deçir — he comes down, descends (present 3rd sg.; diçe de una sierra 'he comes down from a range'; Pidal: 'desciende'; not dezir 'to say'; = desciende)
glossary.remont: Remont — Ramón, the count of Barcelona's name in the poem (don Remont; in full Remont Verenguel; = Ramón)
glossary.lês: les + es — to them is (Pidal's circumflexed contraction: les 'to them' + es, ser as perfect auxiliary of venir; venido lês mensaje 'a message has come to them'; = les ha venido; reading probable, not certain)
glossary.enbió: enviar — he sent (preterite 3rd sg.; enbió pora allá 'he sent (messengers) over there'; = envió)
glossary.digades: dezir — (that) you say, tell (2nd pl. present subjunctive used as command, polite; digades al conde 'tell the count'; = digáis)
glossary.tenga: tener — (that) he hold, take (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it ill'; = tenga)
glossary.lievo: levar — I take, carry off (present 1st sg.; de lo so non lievo nada 'of what is his I take nothing'; = llevo)
glossary.déxem: dexar + me — let him leave me (dexe, present subjunctive 3rd sg., + enclitic me; déxem ir en paz 'let him let me go in peace'; = déjeme)
glossary.tódom: todo + me — all of it ... to me (todo + enclitic me, dative 'for me'; tódom lo pechará 'he will pay me for all of it'; = todo me)
glossary.pechará: pechar — he will pay, pay for (future 3rd sg.; lo pechará 'he shall pay for it'; = pagará)
glossary.sabrá: saber — he will know, find out (future 3rd sg.; sabrá el salido 'the exile will find out'; = sabrá)
glossary.desondrar: desondrar — to dishonour, insult (infinitive; vino desondrar 'came to dishonour'; = deshonrar)
glossary.connosçe: connosçer — he recognizes, realizes (present 3rd sg.; essora lo connosçe 'then he realizes it'; = conoce)
glossary.den: den — from there, from it (de + en, the short form of ende 'thence', as dent = de + ent; non pueden den quitar 'they cannot get clear of it'; = de allí, de ello) · also den — they give (present subjunctive 3rd pl. of dar; commo den derecho 'that they give justice'; = den)
glossary.apart: apart — aside, apart (adverb; apart fazed la ganançia 'set the booty aside'; = aparte)
glossary.fazed: fazer — do, make (imperative 2nd pl.; apart fazed 'set aside'; = haced)
glossary.guarnid: guarnir — equip, arm yourselves (imperative 2nd pl.; apriessa vos guarnid 'arm yourselves quickly'; = guarneced, armaos)
glossary.metedos: meter + vos — put yourselves (imperative 2nd pl. meted + vos, the v of vos lost: metedvos > metedos; metedos en las armas 'take up your arms'; = meteos)
glossary.dexarié: dexar — he would leave (conditional 3rd sg., -ié ending; non nos dexarié 'he would not let us be'; = dejaría)
glossary.apretad: apretar — tighten (imperative 2nd pl.; apretad los cavallos 'tighten the (girths of the) horses'; = apretad)
glossary.bistades: bestir — (that) you put on (present subjunctive 2nd pl. used as an exhortation; b for v; bistades las armas 'put on your armour'; = vistáis)
glossary.cuesta: cuesta — slope, hillside (fem. noun; cuesta yuso 'down the slope'; = cuesta)
glossary.yuso: yuso — down, downward (adverb, Latin deorsum; cuesta yuso 'down the slope'; = abajo)
glossary.trahen: traer — they bring, they wear (present 3rd pl., h marking the hiatus; todos trahen calças 'all of them wear hose'; = traen)
glossary.elas: e + las — and the (e 'and' + fem. pl. article las; elas siellas 'and the saddles'; = y las) · also elas — the (fem. pl.), perhaps the archaic full article (= las; cf. ela) rather than e + las: elas noches e los días 'always, continually' (Pidal 'siempre, continuamente'); the analysis is uncertain
glossary.coçeras: coçera — of a kind of saddle (adj., fem. pl.; siellas coçeras, the enemy's saddles, which Pidal (note to v. 1007) calls insecure, set against the siellas gallegas; the exact sense is uncertain)
glossary.amojadas: amojado — slack, loose (past part. as adj., fem. pl.; las cinchas amojadas 'the girths slack'; Pidal gives no note and the sense is uncertain)
glossary.cavalgaremos: cavalgar — we shall ride (future 1st pl.; = cabalgaremos)
glossary.gallegas: gallego — Galician (adj., fem. pl.; siellas gallegas 'Galician saddles', set against the enemy's siellas coçeras; = gallegas)
glossary.huesas: huesa — high boot, riding boot (pl.; huesas sobre calças 'boots over hose'; = botas)
glossary.devemos: dever — we must, we are bound to (present 1st pl.; devemos vençer 'we are bound to defeat'; = debemos)
glossary.llaño: llaño — plain, level ground (masc. noun; a llaño 'onto the plain'; = llano)
glossary.presentémosles: presentar + les — let us present to them (present subjunctive 1st pl. presentemos + enclitic les, the s of -mos kept; presentémosles las lanças 'let us meet them with our lances'; = presentémosles)
glossary.firgades: ferir — (that) you strike (present subjunctive 2nd pl., with -g- stem; por uno que firgades 'for each one you strike'; = hiráis)
glossary.verá: veer — he will see (future 3rd sg.; verá Remont 'Ramón will see'; = verá)
glossary.verenguel: Verenguel — Berenguer, the count of Barcelona's second name (Remont Verenguel; = Berenguer)
glossary.tollerme: toller + me — to take from me (toller 'to take away' + enclitic me; por tollerme la ganançia 'in order to take my booty from me'; = quitarme)
glossary.adobados: adobar — equipped, ready (past part. masc. pl.; todos son adobados 'all are ready'; = pertrechados, aderezados)
glossary.fablado: fablar — spoken (past part.; quando esto ovo fablado 'when he had said this'; = hablado)
glossary.presas: prender — taken up, taken (past part. fem. pl.; las armas avién presas 'they had taken up their arms'; = presas)
glossary.sedién: seer — they were sitting, they sat (imperfect 3rd pl. of seer 'to sit'; sedién sobre los cavallos 'they sat on their horses'; = estaban sentados)
glossary.fuerça: fuerça — force, host, army (fem. noun; la fuerça de los francos 'the host of the Franks'; = fuerza)
glossary.francos: franco — Frank (masc. pl.; los francos, the Catalans: Pidal notes that historians of the twelfth century still call them so, Catalonia having been a march of the Carolingian empire; = francos)
glossary.fondón: fondón — bottom, foot (masc. noun; al fondón de la cuesta 'at the bottom of the slope'; = fondo)
glossary.enpleando: enplear — using, plying (gerund; las van enpleando 'they go on plying them'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = empleando)
glossary.derrocando: derrocar — throwing down, unhorsing (gerund; a los otros derrocando 'unhorsing others'; Pidal: 'derribando'; = derribando)
glossary.vençido: vençer — won, defeated (past part.; vençido a 'has won', with a (= ha) after the participle; vençido a esta batalla 'he has won this battle'; = ha vencido)
glossary.preson: preson — prison, captivity (fem. noun; a preson le a tomado 'he has taken him prisoner'; = prisión)
glossary.hi: hi — there, in it (adverb, variant of i from Latin ibi; hi gañó a Colada 'there he won Colada'; = allí)
glossary.colada: Colada — Colada, a sword, won by the Çid at Tévar (hi gañó a Colada 'there he won Colada'; = Colada)
glossary.vale: valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg.; que más vale de mill marcos 'which is worth more than a thousand marks'; = vale) · also va + le — 'it goes on (…ing) for him' (ir + gerund with enclitic le: Yal creçe la barba e vale allongando 'and it goes on lengthening for him'; = se le va alargando) · also más vale que 'it is better that' (impersonal; más vale que nos los vezcamos 'better that we conquer them') · also valer — he helps, aids (present 3rd sg.; si Dios non nos vale 'if God does not help us'; = vale, here ayuda)
glossary.ondró: ondrar — he honoured, made honoured (preterite 3rd sg.; por o ondró su barba 'through which he honoured his beard'; = honró)
glossary.prísole: prender + le — he took him (priso, strong preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic le; prísole al comde 'he took the count'; = le prendió)
glossary.creenderos: creendero — trusted servant (noun, pl.; Pidal: 'servidor fiel'; a sos creenderos 'to his trusted men'; = hombres de confianza)
glossary.mandava: mandar — he ordered, was ordering (imperfect 3rd sg.; a sos creenderos guardar lo mandava 'he told his trusted men to guard him'; = mandaba) · also mandar — he was governing, held (imperfect 3rd sg., of a place; la que Avengalvón mandava 'which Avengalvón ruled'; = gobernaba)
glossary.ajuntavan: ajuntar(se) — they were gathering, assembled (imperfect 3rd pl. in -avan, Pidal's ajunta[van], reflexive sense 'gathered themselves'; = se juntaban)
glossary.cozínal: cozina + l(e) — cooked food, a meal, for him (cozina, Pidal 'vianda o comida aderezada al fuego', + enclitic l(e), dative, resuming A mio Çid; grant cozínal adobavan 'they were preparing a great meal for him'; a pronoun leaning on a noun is unusual and the analysis is uncertain; = comida)
glossary.adobavan: adobar — they prepared, were preparing (imperfect 3rd pl.; = adobaban, aderezaban)
glossary.adúzenle: aduzir + le — they bring to him (aduzen present 3rd pl. + enclitic le; = le traen; aduzir = to bring, lead)
glossary.comeres: comer — food, dishes (masc. noun, pl., nominalised infinitive; adúzenle los comeres 'they bring him the dishes'; = comidas)
glossary.quiere: querer — he wants (present 3rd sg.; non lo quiere comer 'he will not eat it'; = quiere) · also 'is about to' (el março quiere entrar 'March is about to come in')
glossary.sosañava: sosañar — he was scorning, mocking (imperfect 3rd sg.; a todos los sosañava 'he looked down on them all'; = despreciaba, desdeñaba)
glossary.combré: comer — I shall eat (future 1st sg. comré with epenthetic b; non combré un bocado 'I will not eat a morsel'; = comeré)
glossary.perderé: perder — I shall lose, let go (future 1st sg.; antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body'; = perderé)
glossary.cuerpo: cuerpo — body (= cuerpo; perder el cuerpo 'to lose one's life')
glossary.dexaré: dexar — I shall leave, give up (future 1st sg.; dexaré el alma 'I shall give up the soul'; = dejaré)
glossary.tales: tal — such (pl., both genders; tales malcalçados 'such ill-shod men'; = tales)
glossary.malcalçados: malcalçado — badly shod (adj. as noun, masc. pl., mal + calçado; a sneer at the Çid's men; Pidal notes that malcalzado was used as a nickname; = malcalzados)
glossary.vençieron: vençer — they defeated (preterite 3rd pl.; me vençieron de batalla 'defeated me in battle'; = vencieron)
glossary.comed: comer — eat! (imperative 2nd pl., -ed; comed, conde 'eat, count'; = comed)
glossary.deste: de + este — of this, from this (contraction; deste pan 'of this bread', partitive 'some of'; = de este)
glossary.saldredes: salir — you will go out, get out (future 2nd pl., syncopated salré with a d slipped in, old -edes ending; saldredes de cativo 'you will come out of captivity'; = saldréis)
glossary.cativo: cativo — captive, captivity (saldredes de cativo 'you will come out of captivity'; = cautivo)
glossary.veredes: ver — you will see (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = veréis)
glossary.comede: comer — eat! (imperative 2nd pl., variant of comed with a final -e; = comed)
glossary.penssedes: pensar — set about, see to (present subjunctive 2nd pl. as a polite command; penssedes de folgar 'take your rest', Pidal 'descansad, estad tranquilo'; = penséis)
glossary.folgar: folgar — to rest, take ease (infinitive; = holgar)
glossary.mê: me + he — me + I shall (circumflex marks the contraction, as lâ, lês; dexar mê morir = dexar me he morir, split future 'I shall let myself die')
glossary.partiendo: partir — dividing, sharing out (gerund; partiendo estas ganançias 'sharing out this booty'; = repartiendo) · also partirse 'to depart, part' (yas ivan partiendo 'now they were departing')
glossary.muesso: muesso — mouthful, bite (Latin morsus; un muesso de pan 'a morsel of bread'; = bocado)
glossary.comedes: comer — you eat (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; si non comedes 'if you do not eat'; = coméis)
glossary.comiéredes: comer — (if) you eat (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = comiereis)
glossary.fijos: fijo — son (masc. pl.; fijos dalgo 'sons of something', noblemen; = hijos) · also fijos — children, sons and daughters together (los yernos e las fijas todos vuestros fijos son)
glossary.quitarvos: quitar + vos — to free you (infinitive + enclitic vos; first part of split future quitarvos e '(I) shall free you', e = he; = os libraré)
glossary.biva: bivir — may live (present subjunctive 1st sg., same form as 3rd; tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live'; = viva)
glossary.maravillado: maravillar — astonished, amazed (past part.; seré dent maravillado 'I shall be amazed at it'; = maravillado)
glossary.fóredes: seer — (when) you shall be (future subjunctive 2nd pl. of ser, Pidal's [ó]; quando fóredes yantado 'when you have dined'; = fuereis) · also ir — you go (future subjunctive 2nd pl., same form as ser; quando vos los fóredes ferir 'when you go to strike them'; = fuereis, vayáis)
glossary.yantado: yantar — dined, having eaten (past part.; = comido; yantar 'to dine')
glossary.perdido: perder — lost (past part.; quanto avedes perdido 'all that you have lost'; = perdido)
glossary.canpo: canpo — field, battlefield (en canpo 'in the field, in battle'; = campo)
glossary.ello: ello — it (neuter pronoun; de ello 'of it'; = ello)
glossary.comigo: comigo — with me (con + migo, Latin mecum; = conmigo)
glossary.lazrados: lazrado — suffering, toiling, in hardship (past part. of lazrar used as adj., masc. pl.; = lacerados, 'hard-pressed')
glossary.pagando: pagar — paying, satisfying (gerund; ir nos hemos pagando 'we shall go on paying ourselves', taking our pay from what we seize; = pagando)
glossary.ploguiere: plazer — (as long as) it may please (future subjunctive 3rd sg., strong; mientra ploguiere al Padre 'as long as it please the Father'; si vos ploguiere 'if it please you'; = pluguiere)
glossary.santo: santo — holy, saint (masc. sg.; el Padre santo 'the holy Father', God)
glossary.pidió: pedir — he asked for (preterite 3rd sg.; pidió agua 'asked for water'; = pidió)
glossary.tiénengelo: tener + ge + lo — they hold it out to him (tienen 3rd pl. present + enclitic ge, = le before lo, + lo; = se lo tienen; 'they hold it before him')
glossary.diérongelo: dar + ge + lo — they gave it to him (preterite 3rd pl., strong, dieron + ge (= le) + lo; = se lo dieron)
glossary.comiendo: comer — eating (gerund; comiendo va 'he goes on eating'; = comiendo)
glossary.sobrél: sobre + él — over him, beside him (preposition + pronoun, the e of sobre dropped; sobrél sedie 'he sat beside him', Pidal 'junto a él estaba')
glossary.sedie: seer — he was sitting, he sat (imperfect 3rd sg. of seer 'to sit', unaccented -ie; = estaba sentado) · also seer — he was, kept (doing) (imperfect 3rd sg. as auxiliary/copula; Hinojos fitos sedie 'he was on bended knees'; catándol sedie 'he kept gazing at him'; = estaba)
glossary.partiremos: partir — we shall part (future 1st pl.; with nos, no nos partiremos 'we shall not part'; = nos separaremos)
glossary.yantando: yantar — dining, eating (gerund; apriessa va yantando 'goes on dining in haste'; = comiendo)
glossary.aguardando: aguardar — watching, waiting for (gerund; lo está aguardando 'is watching him'; = aguardando)
glossary.bolvie: bolver — he was turning, plying (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', i.e. eat busily; = volvía)
glossary.guisados: guisar — made ready, prepared (past part. masc. pl.; de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go'; = dispuestos)
glossary.mandadnos: mandar + nos — order for us, bid (imperative 2nd pl. mandad + enclitic nos; mandadnos dar 'have given to us'; = mandadnos)
glossary.bestias: bestia — beast, mount (fem. pl.; riding/pack animals; = bestias) · also bestia — wild beast (bestias fieras 'wild beasts', las bestias de la fiera guisa 'the savage beasts')
glossary.dend: dend — of it, from it (variant of dent, de + ent; = de ello); in dend e the e is he 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the pleasure I have of it')
glossary.danles: dar + les — they give them (dan 3rd pl. present + enclitic les; Pidal danle[s]; = les dan)
glossary.palafrés: palafré — palfrey, riding horse (pl.; a gentle horse for ordinary riding rather than war; = palafrenes)
glossary.ensellados: ensellar — saddled (past part. masc. pl.; = ensillados)
glossary.pelliçones: pelliçón — fur robe, pelisse (masc. pl.; a fur-lined garment; = pellizas)
glossary.escurriólos: escurrir + los — he saw them off (preterite 3rd sg. escurrió + enclitic los; Pidal 'los salió a despedir', 'went out to see them off'; = los despidió)
glossary.franco: franco — free, exempt; also a Frank, i.e. a Catalan (adj. and noun; a guisa de muy franco, Pidal's 'juego de palabras' on the two senses 'catalán' and 'libre, exento'; = franco)
glossary.tengo: tener — I hold (present 1st sg.; en grado vos lo tengo 'I hold it to you in thanks', I am grateful; = tengo) · also tener que — 'I think that' (tengo que vos avrá pro 'I think he will be of use to you'; = creo que)
glossary.viniere: venir — (if) it come (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si vos viniere emiente 'if it come to your mind'; = viniere)
glossary.emiente: emiente — memory, thought (noun, Pidal 'recuerdo, idea'; venir emiente 'to come to mind'; from Latin in mente)
glossary.vengallo: vengar + lo — to avenge it (infinitive + enclitic lo, -rl- > -ll-; = vengarlo)
glossary.viniéredes: venir — (if) you come (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; si me viniéredes buscar 'if you come to seek me'; = viniereis)
glossary.dexaredes: dexar — you will leave (future 2nd pl.; o me dexaredes de lo vuestro 'either you will leave me some of what is yours'; = dejaréis)
glossary.levaredes: levar — you will carry off (future 2nd pl.; = llevaréis)
glossary.folguedes: folgar — rest, take your ease (2nd pl. polite imperative/present subjunctive; = holguéis, holgad)
glossary.venirvos: venir + vos — to come (to) you (infinitive + enclitic vos, which belongs to the following buscar: venirvos buscar 'to come to seek you'; = venir a buscaros)
