glossary.penssado: pensar — thought of, considered (past part.; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of'; impersonal; = pensado)
glossary.aguijaba: aguijar — he spurred on, rode hard (imperfect 3rd sg.; = aguijaba)
glossary.penssava: pensar — he set about (imperfect 3rd sg.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; penssava de andar 'set off on his way'; = pensaba)
glossary.catándos: catar + se — looking, glancing (gerund catando + se, with -se shortened to -s; catándos atrás 'looking back'; = mirándose)
glossary.aviendo: aver — having (gerund; miedo iva aviendo 'he went on having fear'; = habiendo)
glossary.repintrá: repentir — he will repent, change his mind (future 3rd sg., syncopated: repentirá > repintrá; reflexive with se, se repintrá; = se arrepentirá)
glossary.ferié: fazer — he would do (conditional 3rd sg. in -ié on the short stem fer-, as feremos; lo que non ferié 'which he would not do'; = haría)
glossary.juntós: juntar + se — he joined (preterite 3rd sg. juntó + -s(e); juntós con sus mesnadas 'joined his troops'; = se juntó)
glossary.conpeçós: conpeçar + se — he began (preterite 3rd sg. conpeçó + -s(e); conpeçós de alegrar 'he began to rejoice', the se belonging in sense to alegrar; = comenzó a alegrarse)
glossary.alegrar: alegrar — to rejoice (infinitive, reflexive sense 'rejoice, be glad', the se carried by conpeçós; = alegrarse)
glossary.aquis: aquí + se — here (aquí with the se of the following verb glued on as -s; Aquis conpieça 'here begins'; = aquí se comienza)
glossary.conpieça: començar — it begins (present 3rd sg., diphthongized -ie- stem; Aquis conpieça la gesta 'here begins the tale'; = comienza)
glossary.gesta: gesta — deed, tale of deeds, the poem itself (Latin gesta; la gesta de mio Çid 'the story of the Cid's deeds'; = gesta, as in cantar de gesta)
glossary.ducá: ducá — uncertain: in a las tierras ducá probably d'acá 'of this side, hereabouts' (de + acá), possibly a place or district name; no secure modern equivalent
glossary.mar: mar — sea (here fem., la mar salada; = mar, now usually masc.)
glossary.salada: salado — salt, salty (fem.; la mar salada 'the salt sea', the Mediterranean; = salada)
glossary.guerrear: guerrear — to make war, wage war (infinitive; conpeçó de guerrear 'he began to make war'; = guerrear)
glossary.orient: orient — east (apocopated; a orient 'to the east'; = oriente)
glossary.exe: exir — it goes out, rises (present 3rd sg.; exe el sol 'the sun rises'; = sale)
glossary.xérica: Xérica — Jérica, a town on the river Palancia in Castellón, north of Murviedro (= Jérica)
glossary.onda: Onda — a town in Castellón province, inland from Burriana (= Onda)
glossary.almenar: Almenar — Almenara, a town with a castle on the coast of Castellón, near Murviedro (= Almenara)
glossary.borriana: Borriana — Burriana, a coastal town in Castellón province (= Burriana)
glossary.conquistas: conquerir — conquered (old short past part. conquisto, fem. pl., agreeing with tierras and the object las; todas conquistas las ha 'he has conquered them all'; = conquistadas)
glossary.ayudól: ayudar + le — helped him (ayudó, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic l(e); Ayudól el Criador 'the Creator helped him'; = le ayudó)
glossary.murviedro: Murviedro — a walled town near the coast north of Valencia, the old name of Sagunto (Latin muri veteres; = Sagunto)
glossary.vidíe: veer — he saw, he was seeing (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe ending, Pidal's vi[d]íe; ya vidíe que Dios le iva valiendo 'he now saw that God was helping him'; = veía)
glossary.valiendo: valer — helping, aiding (gerund; iva valiendo 'was helping'; = valiendo, ayudando)
glossary.viniessen: venir — (that) they come (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; quel viniessen çercar 'that they come to besiege him'; = viniesen)
glossary.trasnocharon: trasnochar — they travelled through the night (preterite 3rd pl.; Trasnocharon de noch 'they rode all night'; = trasnocharon)
glossary.alva: alva — dawn (al alva de la man 'at dawn of the morning'; = alba)
glossary.viólo: veer + lo — he saw it (vio, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic lo; Viólo mio Çid 'the Cid saw it'; = lo vio)
glossary.tomós: tomar + se — he took to, began (tomó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s; tomarse a + inf. 'to set to, begin': tomós a maravillar 'he fell to marvelling'; = se puso a)
glossary.maravillar: maravillar — to marvel, wonder (infinitive; tomós a maravillar 'he set to wondering'; = maravillarse)
glossary.femosles: fazer + les — we do to them (femos, present 1st pl., the contracted form of fazemos, + enclitic les 'to them'; femosles tod mal 'we do them all harm'; = les hacemos)
glossary.bevemos: bever — we drink (present 1st pl.; bevemos so vino 'we drink their wine'; = bebemos)
glossary.comemos: comer — we eat (present 1st pl.; comemos el so pan 'we eat their bread'; = comemos)
glossary.partirá: partir — it will settle, resolve (future 3rd sg.; aquesto nos partirá 'this will be settled for us'; = resolverá; sense uncertain, perhaps 'will part, divide' our case)
glossary.vayan: ir — let them go (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; vayan los mandados 'let the messages go'; = vayan)
glossary.deven: dever — they ought, must (present 3rd pl.; los que nos deven ayudar 'those who must help us'; = deben)
glossary.alucad: Alucad — variant spelling of Alucat, the mountain pass and place (see alucat; the d for t)
glossary.vengan: venir — let them come (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; vengan acá 'let them come here'; = vengan)
glossary.conpeçaremos: començar — we shall begin (future 1st pl.; conpeçaremos aquesta lid 'we shall begin this battle'; = comenzaremos)
glossary.fío: fiar — I trust (present 1st sg.; fiar por Dios 'to trust in God'; yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God'; = confío)
glossary.eñadrán: eñadir (= añadir) — they will add, increase (future 3rd pl., syncopated: eñadirán > eñadrán; eñadir en algo 'to increase something': en nuestro pro eñadrán, Pidal 'aumentarán nuestro provecho'; = añadirán)
glossary.s: se — himself, themselves (reflexive pronoun cut to s’ before a vowel; juntados s’[a]n = se han juntado 'they have gathered'; = se) · also s' = si 'if' (s' yo bivo so 'if I am alive'; = si)
glossary.compeçó: començar — he began (preterite 3rd sg., spelled with m; compeçó de fablar 'he began to speak'; = comenzó)
glossary.salve: salvar — may he save (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; sí el Criador vos salve 'so may the Creator save you'; = salve)
glossary.partiemos: partir — we parted, left (preterite 1st pl., old -iemos ending; nos partiemos 'we departed', with reflexive nos; = partimos, nos fuimos)
glossary.linpia: linpio — clean, pure (fem.; la linpia cristiandad 'pure Christendom'; = limpia)
glossary.ni: ni — nor, not even (continues the negative; non fo a nuestro grado ni nos non pudiemos mas 'it was not to our liking, nor could we do otherwise'; = ni)
glossary.pudiemos: poder — we could (strong preterite 1st pl., old -iemos ending; non pudiemos mas 'we could do no more'; = pudimos)
glossary.çercados: çercar — besieged, surrounded (past part. masc. pl.; çercados nos han 'they have besieged us'; = cercados)
glossary.quisiéremos: querer — (if) we shall wish (future subjunctive 1st pl.; si quisiéremos durar 'if we wish to stay on'; = quisiéremos, tense obsolete, now si queremos)
glossary.durar: durar — to last, stay on, hold out (infinitive; si en estas tierras quisiéremos durar 'if we wish to remain in these lands'; = durar, permanecer)
glossary.escarmentar: escarmentar — to chastise, punish (infinitive; son estos a escarmentar 'these are to be punished', a + inf. with passive sense; = escarmentar)
glossary.venga: venir — let it come (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; venga la mañana 'let morning come'; = venga)
glossary.aparejados: aparejar — made ready, prepared (past part. masc. pl.; aparejados me seed 'be ready for me'; = aparejados, now preparados)
glossary.pareçrá: parecer — will appear, will show (future 3rd sg., syncopated pareçrá for pareçerá; allí pareçrá el que mereçe la soldada 'there will show himself the man who deserves his pay'; = parecerá)
glossary.mereçe: merecer — he deserves, earns (present 3rd sg.; el que mereçe la soldada 'he who earns his pay'; = merece)
glossary.fagamos: fazer — let us do (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; fagamos lo que a vos plaze 'let us do what pleases you'; = hagamos)
glossary.pido: pedir — I ask (present 1st sg.; que non vos pido más 'for I ask no more of you'; = pido)
glossary.firádeslos: ferir + los — you are to strike them (firades, present subjunctive 2nd pl. of ferir used as a command, old -ádes ending, + enclitic los; = que los hiráis, heridlos)
glossary.ferredes: ferir — you will strike (future 2nd pl., syncopated: feriredes > ferredes; bien los ferredes 'you will strike them hard', Pidal 'heriréis'; = heriréis)
glossary.quis: quis — each (Latin quisque, reinforcing cada uno; quis cada uno dellos 'each one of them'; no modern equivalent, = cada; uncertain)
glossary.alvores: alvor — dawn, first light (masc., usually pl.; con los alvores 'at daybreak'; = albores, alba)
glossary.ferirlos: ferir + los — to strike them (infinitive + enclitic los; ferirlos va 'he goes to strike them', ir + infinitive; = ir a herirlos)
glossary.apostol: apostol — apostle (d'apostol santi Yague 'of the apostle St James'; = apóstol)
glossary.yague: Yague — James (Latin Iacobus; santi Yague 'Saint James', the apostle, Spain's patron; = Santiago)
glossary.cuerda: cuerda — rope, cord (tanta cuerda de tienda 'so many a tent-rope'; = cuerda)
glossary.arrancarse: arrancar + se — to be pulled up, torn out (infinitive + reflexive se; arrancarse las estacas 'the pegs being torn up'; = arrancarse)
glossary.acostarse: acostar + se — to lean over, tilt, fall (infinitive + reflexive se; acostarse a todas partes los tendales 'the tent-poles leaning over on every side', Pidal 'ladearse, caerse'; = ladearse; not modern acostarse 'to lie down, go to bed')
glossary.tendales: tendal — tent-pole (pl.; Pidal: 'los postes sobre que están armadas las tiendas'; acostarse los tendales 'the tent-poles lean over and fall'; = postes de la tienda)
glossary.reconbrar: reconbrar — to recover, regain one's footing, rally (infinitive; Pidal 'recobrar'; ya quieren reconbrar 'now they try to recover'; = recobrar)
glossary.entróles: entrar + les — he fell on them (entró, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic les 'on them'; entróles Álbar Fáñez 'Álvar Fáñez fell upon them'; = les entró, los atacó)
glossary.oviéronse: aver + se — they had to (ovieron, strong preterite 3rd pl. of aver, + reflexive se; aver a + inf. 'to have to': oviéronse a dar e a arrancar 'they had to give in and be routed'; = hubieron de)
glossary.arrancar: arrancar — to drive off, rout (infinitive; a arrancar 'to be routed', passive-reflexive sense, cf. arrancada 'rout'; = ser derrotado, ahuyentado; modern arrancar 'to pull up, start') · also arrancar la lid — to win the battle, drive the foe from the field, active (yo la he de arrancar 'I must win it'; = ganar) · also arrancar + object — to rout, defeat (active; arrancar me los trevo 'I dare to rout them', Pidal 'me atrevo a vencerlos')
glossary.ques: que + se — who ... themselves (que, relative pronoun, + reflexive se; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who managed to escape'; = los que se pudieron escapar) · also ques — qué + se, 'what … to' (interrogative que + se; non sabent ques far 'they know not what to do', as qué se far at v. 1155; no note in Pidal; = qué hacer) · also fata ques torne 'until he returns' (conjunction fata que + reflexive se; = hasta que se vuelva) · also ques — que + se, conjunction 'that' + reflexive (que otro dia … ques tornasse cada uno 'that next day … each should return'; = que se) · also ques — que + se, optative 'may' (d' aqueste casamiento que[s] grade el Campeador 'may the Campeador be pleased with this marriage'; = que se)
glossary.pudieron: poder — they could, managed to (strong preterite 3rd pl.; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who were able to escape'; = pudieron)
glossary.fechas: fazer — made, done (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with ganançias; las ganançias que mio Çid fechas ha 'the booty the Cid has made'; = hechas)
glossary.robavan: robar — they were plundering (imperfect 3rd pl.; robavan el campo 'they stripped the field'; = robaban)
glossary.çebolla: Çebolla — Cebolla, today el Puig, a hill-town some 18 km north of Valencia, taken by the Cid in 1093 (Pidal: a popular etymology of the vulgar Arabic diminutive jubayla 'little hill'; = el Puig)
glossary.sonando: sonar — sounding, ringing out, being spoken of (gerund; sonando van 'keep ringing out', ir + gerund, of his fame; = sonando)
glossary.alent: alent — beyond, on the far side of (apocopated allende; alent parte del mar 'beyond the sea'; = allende, allá de)
glossary.andon: andon — uncertain: printed in italics (a supplied word, no footnote in Pidal); the sense is probably 'they go about, spread' (a form of andar), or an adverb; no secure modern equivalent
glossary.ayudara: ayudar — he had helped (-ra form in its old pluperfect sense, 3rd sg.; que Dios le ayudara 'that God had helped him'; = había ayudado)
glossary.fiziera: fazer — he had made, done (-ra pluperfect, 3rd sg.; fiziera esta arrancada 'had brought about this rout'; = había hecho)
glossary.corredores: corredor — raider, outrider sent out to scour the country (masc. pl.; davan sus corredores 'he sent out his raiders'; = corredores, closest 'exploradores, incursores') · also corredor — swift, fast-running (adjective, of horses; cavallos gruessos e corredores 'stout, swift horses'; = veloces)
glossary.fazien: fazer — they were making, doing (imperfect 3rd pl.; fazien las trasnochadas 'they made the night-rides'; = hacían)
glossary.trasnochadas: trasnochada — night-ride, night march, raid by night (fem. pl.; fazien las trasnochadas; closest modern 'correrías nocturnas'; cf. trasnochar)
glossary.gujera: Gujera — Cullera, a coastal town and castle at the mouth of the Júcar south of Valencia (Pidal: Gujera is the Castilian-j pronunciation of Valencian Cullera; = Cullera)
glossary.xátiva: Xátiva — Játiva (Xàtiva), a town south-west of Valencia inland from Cullera (= Játiva)
glossary.ayusso: ayuso — down, farther down, i.e. farther south (adverb, Latin deorsum; aun mas ayusso 'still farther down'; = abajo; ayuso survives only as a literary archaism)
glossary.denia: Denia — a coastal town in Alicante province, south of Valencia (Pidal: Denia la casa 'the town of Denia'; = Denia)
glossary.quebranta: quebrantar — he breaks, ravages, lays waste (present 3rd sg., historic present; firme la quebranta 'he ravages it thoroughly'; = quebranta)
glossary.ganaron: ganar — they took, captured (preterite 3rd pl.; ganaron Peña Cadiella 'they captured Peña Cadiella'; = ganaron)
glossary.peña: peña — rock, crag (Peña Cadiella 'the rock of Cadiella'; = peña)
glossary.cadiella: Cadiella — second element of Peña Cadiella, the modern sierra de Benicadell on the Valencia/Alicante border (Pidal: Pennacatel, Peñacadell; the Cid rebuilt its castle in 1092; = Benicadell)
glossary.exidas: exida — way out, exit, sally (fem. pl., from exir; las exidas e las entradas 'the ways out and the ways in', i.e. the passes; = salidas)
glossary.entradas: entrada — way in, entrance, approach (fem. pl.; las exidas e las entradas; = entradas)
glossary.dolor: dolor — grief, pain, distress (masc.; el dolor de Valençia 'the distress of Valencia'; = dolor)
glossary.ganando: ganar — taking, winning (gerund; prendiendo e ganando 'seizing and taking'; = ganando)
glossary.durmiendo: dormir — sleeping (gerund; durmiendo los días 'sleeping by day'; = durmiendo)
glossary.tranochando: tranochar — riding through the night, going without sleep (gerund, variant of trasnochar; las noches tranochando 'riding at night'; = trasnochando)
glossary.villas: villa — town (fem. pl.; ganar aquellas villas 'to take those towns'; = villas)
glossary.escarmentados: escarmentar — taught a lesson, chastened, punished (past part. masc. pl., with han as perfect auxiliary; escarmentados los han 'they have taught them a lesson'; = escarmentados)
glossary.fueras: fueras — outside, out of doors (adverb, = fuera; fueras exir 'go outside'; = fuera, afuera)
glossary.tajávales: tajar + les — he cut down, he used to cut (imperfect 3rd sg., enclitic les 'to/against them'; tajávales las huertas 'he cut down their orchards'; = les talaba)
glossary.huertas: huerta — irrigated garden land, orchard (fem. pl.; = huertas)
glossary.fazíales: fazer + les — he did to them, he was doing (imperfect 3rd sg., enclitic les; fazíales grand mal 'did them great harm'; = les hacía)
glossary.destos: de + estos — of these (contraction; en cada uno destos años 'in each one of these years'; = de estos)
glossary.tollió: toller — he took away (preterite 3rd sg., -ió; Latin tollere; les tollió el pan 'took the bread from them'; = quitó)
glossary.aquexan: aquexar — they are hard pressed, distressed (se aquexan, reflexive, present 3rd pl.; mal se aquexan 'they are sorely pressed'; = se apuran, se afligen; modern aquejarse has shifted to 'to complain')
glossary.sabent: saber — they know (present 3rd pl., -ent form; non sabent ques far 'they do not know what to do'; = saben)
glossary.viníe: venir — it was coming, came (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe; non les viníe pan 'no bread came to them'; = venía)
glossary.da: dar — he gives (present 3rd sg.; nin da conssejo padre a fijo 'neither does father give help to son'; = da)
glossary.conssejo: conssejo — help, remedy (spelling variant of consejo; Pidal 'amparo, socorro'; = consejo) · also conssejo — council, deliberation (fablando en so conssejo 'talking in their council'; = consejo) · also conssejo — counsel, advice (con vuestro conssejo 'with your counsel'; = consejo)
glossary.fijo: fijo — son (masc. sg., Latin filius; a fijo 'to a son'; = hijo)
glossary.consolar: consolar — to console, comfort (infinitive; nos pueden consolar 'they can comfort one another'; = consolar)
glossary.señores: señor — lords, sirs (masc. pl., vocative; señores, as the poet's address to his audience; = señores)
glossary.murir: murir — to die (infinitive, with u for o in the stem; veer los murir 'to see them die'; = morir)
glossary.fanbre: fanbre — hunger, famine (fem.; murir de fanbre 'die of hunger'; = hambre, with f- kept)
glossary.veyen: veer — they saw, were seeing (imperfect 3rd pl., veyen = veíen, the y a glide between the vowels; delante veyen so duelo 'they saw their grief before them'; = veían)
glossary.huviar: huviar — to help, come to the aid of (infinitive; nin los vino huviar 'nor did he come to help them', Pidal 'ni les vino a ayudar'; = ayudar, socorrer)
glossary.marruecos: Marruecos — Morocco (rey de Marruecos 'the king of Morocco', i.e. the Almoravid ruler; = Marruecos)
glossary.montes: monte — mountain (masc. pl.; los Montes Claros; = montes) · also monte — wood, wooded upland (los montes son altos 'the woods are high'; en estos fieros montes 'in these wild woods')
glossary.claros: claro — clear, bright (adjective masc. pl.; Montes Claros: Pidal, an old name of the Atlas range, the poet anachronistically meaning the Almohad leader, whom he sets at war with the king of Morocco; = claros)
glossary.avíe: aver — he had, was having (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe; avíe guerra tan grand 'he was engaged in so great a war'; = tenía, había)
glossary.sópolo: saber + lo — he learned it, got to know it (strong preterite 3rd sg. sopo + enclitic lo; Sópolo mio Çid 'the Cid heard of it'; = lo supo)
glossary.amaneció: amanecer — it dawned, day broke (preterite 3rd sg.; amaneció a mio Çid en tierras de Mon Real 'day broke on the Cid in the lands of Mon Real'; = amaneció, here with the Cid as dative)
glossary.mon: mon — mount (apocopated mont, = monte; first element of Mon Real); Pidal gives no note here, but in his note on Mont Real at vv. 862–864 he identifies it as Monreal del Campo (Teruel), presumably the same place
glossary.navarra: Navarra — Navarre (por Aragón e por Navarra 'through Aragon and Navarre'; = Navarra)
glossary.pregón: pregón — public proclamation, crier's call (masc.; pregón mandó echar 'he ordered a proclamation to be made'; = pregón)
glossary.menssajes: menssaje — message, or the messenger who carries it (masc. pl.; enbió sos menssajes 'sent his messages'; = mensajes, mensajeros)
glossary.perder: perder — to lose, be rid of (infinitive; perder cueta 'to lose one's distress, escape want'; = perder)
glossary.rritad: rritad — uncertain: no note in Pidal; most likely a noun made on rico, 'riches, wealth' (venir a rritad 'come to riches'), set against cueta 'distress'; rr- the old spelling of initial r; = riqueza (if so)
glossary.viniesse: venir — let him come, (that he) come (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. used as an indirect command; viniesse a mio Çid 'let him come to the Cid'; = viniese)
glossary.premia: premia — compulsion, constraint (noun; ninguno non ha premia 'no one is under compulsion'; = apremio, coacción)
glossary.speraré: esperar — I will wait for (future 1st sg., with e- lost; tres días le speraré 'I shall wait three days for him'; = esperaré)
glossary.tornávas: tornar + se — he went back, returned (imperfect 3rd sg. tornava + -s(e); Tornávas a Murviedro 'he went back to Murviedro'; = se tornaba, se volvía)
glossary.ganada: ganar — taken, won (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with the object la; ganada se la a 'he has taken it for himself'; = ganada)
glossary.detardar: detardar — to delay, put off (infinitive; non lo quiso detardar 'he would not put it off'; = tardar, demorar)
glossary.creçiendo: creçer — growing (gerund; creçiendo va riqueza 'wealth keeps growing'; ir + gerund; = creciendo)
glossary.compeçós: conpeçar + se — he began (preterite 3rd sg. + -s(e); compeçós de pagar 'he began to be pleased', conpeçar de + inf.; pagarse here 'to be pleased, satisfied'; = comenzó a, se puso a)
glossary.sobrellas: sobre + ellas — upon them (fem. pl.; sobrellas va echar 'he goes to cast himself upon them', i.e. to lay siege; the antecedent of ellas is not clear, perhaps Valencia and its lands; uncertain; cf. sobrella)
glossary.avía: aver — there was, it had (imperfect 3rd sg.; que non i avía hart 'for there was no flaw in it'; = había) · also avía — I had (imperfect 1st sg.; por sabor que avía 'out of the longing I had'; = tenía)
glossary.hart: hart — uncertain: Pidal's note on this line reads it as art, 'trick, flaw, loophole' (sin art 'without deceit', then 'perfectly'; 'non i avía art' = 'there was no defect', the siege was perfect); = arte, closest 'falla, resquicio'
glossary.viédales: vedar + les — he forbids them, bars them (present 3rd sg., diphthongized, historic present; viédales exir e viédales entrar 'he barred them from going out and coming in'; = les veda)
glossary.meses: mes — month (masc. pl.; nueve meses complidos 'nine full months'; = meses)
glossary.complidos: complido — full, complete, finished (past part. of complir, masc. pl.; nueve meses complidos 'nine months full'; = cumplidos)
glossary.yaz: yazer — he lies, lay (encamped) (present 3rd sg., historic present; sobrella yaz 'lay before it'; = yace)
glossary.dezeno: dezeno — tenth (ordinal; el dezeno [mes] 'the tenth month'; = décimo)
glossary.oviérongela: aver + gela — they had to give it to him (ovieron, preterite 3rd pl., + gela = ge 'to him' + la 'it'; oviérongela a dar, aver a + inf. 'to have to'; = tuvieron que dársela)
glossary.gozos: gozo — joy, rejoicing (masc. pl.; grandes son los gozos 'great is the rejoicing'; = gozos)
glossary.çibdad: çibdad — city (fem.; entró en la çibdad 'entered the city'; = ciudad)
glossary.podrie: poder — he could, would be able (conditional 3rd sg., -ie; ¿quien vos lo podrie contar? 'who could tell it to you?'; = podría)
glossary.cabdal: cabdal — chief, principal (adjective; seña cabdal 'the chief banner'; = caudal as 'principal', now mainly a noun 'wealth, flow') · also cabdal — principal, capital sum (noun; que nos diesse el cabdal 'that he give us the principal'; = caudal)
glossary.sedié: seer — it was set, stood (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; seer 'to sit, be', Latin sedere; sedié en somo del alcáçer 'stood on top of the citadel'; = estaba)
glossary.alcáçer: alcáçer — citadel, fortress (Arabic al-qaṣr; en somo del alcáçer 'on top of the citadel'; = alcázar)
glossary.folgava: folgar — he was resting, taking his ease (imperfect 3rd sg.; = holgaba; modern holgar 'to rest, be idle')
glossary.âquel: a + aquel — to that (preposition a + demonstrative aquel, run together; Pidal prints â with a circumflex and gives no note; âquel rey 'to that king', the one the news came to; = a aquel)
glossary.sevilla: Sevilla — Seville; from 1091 held by the Almoravids, so rey de Sevilla is the Almoravid general who governed it (Pidal's note to v. 1222; = Sevilla)
glossary.enparan: enparar — they defend, protect (present 3rd pl.; non gela enparan 'they do not hold it against him', i.e. the Moors no longer defend Valencia against the Çid; whose 'him' is meant is uncertain; = amparan)
glossary.aprés: aprés — near, close by (preposition, with de; aprés de la uerta 'close by the orchard-land'; no modern form, = cerca de, junto a)
glossary.uerta: uerta — irrigated orchard-land, here the plain round Valencia (= huerta, spelled without h)
glossary.arrancólos: arrancar + los — he routed them (preterite 3rd sg. arrancó + enclitic los; = los arrancó, 'los derrotó, los hizo huir')
glossary.luenga: luengo — long (fem. sg., Latin longus; la luenga barba 'the long beard'; modern luengo survives only archaically, = larga)
glossary.xúcar: Xúcar — the river Júcar, south of Valencia (= Júcar; x = sh-sound)
glossary.veriédes: veer — you would see (conditional 2nd pl., old -iédes ending; = veríais; the minstrel's aside to the audience)
glossary.barata: barata — apparently 'turmoil, confusion, a scramble' (i veriédes barata 'there you would have seen a scramble'); the word otherwise means a dealing, a bargain; no note in Pidal; sense uncertain
glossary.arruenço: arruenço — (en arruenço) drifting, floundering; Pidal glosses the line 'los moros ronceando (a la ronza contra la corriente) bebían agua sin querer', 'the Moors, drifting against the current, drank water unwillingly'; Pidal restores the first r; no modern form; exact sense uncertain
glossary.escapa: escapar — he escapes, gets away (present 3rd sg.; = escapa)
glossary.provechosa: provechoso — profitable, advantageous (fem. sg.; mas mucho fue provechosa 'was more profitable'; = provechosa)
glossary.menores: menor — lesser (masc. pl.; los menores 'the lesser men', apparently the rank and file; no note in Pidal; = menores)
glossary.cayeron: caer — they fell (preterite 3rd pl.; cayeron çient marcos 'a hundred marks fell to them', i.e. came to each one's share; = cayeron)
glossary.allongando: allongar — lengthening, growing longer (gerund; = alongando; modern alongar is rare, closest alargando, alargar)
glossary.dixera: dezir — he had said (-ra form in its old pluperfect sense, 3rd sg.; ca dixera 'for he had said'; = había dicho, modern dijera)
glossary.atanto: atanto — to such a degree, so, thus (a + tanto; de la su boca atanto 'from his own mouth, just so', introducing the oath; sense inferred, no note in Pidal; modern tanto)
glossary.alffonsso: Alffonsso — Alfonso VI, king of León and Castile who exiled the Cid (= Alfonso)
glossary.entrarié: entrar — it would enter (conditional 3rd sg., -ié ending; nin entrarié en ella tigera 'nor would shears touch it'; = entraría)
glossary.tigera: tigera — scissors, shears (fem. sg., Latin tonsoria; = tijera, modern normally pl. tijeras)
glossary.tajado: tajar — cut (past part. masc. sg.; avrié tajado 'he would have cut'; = tajado, closest cortado; modern tajar 'to slice')
glossary.fablassen: fablar — they should speak, might speak (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., e que fablassen desto 'and that they should talk of it'; = hablasen)
glossary.folgando: folgar — resting, taking ease (gerund; está folgando 'is resting'; = holgando)
glossary.exieron: exir — they went out, left (preterite 3rd pl.; = salieron; no modern exir)
glossary.ritad: ritad — uncertain: no note in Pidal; most likely a noun made on rico, 'riches, wealth' (de ritad son abondados 'they are abounding in wealth'), like rictad (v. 688, Pidal 'riqueza') and rritad (v. 1189); = riqueza (if so)
glossary.abondados: abondar — provided, enriched, supplied in abundance (past part. masc. pl., with son; = abastecidos, abundantes; modern abundar 'to abound')
glossary.provando: provar — trying, putting to the test, experiencing (gerund; ivan provando 'were coming to experience'; = probando)
glossary.veelo: veer + lo — he sees it (present 3rd sg. vee + enclitic lo; veelo mio Çid que … 'the Cid sees it, that …'; = lo ve)
glossary.tomados: tomar — taken (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with averes; los averes que avién tomados 'the goods they had taken'; = tomados)
glossary.sis: si + se — if … themselves (conjunction si + reflexive se; que sis pudiessen ir 'that if they could go away'; = si se) · also si + se — whether … (si 'whether' with se of interest; non sé sis abrá sabor 'I do not know whether he will like it')
glossary.pudiessen: poder — they could, were able (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; = pudiesen)
glossary.conssejado: consejar — advised, counselled (past part. masc. sg.; Minaya lo ovo conssejado 'Minaya had advised it'; = aconsejado)
glossary.ningún: ninguno — no, any (apocopated masc. sg. before a noun; ningún omne 'no man'; = ningún)
glossary.spidiés: espedir(se) — (that) he should take leave (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., espidiesse with its final -e lost (-sse > -s) and its e- dropped; ques le non spidiés = que + se + le + non + spidiés 'who should not take leave of him'; = se despidiese, despedirse)
glossary.besás: besar — (that) he should kiss (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., besasse with -se lost; o nol besás la mano 'or kiss not his hand', the formal leave-taking; = besase)
glossary.sil: si + le — if … him (si + enclitic le; sil pudiessen prender 'if they could seize him'; = si le)
glossary.alcançado: alcançar — overtaken, caught (past part. masc. sg.; o fosse alcançado 'or were overtaken'; = alcanzado)
glossary.tomássenle: tomar + le — let them take from him (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. tomassen + enclitic le, dative 'from him', dependent on mandó que; = le tomasen)
glossary.pusiéssenle: poner + le — let them put him (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. pusiessen + enclitic le as direct object, leísmo; = lo pusiesen)
glossary.palo: palo — stake, pole, here the gallows-post (Pidal: 'horca'; = palo)
glossary.saber: saber — to know, to find out (infinitive; quiero saber recabdo 'I want to learn the account'; = saber)
glossary.meterlos: meter + los + he — I shall put them (split future: infinitive meter + enclitic los + he, 1st sg.; = los meteré)
glossary.escripto: escripto — writing, written record (noun; en escripto 'in writing', i.e. on a list; Latin scriptum; = escrito)
glossary.sean: seer — let them be (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; todos sean contados 'let them all be counted'; = sean)
glossary.furtare: furtar — (if) he steal (future subjunctive 3rd sg., with algunos; with no object, apparently 'steal away, slip off', though 'steal' outright is possible; no note in Pidal; = hurtare, a tense now obsolete; modern hurtar)
glossary.fallaro: fallar — (if) I find (future subjunctive 1st sg., with the old -o ending, restored by Pidal as fallar[o]; menos le fallar[o] 'if I find him missing'; Pidal 'si le hallare menos, si le echare de menos'; = hallare, a tense now obsolete)
glossary.âquestos: a + aquestos — to these (a + demonstrative aquestos masc. pl.; â aquestos myos vassallos 'to these my vassals'; = a estos)
glossary.myos: mio — my (masc. pl.; myos vassallos 'my vassals'; = mis)
glossary.curian: curiar — they guard, watch over (present 3rd pl., paired with andan; curian a Valençia 'guard Valencia'; = guardan; no modern curiar)
glossary.arrobdando: arrobdar — making the rounds, patrolling (gerund; andan arrobdando 'go about on patrol'; Pidal: 'rondar, hacer el servicio de guardia exterior en una fortaleza'; = rondando)
glossary.corth: corth — court (= corte; so spelled, with final -th; no note in Pidal; here the Çid's court at Valencia)
glossary.falló: fallar — he found (preterite 3rd sg.; quando los falló 'when he had found them (all assembled)'; = halló)
glossary.fízolos: fazer + los — he made them (preterite 3rd sg. fizo + enclitic los; fízolos nonbrar 'had them named, called over'; = los hizo)
glossary.nonbrar: nonbrar — to name, call by name, call over (infinitive; = nombrar)
glossary.çientos: çiento — hundred (masc., pl. in compounds; seys çientos 'six hundred'; = cientos, modern seiscientos)
glossary.alégrasle: alegrar + se + le — it rejoices for him (present 3rd sg. alégra + reflexive s(e), written -s, + enclitic le dative; alégrasle el coraçón 'his heart rejoices'; = se le alegra)
glossary.sonrrisar: sonrrisar — to smile (infinitive; tornós a sonrrisar 'he began to smile'; = sonreír)
glossary.ixiemos: exir — we went out, left (preterite 1st pl., old -iemos ending; = salimos; no modern exir)
glossary.destas: de + estas — of these (preposition de + demonstrative estas fem. pl.; destas mis ganançias 'of these my gains'; = de estas)
glossary.ídgelos: id + ge + los — go … them to him (imperative 2nd pl. of ir, id, + ge, old dative 'to him', ancestor of modern se, + los 'them'; e vos ídgelos levar 'and do you go and take them to him'; = id a llevárselos)
glossary.besalde: besar + le — kiss … his (imperative 2nd pl. besad + enclitic le, with -dl- > -ld-; besalde la mano 'kiss his hand'; = besadle)
glossary.rogad: rogar — ask, beg (imperative 2nd pl.; firme gelo rogad 'ask it of him earnestly'; = rogad)
glossary.naturales: natural — natural, by blood, true-born (adjective, pl.; mis fijas naturales 'my daughters by birth'; = naturales; Pidal's bracketed supplied word)
glossary.quenlas: que + me + las — that … me … them (Pidal's note to v. 1277: quenlas dexe 'que me las deje', 'that he let me have them'; the me worn down to its consonant, written n before l, cf. quem; = que me las)
glossary.dexe: dexar — (that) he let, allow (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; quenlas dexe sacar 'that he let me take them out'; = deje)
glossary.sacar: sacar — to take out, bring away (infinitive; dexe sacar 'let (me) take (them) out'; = sacar)
glossary.enbiaré: enbiar — I shall send (future 1st sg.; enbiaré por ellas 'I shall send for them'; = enviaré)
glossary.sabed: saber — know, take note of (imperative 2nd pl.; e vos sabed el mensage 'and you, learn the message'; = sabed)
glossary.vernán: venir — they will come (future 3rd pl., syncopated, with n and r changing places: venir-án > vernán; = vendrán)
glossary.ciento: ciento — hundred (full form before a noun; ciento omnes 'a hundred men'; = cien, ciento)
glossary.servirle: servir + le — to serve him (infinitive + enclitic le; por servirle 'to serve him'; = servirle)
glossary.carrera: carrera — road, way, journey (en la carrera 'on the road'; = carrera, now mostly 'race, career')
glossary.coronado: coronado — tonsured one, cleric (past part. used as noun; 'un coronado' is a priest with the tonsure 'crown' shaved on his head; modern coronado = 'crowned', so the sense differs; Pidal: 'clérigo'; = clérigo)
glossary.jerome: Jerome — Jerónimo, the Cid's bishop of Valencia (Pidal restores Jero[me], 'don Jerome'; = Jerónimo)
glossary.llamado: llamar — called, named (past part.; so nombre es llamado 'his name is called'; = llamado)
glossary.entendido: entender — learned, knowledgeable (past part. as adjective; bien entendido es de letras 'he is well versed in letters'; = entendido)
glossary.letras: letra — letters, learning (pl.; de letras 'in book-learning'; = letras)
glossary.acordado: acordado — prudent, sensible, of sound judgment (past part. of acordar used as adjective; Pidal: 'que obra con acuerdo y madurez; cuerdo, prudente'; modern acordado = 'agreed'; = prudente, sensato)
glossary.arreziado: arreziar — vigorous, strong (past part. as adjective; mucho era arreziado 'he was very sturdy'; = arreciado, recio)
glossary.provezas: proveza — deeds of prowess, valiant deeds (pl.; = proezas)
glossary.andávalas: andar + las — he went about (them) (imperfect 3rd sg. andava + enclitic las; andávalas demandando 'he went about asking for them', i.e. seeking the Cid's feats; = las andaba demandando)
glossary.demandando: demandar — asking for, inquiring about (gerund; = demandando; modern demandar 'to sue, demand', so the sense is wider here; closest preguntando por)
glossary.sospirando: sospirar — sighing, yearning (gerund; sospirando ques viesse 'longing to find himself'; = suspirando)
glossary.viesse: veer — he might see (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; ques viesse 'that he might find himself', with reflexive se; = viese)
glossary.fartás: fartar — he were to glut himself, had his fill (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., reduced from fartasse; sis fartás lidiando 'if he could only have his fill of fighting'; = se hartase; -ás is not a future)
glossary.sieglo: sieglo — world, secular life (Latin saeculum; a los días del sieglo 'in the days of the world', i.e. ever, and with non 'never'; = siglo)
glossary.llorassen: llorar — they would weep (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., -assen; a los días del sieglo non le llorassen cristianos 'no one would ever weep for him' (Pidal: cristianos = 'nadie'); = llorasen)
glossary.gradescamos: gradeçer — let us thank (present subjunctive 1st pl., jussive; nos bien gelo gradescamos 'let us give thanks for it'; = agradezcamos)
glossary.dárgelo: dar + ge + lo — to give it to him (infinitive dar + enclitic ge 'to him', ancestor of se, + lo 'it'; = dárselo)
glossary.otorgan: otorgar — they grant, agree to (present 3rd pl.; yal otorgan por obispo 'they accept him as bishop'; = otorgan)
glossary.diéronle: dar + le — they gave him (preterite 3rd pl. dieron + enclitic le; = le dieron)
glossary.rico: rico — rich, well provided (= rico; estar rico 'to be well off')
glossary.vinos: venir + se — he went away, took himself off (vino, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic reflexive se, here spelled -s; e spidiós e vinos 'took leave and went'; = se vino, closest se fue)
glossary.remanidas: remaner — left, remaining (past part. fem. pl.; tierras remanidas en paz 'lands left in peace'; no modern form, = quedadas)
glossary.dexarévos: dexar + vos — I shall leave you (future 1st sg. dexaré with enclitic vos set after it, not a split future; dexarévos las posadas 'I will leave you the lodgings', i.e. pass over them; = os dejaré)
glossary.demandó: demandar — he asked for, inquired after (preterite 3rd sg.; demandó por Alfonsso 'he asked for Alfonso'; = preguntó por)
glossary.fora: ser / ir — he had gone (pluperfect 3rd sg., from Latin fuerat; Pidal restores F[o]ra; fora el rey a San Fagunt 'the king had gone to Sahagún'; = había ido; modern fuera is imperfect subjunctive)
glossary.fagunt: Fagunt — Sahagún, the monastery town in León (San Fagunt = San Facundo; Fagunt apocopated; = Sahagún)
glossary.carrión: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia, seat of the counts of Carrión (= Carrión)
glossary.afe: afe — behold, lo! (presentative formula, no modern form; afe Minaya 'here comes Minaya', cf. fevos; = he aquí, ahí está)
glossary.llega: llegar — he arrives (present 3rd sg.; do llega 'where he arrives'; = llega)
glossary.apuosto: apuesto — handsome, gallant, elegantly mannered (Pidal restores apu[o]sto, with diphthong; tan apuosto 'so seemly, so gracefully', used as an adverb; = apuesto, gallardo)
glossary.puoblo: pueblo — people, assembled folk (Pidal restores pu[o]blo, with diphthong; ante tod el puoblo 'before all the people'; = pueblo)
glossary.duolo: duelo — grief, sorrow (Pidal restores du[o]lo; con grand duolo 'with great grief'; = duelo, pena; no relation to modern duelo 'duel')
glossary.besávale: besar + le — he kissed his (imperfect 3rd sg. besava + enclitic le; besávale las manos 'he kissed his hands'; = le besaba)
glossary.besávavos: besar + vos — he kissed your (hands) (imperfect 3rd sg. besava + enclitic dative vos; besávavos las manos mio Çid 'my Çid kisses (lit. was kissing) your hands', a greeting and request sent through Minaya, where v. 1338 has the present bésavos; = os besaba, os besa)
glossary.echástesle: echar + le — you cast him out (preterite 2nd pl. echastes, = echasteis, + enclitic le; echástesle de tierra 'you banished him'; = le echasteis)
glossary.agena: ageno — foreign, another's (fem. sg.; tierra agena 'foreign land'; = ajena)
glossary.miyor: mejor — better, finest (Latin melior; spelled miyor; Murviedro que es miyor 'Murviedro, which is the better (of them)'; = mejor)
glossary.fuort: fuerte — strong (apocopated; Pidal restores fu[o]rt, with diphthong; peña fuort 'a strong rock'; = fuerte)
glossary.lides: lid — battle, combat (fem. pl.; = lides, now only 'contest, dispute'; closest batallas)
glossary.campales: campal — pitched, open-field (adjective, pl.; lides campales 'pitched battles'; = campales)
glossary.arrancó: arrancar — he routed, drove off (preterite 3rd sg.; todas las arrancó 'he routed them all', i.e. won every battle; = arrancó, derrotó)
glossary.fevos: fevos — behold, here you have (presentative formula, fe + vos 'for you'; fevos aquí las señas 'here are the tokens for you'; no modern form, = he aquí, mirad)
glossary.aqui: aquí — here (unaccented in Pidal's print at v. 1335; = aquí)
glossary.gruessos: gruesso — big, sturdy, heavy-built (masc. pl.; cavallos gruessos 'strong, stout horses'; = gruesos)
glossary.guarnidos: guarnir — equipped, fitted out (past part. masc. pl.; de siellas e de frenos todos guarnidos 'all fitted with saddles and bridles'; = guarnecidos)
glossary.prendades: prender — you may take, accept (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades; que los prendades vos 'that you accept them'; = toméis, aceptéis; modern prender 'to seize')
glossary.razonas: razonar + se — he declares himself (razona 3rd sg. present + reflexive se, reduced to -s; razonas por vuestro vassallo 'he declares himself your vassal'; = se declara)
glossary.fieras: fiero — great, mighty, extraordinary (fem. pl.; fieras ganançias 'great gains'; modern fiero 'fierce', so a weaker sense here (uncertain nuance); = grandes) · also fiero — wild, savage (bestias fieras 'wild beasts'; = fieras)
glossary.esidre: Esidre — Isidore, Saint Isidore of Seville, whose relics rest in León (Pidal restores Esidr[e]; sant Esidre; = Isidro, Isidoro)
glossary.plázme: plazer + me — it pleases me (plaze + enclitic me, accented plázme; = me place, me agrada)
glossary.plázem: plazer + me — it pleases me (plaze + enclitic me with its e dropped, plaze-m; e plázem de las nuevas 'and I am pleased at the deeds'; = me place, me agrada)
glossary.reçibo: reçebir — I receive, accept (present 1st sg.; = recibo)
glossary.garci: Garci — García (apocopated; Garci Ordóñez, count at Alfonso's court and the Cid's enemy; = García)
glossary.dexad: dexar — leave off, drop (imperative 2nd pl.; dexad essa razón 'drop that talk'; = dejad)
glossary.razón: razón — talk, speech, matter (dexad essa razón 'leave off that talk'; esta razón 'this matter'; = razón, here closest asunto, conversación) · also razón — 'word, voice' (en una razón 'with one voice, in agreement'; = razón)
glossary.guisas: guisa — manner, way (pl.; en todas guisas 'in every way'; = guisas, modo)
glossary.mijor: mejor — better (Latin melior, spelled mijor; mijor me sirve que vos 'he serves me better than you'; = mejor)
glossary.pide: pedir — he asks for, begs (present 3rd sg.; merçed vos pide 'he asks you for favor'; = pide)
glossary.cadiesse: caer — it should fall, should chance (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., Pidal restores ca[d]iesse; si vos cadiesse en sabor 'if it should fall to your liking, please you'; = cayese)
glossary.saldríen: salir — they would go out (conditional 3rd pl., old -ién ending; = saldrían)
glossary.irién: ir — they would go (conditional 3rd pl., old -ién ending; = irían)
glossary.coraçone: coraçón — heart (with a final -e restored by Pidal in italics, the paragogic e at the line-end; plazme de coraçone 'it pleases me with all my heart'; = corazón)
glossary.mandaré: mandar — I shall order (future 1st sg.; yo les mandaré dar conducho 'I will order provisions given them'; = mandaré)
glossary.foren: seer (or ir) — they shall be, they shall go (future subjunctive 3rd pl., Pidal restores f[o]ren; mientra que por mi tierra foren 'while they are (travelling) in my land'; quando en cabo de mi tierra … foren 'when they are at the edge of my land'; = fueren)
glossary.curiallas: curiar + las — to guard them (infinitive curiar + enclitic las, with -r assimilated before l-; de mal curiallas 'to protect them from harm'; no modern form, = guardarlas, protegerlas)
glossary.desonore: desonor — dishonour, disgrace (with a final -e restored by Pidal in italics, the paragogic e at the line-end; = deshonor)
glossary.catad: catar — look, see to it (imperative 2nd pl.; catad cómmo las sirvades 'see that you serve them'; = mirad; modern catar is 'to taste')
glossary.sirvades: servir — you serve, may serve (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades; cómmo las sirvades 'how you are to serve them'; = sirváis)
glossary.campeadore: Campeador — the Battler, the Cid's epithet (with a final -e restored by Pidal in italics, the paragogic e at the line-end; = Campeador)
glossary.oídme: oír + me — hear me (imperative 2nd pl. oíd + enclitic me; = oídme)
glossary.pierda: perder — he lose (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non quiero que nada pierda 'I do not want him to lose anything'; = pierda)
glossary.deseredé: deseredar — I disinherited (preterite 1st sg.; por que los deseredé 'for which I disinherited them', i.e. because of the Cid; = desheredé)
glossary.sírvanle: servir + les — let (their estates) serve them (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive, + enclitic les, its s lost before the s of sus and marked by Pidal's apostrophe: sírvanle' sus heredades; Pidal: sírvanles sus heredades 'queden en posesión de ellas, aunque ausentes', 'let them keep possession of them though absent'; = que les sirvan)
glossary.atrégoles: atreguar + les — I assure them, guarantee them protection (present 1st sg. + enclitic dative les; Pidal: 'atréguoles', 'les aseguro que no recibirán mal ni ocasión'; atrégoles los cuerpos de mal 'I guarantee their persons against harm'; = les aseguro)
glossary.ocasión: ocasión — mischance, serious damage (de mal e de ocasión 'from harm and mischance'; Pidal: ocasión o 'daño grave'; modern ocasión 'occasion, chance'; closest daño, percance)
glossary.sirvan: servir — they may serve (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; que sirvan a so señor 'that they serve their lord'; = sirvan)
glossary.vellido: vellido — fair, gracious, handsome (adjective used as an adverb, Pidal 'hermosamente'; tan vellido fabló 'spoke so graciously'; no modern form, = bello, gentil)
glossary.servir: servir — to serve (infinitive; ir servir al Campeador 'to go serve the Campeador'; = servir)
glossary.quitos: quito — free, released (masc. pl.; de mí sean quitos 'let them be free of me', released from allegiance to the king; = libres, quitos)
glossary.desamor: desamor — ill will, disaffection (Pidal restores des[amor]; en otra desamor 'in other ill-will', Pidal's reading of a defective line; = desamor)
glossary.fabla: fabla — talk, conversation (entrar en fabla 'to enter into discussion, confer'; = habla)
glossary.casariemos: casar — we would marry (conditional 1st pl., old -iemos ending; casar con 'to marry'; = casaríamos)
glossary.acometer: acometer — to broach, venture upon, undertake (infinitive; Pidal 'proponer'; non la osariemos acometer 'we would not dare to broach it'; = acometer, here closest emprender, plantear)
glossary.comdes: conde — counts (pl., Pidal's co[m]des; de comdes de Carrión 'of the counts of Carrión'; = condes)
glossary.espidió: espedirse — he took leave (preterite 3rd sg., with the reflexive se placed before: se espidió; = se despidió)
glossary.portero: portero — the king's officer (Pidal: the palace official who replaced the old sayón, at first bringing persons into the king's presence, then carrying the king's letters and orders and carrying out his commands; not a door-keeper here; levedes un portero 'take a royal officer with you'; = portero real)
glossary.leváredes: levar — you take (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; si leváredes las dueñas 'if you take the ladies'; = llevareis, now obsolete; closest lleváis)
glossary.sírvanlas: servir + las — let them serve them (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive, + enclitic las; = que las sirvan)
glossary.medina: Medina — Medinaceli, the frontier town on the Jalón where Alfonso's land ends (= Medinaceli)
glossary.denles: dar + les — let them give them (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive, den + enclitic les; = que les den)
glossary.for: ser — it may be (future subjunctive 3rd sg., Pidal restores f[o]r; quanto huebos les for 'whatever they need'; = fuere)
glossary.piensse: pensar — let him take thought, look after (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; piensse dellas 'let him care for them'; = piense)
glossary.vasse: ir + se — he goes away (va, present 3rd sg., + enclitic reflexive se, with doubled s; = se va)
glossary.ane: aver — they have (present 3rd pl. an + paragogic -e, the epic final e in á-e assonance; perfect auxiliary: so consejo preso ane 'they have taken their counsel, made up their minds'; = han)
glossary.saludadnos: saludar + nos — greet (for) us (imperative 2nd pl. saludad + enclitic nos, 'on our behalf'; saludadnos a mio Çid 'give the Cid our greetings'; = saludadnos)
glossary.bivare: Bivar — Vivar (Bivar + paragogic -e, Pidal's restored final e in á-e assonance; el de Bivare 'the one of Vivar'; = Vivar)
glossary.fare: fazer — to do (short infinitive far + paragogic -e in á-e assonance; quanto lo podemos fare 'as much as we can do'; = hacer)
glossary.perderave: perder — he will lose (future 3rd sg.; Pidal: 'perderave por perderá, con e paragógica', the e with a v glide restored by him in italics; nada non perderave 'he will lose nothing'; = perderá)
glossary.pesare: pesar — to grieve, weigh upon (infinitive + paragogic -e in á-e assonance; non me a por qué pesare 'I have no cause to be grieved'; = pesar)
glossary.tórnansse: tornar + se — they go back, return (present 3rd pl. tornan + reflexive se, spelt -ss-; tórnansse los iffantes 'the infantes turn back'; = se tornan)
glossary.quandol: quando + le — when … him (quando + le, the -e of le dropped; quandol vieron assomar 'when they saw him appear'; = cuando le)
glossary.assomar: assomar — to appear, come into view (infinitive; vieron assomar 'they saw (him) appear'; = asomar)
glossary.deçido: deçir — come down, dismounted (past part.; ser + participle as perfect of a verb of motion: Deçido es Minaya 'Minaya has dismounted'; Pidal: 'descendido' del caballo, compare diçiendo del cavallo; = descendido)
glossary.ssan: santo — Saint (apocopated before a name, spelt with doubled s; a ssan Pero 'to Saint Peter'; = san)
glossary.acabó: acabar — he finished (preterite 3rd sg.; quando acabó la oraçión 'when he had finished the prayer'; = acabó)
glossary.omillom: omillar + me — I humble myself, I bow to (present 1st sg. omillo + enclitic me, the e dropped before the next word: omíllome; Omillom, doña Ximena 'I bow to you, doña Ximena', a courtly greeting; = me humillo)
glossary.ffaga: fazer — may (he) do (likewise) (present subjunctive 3rd sg., ff = f; Pidal: a 'verbo vicario' standing for the verb before it, assi ffaga 'también curie', 'may he guard them too'; = haga)
glossary.salúdavos: saludar + vos — greets you (present 3rd sg. salúda + enclitic vos; Salúdavos mio Çid 'the Cid sends you greetings'; = os saluda)
glossary.onde: onde — where, whence (relative adverb; allá onde elle está 'there where he is'; = donde)
glossary.dexé: dexar — I left (preterite 1st sg.; sano lo dexé 'I left him well'; = dejé)
glossary.sueltas: soltar — released, set free (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with the object; sueltas me vos ha, Pidal 'os ha dejado libres', 'he has let you go free (into my charge)'; = sueltas)
glossary.levaros: levar + vos — to take you (infinitive levar + enclitic vos, contracted to -ros; por levaros a Valençia 'in order to take you to Valencia'; = llevaros)
glossary.heredad: heredad — inherited holding, estate, landed property (por heredad 'as a possession'; = heredad)
glossary.sanas: sano — sound, unharmed, healthy (fem. pl.; sanas e sin mal 'safe and unharmed'; = sanas)
glossary.enviólos: enviar + los — he sent them (preterite 3rd sg. envió + enclitic los; = los envió)
glossary.dezid: dezir — say, tell (imperative 2nd pl.; Dezid al Canpeador 'tell the Campeador'; = decid)
glossary.fóremos: seer / ir — we shall be, go (future subjunctive 1st pl., Pidal's restored f[ó]remos; mientra que fóremos por sus tierras 'while we travel through his lands'; seer and ir share this stem; = fuéremos)
glossary.curiare: curiar — he should guard (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si Dios nos curiare de mal 'if God keeps us from harm'; no modern curiar, = guardare)
glossary.sermos: seer — we shall be (future 1st pl., a rare shortened form beside seremos, its exact formation uncertain; sermos i 'we shall be there'; = seremos)
glossary.penssarán: pensar — they will see to, take care of (future 3rd pl.; e dello penssarán, Pidal 'y cuidarán de ello'; = pensarán)
glossary.remaneçió: remaneçer — he remained, stayed behind (preterite 3rd sg.; remaneçió en San Pero 'he stayed on at San Pedro'; = permaneció, quedó)
glossary.irse: ir + se — to go away, set off (infinitive + reflexive se; irse quieren 'they wish to be off'; = irse)
glossary.toviesse: tener — he might hold, keep (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; que les toviesse pro 'that he should look after their interests, be of use to them'; the exact force of tener pro is uncertain; = tuviese)
glossary.rogavan: rogar — they were begging (imperfect 3rd pl.; = rogaban)
glossary.diziendo: dezir — saying (gerund; diziendo Minaya 'Minaya says', the gerund standing for a finite verb of speech; = diciendo)
glossary.feré: fazer — I shall do (future 1st sg.; esto feré 'I shall do this'; = haré)
glossary.acreçídol: acreçer + le — increased (to him) (past part. acreçído + enclitic le, the e dropped; acreçídol han 'have added to his company', i.e. le han acrecido; = acrecido)
glossary.aduxiera: aduzir — he had brought (3rd sg. -ra form with pluperfect value, strong preterite stem adux- (aduxo); que aduxiera d'allá 'whom he had brought from there'; = había traído)
glossary.pensólas: pensar + las — he set about (equipping) them (preterite 3rd sg. pensó + enclitic las; pensólas de adobar 'he set about fitting them out', pensar de + inf., las the object of adobar; = se puso a adobarlas)
glossary.mejores: mejor — better, best (pl.; de los mejores guarnimientos 'of the best equipment'; = mejores)
glossary.guarnimientos: guarnimiento — clothing and finery, attire (pl.; Pidal: 'vestidos y aderezo de una persona'; de los mejores guarnimientos 'with the finest attire'; = atavíos)
glossary.parescan: parescer — they may seem, look (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; que non parescan mal 'so that they may not look poor'; = parezcan)
glossary.adobadas: adobar — fitted out, equipped (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with the object; las ha adobadas 'has fitted them out'; = adobadas, aderezadas)
glossary.desfechos: desfazer — undone, ruined (past part. masc. pl.; Desfechos nos ha el Çid 'the Cid has ruined us'; = deshechos)
glossary.soltariemos: soltar — we would release, give up (conditional 1st pl.; soltariemos la ganançia 'we would give up the interest'; = soltaríamos)
glossary.cosiment: cosiment — favour, grace; reward (Pidal: 'merced, favor'; buen cosiment y avrá, 'habrá buen pago', 'there will be good reward for it'; no modern descendant)
glossary.dexaremos: dexar — we shall leave (future 1st pl.; dexaremos Burgos 'we shall leave Burgos'; = dejaremos)
glossary.acogen: acoger — they join, gather to (present 3rd pl.; reflexive acogerse a uno 'to come over to someone, join his following': muchas yentes se le acogen 'many people join him'; = se le unen)
glossary.besad: besar — kiss (imperative 2nd pl.; las manos le besad 'kiss his hands'; = besad)
glossary.olbidar: olbidar — to forget (infinitive, spelt with b for v; no lo quiera olbidar 'let him not forget'; = olvidar)
glossary.levarlo: levar + lo — to carry it (infinitive + enclitic lo; en levarlo adelant 'in carrying it forward, promoting it'; = llevarlo)
glossary.espiden: espedir — they take leave (present 3rd pl., reflexive; yas espiden 'now they take their leave', the se in yas; = se despiden)
glossary.felos: fe + los — behold them (presentative, as in afevos, + enclitic los; felos en Medina las dueñas 'there they are at Medina, the ladies and Álvar Fáñez'; = helos aquí)
glossary.direvos: dezir + vos — I shall tell you (future 1st sg. diré + enclitic vos, the pronoun set after a verb that opens the line; Direvos de los cavalleros 'I shall tell you of the knights'; = os diré)
glossary.levaron: levar — they carried, took (preterite 3rd pl.; levaron el menssaje 'carried the message'; = llevaron)
glossary.menssaje: menssaje — message, the news or word sent (noun, ss = s; = mensaje)
glossary.plógol: plazer + le — it pleased him (strong preterite plogo 3rd sg., impersonal, + enclitic le, e dropped; plógol de coraçon 'it pleased him from the heart'; = le plugo, modern le plació)
glossary.coraçon: coraçón — heart (noun, printed unaccented coraçon; de coraçon 'from the heart, heartily'; = corazón)
glossary.deve: dever — he ought, must (present 3rd sg.; tal deve sperar 'such he must expect'; = debe)
glossary.sperar: esperar — to expect, await (infinitive, with e- lost; tal deve sperar 'he must expect the like'; = esperar)
glossary.cavalguedes: cavalgar — ride (present subjunctive 2nd pl. in -edes, a polite command; cavalguedes con çiento 'ride with a hundred'; = cabalgad, cabalguéis)
glossary.vayades: ir — (that) you go (present subjunctive 2nd pl. in -ades, used as a command; vayades a Molina 'go to Molina'; = vayáis)
glossary.iaze: yazer — lies, is situated (present 3rd sg.; Molina, que iaze más adelant 'Molina, which lies farther on'; = yace)
glossary.tiénela: tener + la — holds it (present 3rd sg. tiene + enclitic la, accent shifted; tiénela Avengalvón 'Avengalvón holds it'; = la tiene)
glossary.avengalvón: Avengalvón — the Moorish lord (alcaide) of Molina, friend and ally of the Cid (proper name, Aven- = Arabic ibn 'son of'; = Abengalbón)
glossary.conssigrá: conseguir — he will accompany, escort (future 3rd sg., syncopated: consigrá for conseguirá, ss = s; bien vos conssigrá 'he will escort you well'; the sense 'keep company with, follow' is read from the context, Pidal giving no note here; modern conseguir means 'to obtain')
glossary.pudiéredes: poder — you shall be able (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; quanto lo pudiéredes far 'as fast as you can do it'; = pudiereis, modern podáis)
glossary.dixieron: dezir — they said (strong preterite 3rd pl., x = sh-sound; así commo a mí dixieron 'as they told me'; = dijeron)
glossary.podredes: poder — you will be able (future 2nd pl., syncopated for poderedes; hi los podredes fallar 'you will be able to find them there'; = podréis)
glossary.aduzídmelas: aduzir — bring (them) to me (imperative 2nd pl. aduzid + enclitic me + las; aduzídmelas delant 'bring them before me'; = traédmelas)
glossary.costadom: costar + me — cost me (past participle costado + enclitic me reduced to -m; mucho costadom ha 'it has cost me dear', ha the perfect auxiliary set after; = me ha costado)
glossary.locura: locura — madness, folly (noun; grand locura seríe 'it would be great folly'; = locura)
glossary.seríe: ser — would be (conditional 3rd sg.; printed seríe, with the accent on the i, where Pidal elsewhere prints serié; = sería)
glossary.desenparás: desenparar — (if) I abandoned, left unprotected (imperfect subjunctive 1st sg., desenparasse with the final -e dropped; si la desenparás 'if I abandoned it'; = desamparase, closest abandonase)
glossary.ffincaré: fincar — I shall remain (future 1st sg., ff = f; yo ffincaré en Valençia 'I shall stay in Valencia'; = quedaré, modern hincar means 'to drive in')
glossary.fincan: fincar — they stop, cease (present 3rd pl.; non fincan de andar 'they do not stop riding'; = quedan, closest cesan) · also fincar — they stay, take their stand (fincan sobre so señor 'they take their stand around their lord'; = se quedan, se plantan) · also fincar — they fix, rest (en el[le] fincan los ojos 'they fix their eyes on him'; = clavan, fijan)
glossary.troçieron: troçir — they passed, went by (preterite 3rd pl.; Troçieron a Santa María 'they passed Santa María'; cf. tres an por troçir; no modern form)
glossary.fronchales: Fronchales — Bronchales, a village of the province of Teruel on the border of Guadalajara, 25 km from Albarracín and a day's ride from Molina (Pidal; proper name, -chales restored by Pidal; = Bronchales)
glossary.viniéron: venir — they came (preterite 3rd pl., printed with an accent on the e, probably a misprint for vinieron; viniéron a Molina posar 'they came to lodge at Molina'; = vinieron)
glossary.moro: moro — Moor, Muslim (noun; el moro Avengalvón 'the Moor Avengalvón'; = moro)
glossary.speró: esperar — he waited for (preterite 3rd sg., e- lost; non speró a nadi 'he waited for nobody'; = esperó)
glossary.saludava: saludar — was greeting, sends greetings (imperfect 3rd sg.; mio Çid vos saludava 'the Cid sends you his greetings', the imperfect of a message; = saludaba)
glossary.recabdar: recabdar — to carry out, see to (infinitive; mandólo recabdar 'he ordered it carried out'; = recaudar, here closest cumplir)
glossary.privádol: privado + le — quickly, at once, for him (adverb privado + enclitic le, e dropped; que privádol acorrades 'that you help him promptly'; = pronto le)
glossary.adugades: aduzir — (that) you bring (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; adugades gelas acá 'bring them here to him', gelas = ge + las; = traigáis)
glossary.ffata: fata — until, as far as (preposition, ff = f; ffata en Valençia 'as far as Valencia'; = hasta)
glossary.partades: partir — (that) you part, separate (present subjunctive 2nd pl., prohibition with non, reflexive vos; non vos partades 'do not leave them'; = os apartéis, closest os separéis)
glossary.çientol: çiento + le — a hundred (of them) to him (çiento + enclitic le, e dropped; çientol pidieron 'they asked him for a hundred'; = cien)
glossary.montañas: montaña — mountains, wooded highlands (pl.; Passan las montañas 'they cross the mountains'; = montañas)
glossary.mata: mata — thicket, scrub; here in the place name Mata de Taranz, which Pidal identifies with today's campo Taranz, a stony plain over the head of the valley of Arbujuelo, between the provinces of Soria and Guadalajara (noun; = mata) · also matar — he kills (present 3rd sg.; atantos mata de moros 'he kills so many Moors'; = mata, unrelated to the noun mata)
glossary.arbuxuelo: Arbuxuelo — Arbujuelo, a small valley and stream feeding the Jalón, running down to Medinaceli (Pidal; val de Arbuxuelo, the ue restored by Pidal; = Arbujuelo)
glossary.deprunar: deprunar — to go down, descend (infinitive; pienssan a deprunar 'they set about going down'; a rare word, etymology doubtful; no modern form)
glossary.armados: armar — armed (past participle masc. pl.; vídolos venir armados 'he saw them come armed'; = armados)
glossary.temiós: temer + se — he took alarm, was afraid (preterite 3rd sg. temió + reflexive -s(e); temiós Minaya 'Minaya took alarm'; = se temió)
glossary.coranado: coranado — tonsured one, cleric (past participle used as a noun, a variant of coronado; Pidal: forma concurrente con coronado, 'clérigo'; coranado leal 'a loyal churchman'; = clérigo)
glossary.alcáyaz: alcáyaz — alcaide, governor of a fortress (Pidal: 'alcaide', el que tiene a su cargo una fortaleza; from Arabic al-qāʾid; alcáyaz Avengalvón 'the governor Avengalvón'; = alcaide)
glossary.trahe: traer — brings (present 3rd sg., h marking the old hiatus; fuerças que trahe 'the forces he brings'; = trae)
glossary.óndral: ondra + le — honour to him (noun ondra + enclitic le, e dropped; printed with an accent on the o; de grand óndral dar 'to give him great honour'; = darle gran honra)
glossary.llegarán: llegar — they will arrive (future 3rd pl.; agora llegarán 'now they will arrive'; = llegarán)
glossary.ffo: ser — was (preterite 3rd sg. fo, ff = f, the o restored by Pidal: ff[o]; Esso ffo apriessa fecho 'that was quickly done'; = fue)
glossary.pareçen: pareçer — they look, appear (present 3rd pl.; non pareçen mal 'they look splendid'; = parecen)
glossary.cuberturas: cubertura — horse-covering, caparison (pl.; cuberturas de çendales 'caparisons of silk'; = cobertura, closest gualdrapa)
glossary.çendales: çendal — sendal, fine thin silk (pl.; = cendales)
glossary.peytrales: peytral — horse's breast-strap, breast-piece (pl.; peytrales a cascaviellos 'breast-straps hung with bells'; = petral)
glossary.cuellos: cuello — neck (pl.; escudos a los cuellos 'shields hung at the neck'; = cuellos)
glossary.seso: seso — mind, wits, judgment, character (de qué seso era 'what kind of mind he had'; = seso, now 'brain')
glossary.saliera: salir — he had gone out, set out (pluperfect indicative 3rd sg. in -ra, from the Latin pluperfect; qu[o]mo saliera de Castiella 'how he had left Castile'; = había salido)
glossary.mesurando: mesurar — scouting, reconnoitring (gerund; Pidal: mesurar significa 'explorar, reconocer el terreno'; los que ivan mesurando 'those who went scouting ahead'; modern mesurar 'to moderate')
glossary.llegando: llegar — arriving, drawing near (gerund; llegando delant 'coming up ahead'; = llegando)
glossary.toman: tomar — they take (present 3rd pl.; toman armas 'they take up arms'; = toman)
glossary.tómanse: tomar + se — they set about (present 3rd pl. toman + enclitic se, the accent written on the verb's stressed vowel; tómanse a deportar, Pidal 'comienzan a deportarse'; = se ponen a)
glossary.deportar: deportar — to sport, disport oneself (infinitive, reflexive with tómanse; Pidal: deportarse, 'solazarse con ejercicios corporales'; = deportarse, closest divertirse)
glossary.homillar: omillar — to bow, pay homage (infinitive, with unetymological h-; se van homillar 'they go to pay their respects'; = humillarse)
glossary.sonrrisándose: sonrrisar + se — smiling (gerund + enclitic se, rr = r; sonrrisándose de la boca 'smiling with his mouth'; = sonriéndose)
glossary.hivalo: ir + lo — he went to (embrace) him (imperfect 3rd sg. iva spelt hiva + enclitic lo; hivalo abraçar 'he went to embrace him'; = lo iba a (abrazar))
glossary.ombro: ombro — shoulder (noun; en el ombro lo saluda 'he greets him with a kiss on the shoulder', Pidal 'le besa en el hombro'; = hombro)
glossary.saluda: saludar — he greets (present 3rd sg.; = saluda) · here 'he greets with a kiss' (en el ombro lo saluda; Pidal 'le besa en el hombro', saludar 'besar')
glossary.husaje: usaje — custom, habit (noun, h- spelling; tal es so husaje 'such is his custom'; no common modern form, closest uso)
glossary.traedes: traer — you (pl.) bring (present 2nd pl. in -edes; Traedes estas dueñas 'you bring these ladies'; = traéis)
glossary.valdremos: valer — we shall be worth, shall gain in worth (future 1st pl.; por o valdremos más 'through whom we shall be worth more'; = valdremos)
glossary.ondrar: ondrar — to honour (infinitive; ondrar vos hemos 'we shall honour you', infinitive + vos + auxiliary, split future; = honrar)
glossary.abrá: aver — he will have (future 3rd sg., b for v; de lo nuestro abrá 'he will have of ours'; = habrá)
glossary.muchol: mucho + le — very much, to him (mucho + enclitic le, e dropped; muchol tengo por torpe 'I hold him a great fool'; = mucho le)
glossary.conosçe: conoscer — knows, recognizes (present 3rd sg.; qui non conosçe la verdad 'who does not know the truth'; = conoce)
glossary.sorrisós: sorrisar(se) — he smiled (preterite 3rd sg. sorrisó + reflexive se reduced to -s; Sorrisós de la boca 'he smiled with his mouth'; = se sonrió; compare sonrrisándose, the gerund with se)
glossary.amigol: amigo + l(e) — a friend to him (amigo + le, dative le elided to -l after the noun; amigol sodes 'you are his friend'; = sois su amigo; the le read as the Cid, 'friend to him'; the reading is not certain)
glossary.llegare: llegar — may (He) bring, may (He) let me arrive (future subjunctive 3rd sg. in -re, in an if-clause, here transitive 'to bring'; Si Dios me llegare al Çid 'if God lets me reach the Cid'; modern si + present indicative, si Dios me lleva; the future subjunctive is lost in modern Spanish)
glossary.perderedes: perder — you will lose (future 2nd pl., perder + edes, the old -edes ending; non perderedes nada 'you will lose nothing'; = perderéis)
glossary.adobada: adobar — made ready, prepared (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with çena; la çena es adobada 'supper is prepared'; = preparada; modern adobar means 'to season, marinate')
glossary.sirvíalos: servir + los — he was serving them (imperfect 3rd sg. sirvía + enclitic los, set after the verb that opens the clause; sirvíalos Minaya 'Minaya waited on them'; = los servía)
glossary.fueron: seer/ir — they were (preterite 3rd pl., shared by ser and ir; todos fueron alegres 'all were glad'; = fueron)
glossary.çerviçio: çerviçio — service, hospitality, provisions supplied (del çerviçio que tomaran 'of the service they had received'; = servicio)
glossary.tomaran: tomar — they had taken, received (pluperfect indicative 3rd pl. in -ra, the Latin pluperfect; que tomaran 'which they had received'; = habían tomado; Pidal's tomara[n])
glossary.medinal: Medina + l(e) — Medina (Medinaceli) with elided le: en Medinal sacaran 'they had taken out at Medina for him'; = en Medina le; le dative, uncertain who it is; see Medina
glossary.sacaran: sacar — they had taken out, drawn (pluperfect 3rd pl. in -ra; conducho … sacaran 'provisions they had drawn'; = habían sacado)
glossary.passada: passar — passed, gone (past part. fem. sg. with ser, agreeing with noche; Passada es la noche 'the night is past'; = pasada) · also passar — crossed (past part. fem. sg. with aver, agreeing with its object; passada han la sierra 'they have crossed the sierra'; = han pasado)
glossary.venida: venir — come, arrived (past part. fem. sg. with ser; venida es la mañana 'morning has come'; = venida) · also venida — arrival, coming (noun; en vuestra venida 'at your arrival'; = venida)
glossary.oída: oír — heard (past part. fem. sg. with ser; oída es la missa 'mass has been heard'; = oída)
glossary.cavalgavan: cavalgar — they rode, mounted (imperfect 3rd pl.; luego cavalgavan 'at once they mounted'; = cabalgaban)
glossary.passavan: passar — they crossed, passed (imperfect 3rd pl.; Salón passavan 'they crossed the Jalón'; = pasaban)
glossary.luégol: luego + l(e) — at once it (luego + le; le probably takes up el campo as object, an odd use, so not certain; luégol atravessavan 'at once they crossed it'; = luego lo atravesaban; the accent shows the stress stays on lué-) · also luego + l(e) — at once … from him, dative of separation (dessí luégo[l] quitó 'right there he parted from him')
glossary.atravessavan: atravessar — they were crossing (imperfect 3rd pl.; el campo … atravessavan 'they crossed the plain'; = atravesaban)
glossary.aguardava: aguardar — he was guarding, looking after (imperfect 3rd sg.; Pidal restores aguarda[va]; las dueñas aguardava 'he looked after the ladies'; = aguardaba, but modern aguardar means 'to wait for', here 'to guard, care for')
glossary.hivan: ir — they went (imperfect 3rd pl., h- only spelling; hivan a una compaña 'they went together as one company'; = iban)
glossary.entrados: entrar — entered (past part. masc. pl. with ser; Entrados son 'they have entered'; = entrados)
glossary.sirvié: servir — he was serving (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ié; bien los sirvié 'he served them well'; = servía)
glossary.quisieron: querer — they wished (strong preterite 3rd pl.; de quanto que quisieron 'of all they wanted'; = quisieron)
glossary.ferraduras: ferradura — horseshoes, the shoeing of horses (pl.; ferraduras quitar gelas mandava 'he had the horseshoes (cost) cleared for them'; = herraduras; Latin ferrum)
glossary.ondrava: ondrar — he was honoring (imperfect 3rd sg.; ¡Dios cómmo las ondrava! 'God, how he honored them!'; = honraba)
glossary.manaña: mañana — morning, as printed manaña without the tilde (otro día manaña 'next morning'; = mañana; so printed, the first n without the tilde)
glossary.despendié: despender — he was spending (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ié; lo so despendié el moro 'the Moor spent of his own'; = gastaba; despender survives only as a rare word; Latin dispendere)
glossary.ondradas: ondrado — honored, splendid (past part. as adj. fem. pl.; nuevas tan ondradas 'such honored tidings'; = honradas)
glossary.leguas: legua — league, a measure of distance (pl.; a tres leguas contadas 'three full leagues away'; = leguas)
glossary.contadas: contar — counted, full (past part. fem. pl.; leguas contadas 'full, reckoned leagues'; = contadas)
glossary.mandádol: mandado + l(e) — the message to him (mandado + dative le, the accent showing the stress stays on -dá-; el mandádol levavan 'they carried the message to him'; = el mandado le llevaban; the ol is Pidal's restoration)
glossary.amava: amar — he loved (imperfect 3rd sg.; lo que más amava 'what he loved most'; = amaba)
glossary.yál: ya + l(e) — now to him (ya 'already, now' + dative le; yál viene el mandado 'now the news comes to him'; = ya le viene)
glossary.reçiban: reçebir — may they receive (present subjunctive 3rd pl., purpose after que; que reçiban a Minaya 'that they receive Minaya'; = reciban)
glossary.sedíe: seer — he was sitting, was staying (imperfect 3rd sg., printed sedíe, stressed on the í, beside the unaccented sedie elsewhere; Latin sedebat; él sedíe en Valençia 'he stayed in Valencia'; = estaba, sedía no longer used)
glossary.curiando: curiar — guarding, watching over (gerund; Latin curare; curiando e guardando 'on guard and watching'; no modern form, closest cuidar)
glossary.guardassen: guardar — (that) they guard (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. in -ssen, after mandó; que guardassen el alcáçer 'that they guard the citadel'; = guardaran / guardasen)
glossary.aduxiéssenle: aduzir + le — (that) they bring him (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. aduxiessen + enclitic le, after mandó; e aduxiéssenle a Bavieca 'and that they bring Bavieca to him'; = que le trajeran; modern aducir means only 'to adduce')
glossary.bavieca: Bavieca — Babieca, the Cid's horse (proper name; = Babieca)
glossary.ganara: ganar — he had won (pluperfect 3rd sg. in -ra; quel ganara 'that he had won him'; = había ganado)
glossary.sabié: saber — he knew (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ié; aun non sabié 'he did not yet know'; = sabía)
glossary.corredor: corredor — runner, fast horse (noun from correr; si serié corredor 'whether he would be a runner'; = corredor, closest caballo veloz) · also corredor — swift (adjective, masc. sg.; tanto buen cavallo corredor 'so many a good swift horse'; = veloz)
glossary.ssi: si — if, whether (ss- only a spelling of initial s; = si)
glossary.abrié: aver — he would have (conditional 3rd sg., the infinitive aver + the imperfect ending -ié, Latin habere + habebat; ssi abrié buena parada 'whether he would have a good halt'; = habría)
glossary.parada: parada — halt, stopping (noun from parar; the horse's stop at the end of the run; buena parada 'a good stop'; = parada)
glossary.reçebidas: reçebir — received (past part. fem. pl., absolute with las dueñas; Reçebidas las dueñas 'the ladies having been received'; = recibidas)
glossary.ondrança: ondrança — honor, ceremony (a grant ondrança 'with great honor'; = honra, closest honra/pompa)
glossary.dexava: dexar — he was leaving (imperfect 3rd sg.; dexava el cavallo 'he left his horse'; = dejaba)
glossary.oras: ora — hour, time (fem. pl.; con oras 'in time, in good time': que con oras se acordaran 'who had made ready in time', Pidal's reading, which he queries; Bello's 'gathered to pray the (canonical) hours' he calls arbitrary; = horas)
glossary.acordaran: acordar(se) — they had made ready, prepared themselves (pluperfect 3rd pl. in -ra, with se; que con oras se acordaran 'who had made ready in time', Pidal 'se habían preparado', with a query; compare acordados foron, v. 3059; = se habían preparado; sense not certain)
glossary.sobrepelliças: sobrepelliça — surplice, the white liturgical garment worn by clergy (pl.; = sobrepellices, from sobrepelliz)
glossary.cruzes: cruz — cross (pl.; cruzes de plata 'crosses of silver'; = cruces)
glossary.reçibir: reçebir — to receive (infinitive; reçibir salién 'they came out to receive'; = recibir)
glossary.salién: salir — they were coming out (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ié, salién + infinitive of purpose; salién reçibir 'they came out to receive'; = salían)
glossary.vistiós: vestir + se — he put on (preterite 3rd sg. vistió + reflexive se reduced to -s; vistiós el sobregonel 'he put on the sobregonel'; = se vistió)
glossary.sobregonel: sobregonel — a garment worn over the other clothes (sobre + gonel(a), a tunic; Pidal: an unknown word, some kind of gonela or silk tunic; vistiós el sobregonel 'he put on the surcoat'; no modern form)
glossary.ensiéllanle: ensellar + le — they saddle for him (present 3rd pl. in the narrative present + enclitic le; ensiéllanle a Bavieca 'they saddle Bavieca for him'; = le ensillan; ensillar)
glossary.echavan: echar — they were putting, throwing on (imperfect 3rd pl.; cuberturas le echavan 'they put the caparisons on him'; = echaban)
glossary.fuste: fuste — wood, a wooden shaft, lance (Latin fustis; armas de fuste 'arms of wood', lances for the display; = fuste)
glossary.ésta: ésta — this (fem. demonstrative pronoun, accented in Pidal's print; ésta fo tan estraña 'this was so extraordinary'; = ésta)
glossary.corrido: correr — run (past part.; quando ovo corrido 'when he had run'; = corrido)
glossary.maravillavan: maravillar — they marveled (imperfect 3rd pl., with se, maravillarse 'to marvel'; todos se maravillavan 'all marveled'; = maravillaban)
glossary.des: des — from (des día 'from that day', short for desde aquel día; des = desde; = desde) · also des — of that (de + es, es the shortened ese; ques pague des casamiento 'that he be pleased with that marriage'; = de ese)
glossary.preçió: preçiar — he was esteemed (preterite 3rd sg., with se 'became prized, famous'; se preçió Bavieca 'Bavieca became famous'; = fue apreciado; modern se preció would mean 'prided himself') · also preçiar — he valued, praised (active, with personal a; allí preçió a Bavieca 'there he prized Bavieca'; = apreció, valoró)
glossary.quant: quant — as much as, how far (apocopated quanto, with grant; en quant grant fo España 'throughout the whole extent of Spain'; = cuan, cuanto)
glossary.cosso: cosso — course, run, racing ground (Latin cursus; en cabo del cosso 'at the end of the course'; = coso, now mainly 'bullring')
glossary.merced: merced — mercy, favor, grace (noun; Merced, Campeador 'mercy, thanks, Campeador', the word of a suppliant or of thanks; = merced)
glossary.sacada: sacar — rescued, taken out (past part. fem. sg. agreeing with me; Sacada me avedes 'you have rescued me'; = sacada)
glossary.vergüenças: vergüença — shame, disgrace, affronts (fem. pl.; vergüenças malas 'bad affronts'; = vergüenzas)
glossary.afeme: afe + me — behold me, here I am (afe presentative + me, as afevos; afeme aquí 'here I am'; = heme aquí)
glossary.criadas: criar — brought up, reared, well bred (past part. fem. pl.; buenas son e criadas 'they are good and well brought up'; = criadas)
glossary.abraçava: abraçar — he was embracing (imperfect 3rd sg.; = abrazaba)
glossary.avíen: aver — they had (imperfect 3rd pl. in -íen, full verb 'to have, feel'; del gozo que avíen 'from the joy they felt'; = tenían, habían)
