glossary.deleyt: deleyt — delight, pleasure, festivity (en grant deleyt 'in great delight'; = deleite)
glossary.tenien: tener — they held; with armas, they played at arms (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ién; armas tenien 'they played at arms', Pidal 'jugaban las armas'; = tenían) · also tener 'hold, reckon' (commo ellos tenien 'as they reckoned it', imperfect 3rd pl.; = tenían, pensaban)
glossary.tablados: tablado — a little castle of boards set up as a target, which knights struck with their lances to bring it down (pl.; tablados crebantavan 'they broke down the board castles'; Pidal 'castillejo de tablas'; = tablado, now 'stage, platform')
glossary.crebantavan: crebantar — they were breaking (imperfect 3rd pl.; the cr and the van Pidal's: [cr]ebanta[van]; = quebrantaban)
glossary.querida: querer — beloved (past part. fem. sg. used as adj.; querida mugier 'beloved wife'; = querida)
glossary.besavan: besar — they were kissing (imperfect 3rd pl.; las manos le besavan 'they kissed his hands'; = besaban)
glossary.subie: subir — he was taking up (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ie, transitive; allá las subie 'he took them up there'; = las subía)
glossary.vellidos: vellido — beautiful, lovely (adjective, masc. pl.; ojos vellidos 'lovely eyes'; = bellido (archaic), hermoso)
glossary.catan: catar — they look at, gaze (present 3rd pl.; ojos … catan a todas partes 'eyes look in every direction'; = miran; modern catar means 'to taste, sample')
glossary.miran: mirar — they look at, gaze on (present 3rd pl.; miran Valençia 'they gaze on Valencia'; = miran)
glossary.yaze: yazer — it lies, is situated (present 3rd sg.; cómmo yaze la çibdad 'how the city lies'; = yace)
glossary.huerta: huerta — irrigated garden land, orchard-plain (fem.; miran la huerta 'they look on the huerta'; = huerta)
glossary.espessa: espesso — dense, thick, lush (adjective, fem. sg.; espessa es e grand 'it is thick and large'; = espesa)
glossary.alçan: alçar — they raise, lift (present 3rd pl.; alçan las manos 'they raise their hands'; = alzan)
glossary.allent: allent — beyond, on the far side of (apocopated allende; de alle[n]t partes del mar 'from beyond the sea'; = allende; also in d'allent mar)
glossary.yúcef: Yúcef — Yusuf, the king of Morocco in the poem, the Almoravid emperor (Pidal: 'emperador almorávide'; Arabic Yūsuf; = Yusuf)
glossary.pesól: pesar + le — it grieved him (preterite 3rd sg. pesó + enclitic dative le, reduced to -l; Pesól al rey 'it grieved the king'; = le pesó)
glossary.gradeçe: gradeçer — he thanks, is grateful (present 3rd sg.; non gelo gradeçe sinon a Jesu Cristo 'he thanks no one but Jesus Christ for it'; = agradece)
glossary.ajuntava: ajuntar — he was gathering, assembling (imperfect 3rd sg.; ajuntava sus virtos 'he was gathering his forces'; = juntaba)
glossary.vezes: vez — time, occasion (fem. pl.; çinquaenta vezes mill 'fifty times a thousand'; = veces)
glossary.conplidos: conplido — complete, full (past part. used as adjective, masc. pl.; todos foron conplidos 'all were complete, at full strength'; = cumplidos, completos; the exact sense is somewhat uncertain)
glossary.barcas: barca — boat, ship's boat (fem. pl.; en las barcas 'in the boats'; = barcas)
glossary.metidos: meter — put, set, embarked (past part. masc. pl. with son; en las barcas son metidos 'they have got into the boats'; = metidos)
glossary.arribado: arribar — arrived, come to shore (past part., invariable, in the perfect with an; Arribado an las naves 'the ships have come to land', naves the subject; = arribado, llegado)
glossary.conquista: conquistar — conquered (short past part. fem. sg., = conquistada, agreeing with la, i.e. Valençia; la que mio Çid a conquista 'the one my Cid has conquered'; compare conquistas = conquistadas, v. 1093; = ha conquistado; the likelier reading, the noun conquista 'conquest' not ruled out)
glossary.posan: posar — they lodge, settle, encamp (present 3rd pl.; posan las yentes descreidas 'the unbelieving host encamps'; = se alojan, acampan; modern posar 'to rest, to pose')
glossary.descreidas: descreído — unbelieving, infidel (past part. used as adjective, fem. pl.; yentes descreidas 'the unbelieving peoples', i.e. the Moors; = descreídas, incrédulas)
glossary.venidas: venir — come (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with nuevas, with ser; Estas nuevas … eran venidas 'this news had come'; = venidas)
glossary.espirital: espirital — spiritual (adjective; el Padre espirital 'the spiritual Father'; = espiritual; variant of spirital)
glossary.afán: afán — toil, hardship, labor (masc. noun; con afán gané 'with toil I won'; = afán)
glossary.muert: muert — death (apocopated muerte; a menos de muert 'short of death'; = muerte)
glossary.puodo: poder — could, was able (strong preterite, the shape of the 3rd sg., = pudo; here in the Çid's mouth, 'I could': no la puodo dexar 'I could not leave her'; an odd form, the reading not certain)
glossary.venídom: venir + me — come to me (past part. venido + enclitic dative me, reduced to -m, the accent marking the stress; Venídom es deliçio 'delight has come to me'; ser as perfect auxiliary; = me ha venido)
glossary.podré: poder — I shall be able (future 1st sg.; non lo podré dexar 'I shall not be able to leave it'; = podré)
glossary.veerme: veer + me — to see me (infinitive + enclitic me, first half of the split future ve[e]rme an 'they will see me'; = me verán; ver)
glossary.agenas: ageno — foreign, another's, strange (adjective, fem. pl.; en estas tierras agenas 'in these foreign lands'; = ajenas)
glossary.verán: veer — they will see (future 3rd pl.; verán las moradas 'they will see the dwellings'; = verán)
glossary.moradas: morada — dwelling, abode (fem. pl., from morar 'to dwell'; verán las moradas cómmo se fazen 'they will see how the dwellings are made'; = moradas; the exact sense here, 'dwellings' or 'how one makes one's dwelling', is uncertain)
glossary.afarto: afarto — abundantly, to the full, one's fill (adverb, a + farto = harto; afarto verán por los ojos 'they will see their fill with their eyes'; = hasta hartarse, de sobra)
glossary.gana: ganar — he wins, earns (present 3rd sg.; with se, passive 'is earned': cómmo se gana el pan 'how bread is earned'; = gana)
glossary.subiólas: subir + las — he took them up (preterite 3rd sg. subió + enclitic las; subiólas al alcáçer 'he took them up to the citadel'; = las subió)
glossary.alçavan: alçar — they were raising (imperfect 3rd pl.; alçavan los ojos 'they raised their eyes'; = alzaban)
glossary.quês: qué + es — what is (qué 'what' with es run together; ¿Quês esto? 'What is this?'; = ¿qué es?)
glossary.acreçe: acreçer — it increases, accrues (present 3rd sg., intransitive with dative nos; Riqueza es que nos acreçe 'it is wealth that accrues to us'; = acrece; modern acrecer is literary)
glossary.viniestes: venir — you came (preterite 2nd pl., old -stes ending; a poco que viniestes 'a little after you came'; = vinisteis)
glossary.presend: presend — gift, present (masc. noun, apocopated form of presente, with final -d; presend vos quieren dar 'they wish to give you a present'; = presente, regalo)
glossary.casar: casar — to marry off, to be married (infinitive; por casar son vuestras fijas 'your daughters are to be married'; por + inf. 'still to be done'; = casar) · also casar — to marry (infinitive, active, of the suitors; casar queremos con ellas 'we wish to marry them'; = casar)
glossary.adúzenvos: aduzir + vos — they bring you (present 3rd pl. adúzen + enclitic dative vos; adúzenvos axuvar 'they bring you a trousseau'; = os traen; modern aducir 'to adduce')
glossary.axuvar: axuvar — trousseau, the bride's household goods (Arabic; adúzenvos axuvar 'they bring you the trousseau', Pidal 'os traen el ajuar para el casamiento'; = ajuar)
glossary.veades: veer — you may see (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; por que me veades lidiar 'because you see me fight'; = veáis)
glossary.créçem: creçer + me — it grows in me (present 3rd sg. créçe + enclitic me, dative of the possessor; créçem el coraçón 'my heart swells'; = me crece el corazón)
glossary.fincadas: fincar — planted, fixed in the ground (past part. fem. pl.; fincadas son las tiendas 'the tents are pitched'; = hincadas, clavadas)
glossary.tañién: tañer — they were sounding, playing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién ending; = tañían)
glossary.alegravas: alegrar + se — he rejoiced, was glad (imperfect 3rd sg. alegrava with the reflexive se run on; = se alegraba)
glossary.quiérel: querer + le — wants, is about to (present 3rd sg. quiere + dative le 'her'; querer + inf. 'to be about to'; quiérel crebar el coraçón 'her heart is about to break'; = se le quiere quebrar)
glossary.ffazie: fazer — it did, was so (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie ending; doubled ff a spelling only; assí ffazie a las dueñas 'so it did to the ladies', the same fear took them; = hacía)
glossary.nasquieran: nascer — they had been born (3rd pl. in -ra, old pluperfect indicative sense; del día que nasquieran 'since the day they were born'; = habían nacido)
glossary.vidieran: veer — they had seen (3rd pl. in -ra, old pluperfect indicative sense; = habían visto, vieran)
glossary.prisos: prender + se — he took hold of (strong preterite 3rd sg. priso + reflexive se; prisos a la barba 'he took himself by the beard'; = se asió, se tomó)
glossary.pondrán: poner — they will put, set (future 3rd pl.; = pondrán)
glossary.quáles: qual — what sort, which (pl., interrogative/relative; veredes quáles son 'you will see what they are like'; = cuáles)
glossary.sseer: seer — to be (infinitive, doubled s- spelling; = ser); an a sse[e]r 'they are to be' (aver a + inf.; = serán)
glossary.colgar: colgar — to hang (infinitive; colgar los han 'they will hang them', split future; = los colgarán)
glossary.vocaçión: vocaçión — vow, votive offering (from Latin vocatio 'a calling'; vocaçión es que fizo 'it is a vow that he made'; most likely sense, rare word, not certain; closest voto)
glossary.perdiendo: perder — losing (gerund; perdiendo van el pavor 'they go on losing their fear'; = perdiendo)
glossary.vigor: vigor — vigour, force; a vigor 'swiftly' (Pidal 'con presteza'; cavalgan a vigor 'they ride swiftly'; = con presteza)
glossary.adentro: adentro — inside, within (adverb; por las huertas adentro 'right into the orchards'; = adentro)
glossary.vidolo: veer + lo — he saw it/him (strong preterite 3rd sg. vido + object lo; = lo vio)
glossary.atalaya: atalaya — watchman, lookout (also the watchtower; here the sentinel; = atalaya)
glossary.tanxo: tañer — he rang, sounded (strong preterite 3rd sg., x = sh-sound; tanxo el esquila 'rang the bell'; = tañó)
glossary.esquila: esquila — small bell, alarm bell (= esquila)
glossary.prestas: presto — ready (fem. pl.; prestas son las mesnadas 'the troops are ready'; = prestas, listas)
glossary.adóbanse: adobar + se — they get ready, equip themselves (present 3rd pl. + reflexive; = se aprestan, se arman)
glossary.cometiénlos: cometer + los — they were attacking them (imperfect 3rd pl. cometién, -ién ending, + object los; = los acometían)
glossary.sácanlos: sacar + los — they drive them out, take them out (present 3rd pl. + object los; = los sacan)
glossary.fea: feo — ugly, foul (fem.; a fea guisa 'in a sorry, shameful fashion'; = fea)
glossary.dura: durar — it lasts, goes on (present 3rd sg.; = dura)
glossary.comién: comer — they ate (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién ending; los que comién so pan 'those who ate his bread'; = comían)
glossary.cuéntangelo: contar + ge + lo — they tell him it (present 3rd pl. + dative ge, = le before lo, + object lo; = se lo cuentan)
glossary.prieta: prieto — dark (fem.; por la mañana prieta, Pidal 'cerca del amanecer', in the dark before dawn; 'close, tight' also possible; = prieta, oscura)
glossary.soltura: soltura — absolution (lit. 'loosing', from soltar; Pidal 'absolución de pecados'; = absolución)
glossary.penssad: pensar — think, set your mind to (imperative 2nd pl.; penssad de cavalgar 'make ready to ride'; = pensad)
glossary.fferir: ferir — to strike, attack (infinitive, doubled f-; ir los hemos fferir 'we will go and strike them'; = herir)
glossary.passará: passar — it will pass (future 3rd sg.; non passará por al 'it will not be otherwise'; = pasará)
glossary.vezcamos: vençer — we may conquer (present subjunctive 1st pl., -zc- form; que nos los vezcamos 'that we conquer them'; = venzamos)
glossary.cojan: coger — they may gather, harvest (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; cojan el pan 'gather the grain'; = cojan, recojan)
glossary.damor: de + amor — of love, with affection (damor e de voluntad 'with love and good will, gladly'; = de amor)
glossary.queredes: querer — you wish (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = queréis)
glossary.dadme: dar + me — give me (imperative 2nd pl. dad + enclitic me; = dadme)
glossary.entrada: entrar — entered, come (past part. fem. sg.; la noch es entrada 'night has fallen'; = entrada)
glossary.adobasse: adobar + se — to get oneself ready, arm (infinitive adobar + reflexive se, the r assimilated to the s; = adobarse)
glossary.cantava: cantar — he sang, was singing (imperfect 3rd sg.; la missa les cantava 'he was singing the mass for them'; = cantaba)
glossary.sultura: sultura — absolution (variant spelling of soltura, as printed; = absolución)
glossary.muriere: morir — (whoever) shall die (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; el que muriere 'he who dies'; = muriere, now muera)
glossary.préndol: prender + le — I take from him (present 1st sg. prendo + dative le; préndol yo los pecados 'I take his sins from him', I absolve him; = le quito)
glossary.pídovos: pedir + vos — I ask you (present 1st sg. pido + object vos; = os pido)
glossary.dona: dona — gift, boon (fem., from Latin dona, plural of donum; pídovos una dona 'I ask a gift of you'; = don, dádiva)
glossary.seam: seer + me — may it be to me (present subjunctive 3rd sg. sea + dative me; seam presentada 'let it be granted me'; = séame, me sea)
glossary.presentada: presentar — presented, granted (past part. fem. sg.; = presentada)
glossary.feridas: ferida — blow, wound (fem. pl.; las feridas primeras 'the first blows'; = heridas)
glossary.otorgadas: otorgar — granted (past part. fem. pl.; = otorgadas)
glossary.desaquí: desaquí — from here on, henceforth (des + aquí; = desde aquí)
glossary.mandadas: mandar — ordered, granted (past part. fem. pl.; vos sean mandadas 'let them be granted to you'; = mandadas)
glossary.salidos: salir — gone out, sallied forth (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; salidos son 'have gone out'; = salidos)
glossary.quarto: Quarto — Cuarte (Valencian Cuart), a place at the fourth milestone (Latin quartum) of the road from Valencia toward Castile; las torres de Quarto, Pidal: the towers on either side of the gate in Valencia's wall that opens on the road to Cuart (place name, restored by Pidal; = Cuarte)
glossary.guarnizones: guarnizón — armor, equipment, trappings (fem. pl.; = guarniciones, 'fittings, harness'; modern guarnición is mainly 'garrison, trimming')
glossary.adobado: adobar — fitted out, equipped, armed (past part. masc.; es adobado 'is fully equipped'; = equipado, arreglado; modern adobar means 'to marinate, tan')
glossary.vanlos: ir + los — they go (to) them (van, present 3rd pl., + enclitic los 'them'; vanlos ferir 'they go to strike them'; = los van a herir)
glossary.alvaroz: Alvaroz — Álvarez (patronymic, 'son of Álvaro', the -oz restored by Pidal; Álvar Alvaroz = Álvar Álvarez, one of the Cid's knights; = Álvarez)
glossary.entráronles: entrar + les — they attacked them (preterite 3rd pl. entraron + enclitic les 'them'; entrar a uno 'to charge, break in on'; = les entraron, 'les atacaron')
glossary.arrancarlos: arrancar + los — to rout them (infinitive + enclitic los, 'to drive them off'; = derrotarlos, ahuyentarlos; modern arrancar 'to pull up, start')
glossary.enpleó: enplear — he used, used up (preterite 3rd sg.; enpleó la lança 'he used his lance' until it broke, Pidal 'usó la lanza'; = empleó)
glossary.atantos: atanto — so many (masc. pl.; tanto with a prefixed a-, not the preposition; atantos mata de moros 'he kills so many Moors'; = tantos)
glossary.saliósle: salir + se + le — he got away from him (preterite 3rd sg. salió + reflexive se + dative le 'from him'; saliósle del sol espada 'he slipped out from under his sword'; = se le salió, se le escapó)
glossary.andido: andar — it ran, went (strong preterite 3rd sg., Old Spanish andido/andude type; = anduvo; the horse 'ran' freely, escaping)
glossary.metiósle: meter + se + le — he got himself in, took refuge (preterite 3rd sg. metió + reflexive se + dative le; metiósle en Gujera 'he got away into Gujera'; = se le metió, 'se metió')
glossary.palaçiano: palaçiano — of a palace, stately, grand (adj. masc.; castiello palaçiano 'a palatial castle'; = palaciego, closest 'señorial, palaciego')
glossary.alcanço: alcanço — pursuit, chase (noun; llegar en alcanço 'to come up in pursuit'; = alcance, 'persecución'; the editor's restoration alca[nço])
glossary.consiguen: conseguir — they follow, keep up with, overtake (present 3rd pl., in the old sense of Latin consequi; quel consiguen 'who keep up with him'; = siguen, alcanzan; modern conseguir is 'to obtain')
glossary.desd: desde — from, since (the final -e dropped before a vowel; Desd' allí 'from there'; = desde)
glossary.caçado: caçar — taken, caught (past part.; lo que an caçado 'what they have taken'; Pidal: caçar is 'coger' in general, Latin captare, captiare, not yet narrowed to hunting; = cogido, ganado)
glossary.rastado: rastar — remained (past part. with a = ha; Pidal 'quedar': a rastado 'it has remained (his)', ha quedado por suya; = quedado)
glossary.fuero: seer/ir — they were (preterite 3rd pl. fueron, with the final -n elided, fuero'; fuero' notados 'were noted'; = fueron)
glossary.notados: notar — noted, recorded, counted (past part. masc. pl.; = notados, 'anotados, contados'; modern notar is mainly 'to notice')
glossary.desarmado: desarmar — unarmed, with his defensive arms off (past part. as adj.; que era desarmado 'for he was unarmed': Pidal, he had taken off helmet and mail hood, as was done when fighting stopped; = desarmado)
glossary.reçibienlo: reçebir + lo — they received him (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ien, 'were receiving', + enclitic lo; = lo recibían)
glossary.antellas: ante + ellas — before them (fem.) (preposition ante + pronoun ellas, joined; fincó antellas 'he stopped before them'; = ante ellas)
glossary.omillo: omillar — I humble myself, bow (present 1st sg. with reflexive me; a vos me omillo 'I bow before you'; = me humillo)
glossary.prez: prez — honor, renown, glory (masc./fem. noun, Latin pretium; grant prez 'great honor'; = prez, a literary word; closest honra, fama)
glossary.sudiento: sudiento — sweaty, in a lather (adj. masc. sg.; = sudoroso; no exact modern form)
glossary.cum: cum — as, like (spelling of como, Latin quomodo; con tal cum esto 'with such as this'; = como)
glossary.vençen: vençer — they are defeated (present 3rd pl., passive-reflexive se vençen; = se vencen); also 'they conquer'
glossary.viba: bivir — may (I/he) live (present subjunctive 1st or 3rd sg., optative; que vos viba algunt año 'that I may live (for you) some years'; = viva; b/v spellings alternate)
glossary.algunt: algún — some (apocopated form before a noun, the -t a graphic variant; algunt año 'some year', a few years; = algún)
glossary.entraredes: entrar — you will enter (future 2nd pl.; entraredes en prez 'you will enter into honor'; = entraréis)
glossary.besarán: besar — they will kiss (future 3rd pl.; = besarán)
glossary.diçiendo: deçir — getting down, dismounting (gerund; diçiendo del cavallo 'getting down from the horse', Pidal 'apeándose'; Latin descendere, a different verb from dezir 'to say'; = descendiendo, apeándose)
glossary.descavalgado: descavalgar — dismounted (past part. masc., with era; = descabalgado, desmontado)
glossary.buelta: buelta — turn, throng, company (noun; en buelta con él 'in a body with him, together with him'; = vuelta; modern vuelta 'turn, return')
glossary.preçiosos: preçioso — precious, costly, fine (adj. masc. pl.; = preciosos)
glossary.escaños: escaño — bench, long seat (masc. pl.; = escaños)
glossary.nom: non + me — not … me (non with enclitic me, the -e dropped; nom lo aviedes rogado 'had you not asked me for it'; = no me)
glossary.aviedes: aver — you had (imperfect 2nd pl., -iedes; aviedes rogado 'you had asked', pluperfect auxiliary; = habíais)
glossary.rogado: rogar — asked, begged (past part.; lo aviedes rogado 'you had asked for it'; = rogado)
glossary.aduxiestes: aduzir — you brought (strong preterite 2nd pl.; = trajisteis; modern aducir means 'to adduce')
glossary.quiérolas: querer + las — I want them (quiero, present 1st sg., + enclitic las; quiérolas casar 'I wish to marry them off'; = las quiero casar)
glossary.doles: dar + les — I give them (do, 1st sg. present of dar, + enclitic les 'to them'; = les doy)
glossary.quién: quién — whom, who (interrogative/relative; a quién sirvieron tanto 'whom they served so well'; = quién)
glossary.espacio: espacio — leisure, time, slowness (noun; por espacio 'at leisure, in good time, later'; = espacio; modern espacio 'space')
glossary.levantáronse: levantar + se — they got up (preterite 3rd pl. levantaron + reflexive se; = se levantaron)
glossary.acabado: acabar — finished, carried out (past part.; lo han acabado 'they have carried it out'; = acabado)
glossary.preçiados: preçiado — valuable, precious (adj. masc. pl.; from preçiar; = preciados) · also preçiados — esteemed, held in honour, of men (adelant serán preçiados 'hereafter they will be esteemed'; = apreciados)
glossary.sobejano: sobejano — superabundant, very great (adj. masc.; from sobejo 'excess'; tanto … que es sobejano 'so much that it is beyond measure'; no modern equivalent, closest sobrado, abundantísimo)
glossary.granado: granado — outstanding, notable, remarkable (adj. masc.; lo que es más granado 'what is most remarkable'; = granado, 'notable'; modern granado also 'pomegranate tree')
glossary.arriados: arriar — in harness, in their trappings (past part. masc. pl., = arreados, Pidal's word; andan arriados 'they run about in harness', of riderless horses; the sense is not certain: arrear also 'to drive (beasts)')
glossary.tomallos: tomar + los — to take them (infinitive tomar + enclitic los, rl assimilated to ll; = tomarlos)
glossary.otorgados: otorgar — approved, warranted (past part. masc. pl.; de los buenos e otorgados 'of the good and approved ones', most likely horses passed as sound; the shade is not certain; = aprobados)
glossary.cayéronle: caer + le — they fell to him (preterite 3rd pl. cayeron + enclitic le; = le cayeron, 'le tocaron en suerte')
glossary.preciada: preçiado — valuable, fine (adj. fem. sg.; = preciada)
glossary.tendal: tendal — tent-pole (sg.; tendal obrado 'a worked tent-pole', Pidal: a pole with ornament, inlay and precious stones, silver or gold; = poste de la tienda)
glossary.obrado: obrar — worked, wrought, decorated (past part. masc.; = obrado, labrado)
glossary.sufren: sufrir — they bear, support (present 3rd pl.; = sufren; modern sufrir 'to suffer')
glossary.labrados: labrar — worked, wrought (past part. masc. pl.; con oro son labrados 'are worked with gold'; = labrados)
glossary.sovisse: seer — it should stay, remain (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., Latin sedere; Pidal: a dialect form of soviese, from seder; fita sovisse 'quedase plantada', 'should stay pitched'; = estuviese)
glossary.tolliesse: toller — he should take away, remove (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quitase; the verb toller no longer exists, closest quitar)
glossary.croviesse: creer — he should believe, credit (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., strong form; = creyese)
glossary.farto: farto — sated, weary, having had enough (adj. masc.; farto de lidiar 'weary of fighting'; = harto)
glossary.matados: matar — killed (past part. masc. pl.; los moros que ha matados 'the Moors he has killed'; = matados)
glossary.cadié: caer — it fell, came (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ié of the old form cader; lo que cadié a él 'what fell to his share'; = caía, le tocaba)
glossary.diezmo: diezmo — tenth, tithe (masc. noun; = diezmo; here the tenth part of the Cid's fifth)
glossary.casadas: casar — married, settled in marriage (past part. fem. pl.; tener por casadas 'to count themselves married'; = casadas)
glossary.cadió: caer — fell, fell to one's lot (preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal's ca[d]ió; = cayó)
glossary.gradeçedes: gradecer — you thank, are grateful for (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = agradecéis)
glossary.dígovos: dezir + vos — I tell you (present 1st sg. digo + enclitic vos; = os digo)
glossary.remanga: remanir (also remaner) — let it remain (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quede)
glossary.dond: dond — where (apocopated donde, Latin de unde; = donde)
glossary.pagadas: pagar — satisfied, content (past part. fem. pl.; = pagadas, closest contentas)
glossary.presentajas: presentaja — gift, present (fem. pl.; en presentajas 'as gifts'; = presentes, regalos)
glossary.díga: dezir — may he say (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = diga)
glossary.lievan: levar — they carry, take along (present 3rd pl., with the diphthong ie; = llevan)
glossary.besava: besar — he kissed, was kissing (imperfect 3rd sg.; = besaba)
glossary.enbiava: enbiar — he was sending (imperfect 3rd sg.; = enviaba)
glossary.ovisse: aver — I should have, he should have (imperfect subjunctive 1st/3rd sg., here 1st: mientra que ovisse el alma 'as long as I have the soul (in me)'; Pidal: a dialect form for oviesse; = hubiese, hubiera)
glossary.valladolid: Valladolid — Valladolid, the Castilian city (= Valladolid)
glossary.enviávale: enviar + le — he was sending him (imperfect 3rd sg. enviava + enclitic le, 'to him'; = le enviaba)
glossary.mandasse: mandar — he might order (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = mandase)
glossary.mensajes: mensaje — messenger, envoy; also message (pl.; estos mensajes 'these messengers'; = mensajeros, mensajes)
glossary.ifantes: infante — young nobleman, son of a noble house (pl., spelt Ifantes; = infantes)
glossary.carrion: Carrión — Carrión de los Condes, town in Palencia (= Carrión)
glossary.is: i + se — there ... themselves (i, adverb 'there', Latin ibi, + reflexive se; = allí se)
glossary.açertaron: açertar(se) — they happened to be (present), chanced to be there (preterite 3rd pl.; with is = i se: is açertaron 'there happened to be'; = se hallaron, se encontraron)
glossary.garcia: García — García, a personal name (the count García of the poem, Garci Ordóñez; = García)
glossary.cuédanse: cuedar + se — they think, suppose (present 3rd pl. cuedan + enclitic se; cuedar = cuidar, 'to think'; = se creen, piensan)
glossary.seíse: seer + se — he was (imperfect 3rd sg. seíe, its final e lost before the enclitic se; seer + gerund = estar + gerund; the se goes with the gerund: seíse santiguando 'was crossing himself'; = se estaba santiguando)
glossary.santiguando: santiguar — crossing (oneself), making the sign of the cross (gerund; santiguarse; = santiguando)
glossary.firiéronse: ferir + se — they threw themselves down, dismounted (preterite 3rd pl. firieron + enclitic se; ferirse a tierra, Pidal 'echar pie a tierra', 'to get down to the ground'; = echaron pie a tierra)
glossary.diçieron: deçir — they went down, dismounted (preterite 3rd pl.; Pidal's di[ç]ieron; OS deçir, Latin descendere; = descendieron)
glossary.antel: ante + el — before the (preposition ante + article el; = ante el)
glossary.inoios: inojos — knees (masc. pl.; = hinojos; Pidal's spelling inoios)
glossary.fincados: fincar — planted, set down (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with inojos; los inojos fincados 'knees on the ground'; = hincados)
glossary.tienes: tener + se — he holds himself (present 3rd sg. tiene + reflexive se, the e of se run into tiene; tener por 'to consider as'; = se tiene) · also tener — you hold, have (present 2nd sg.; espada tienes en mano 'you hold a sword in hand'; = tienes)
glossary.yúceff: Yúceff — Yúsuf, the name of the Moorish king of Marruecos (= Yúsuf)
glossary.nombrado: nombrar — named, called (past part. masc. sg.; = nombrado)
glossary.venidos: venir — come, become (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; ricos son venidos 'have become rich'; = venidos)
glossary.embíavos: enbiar + vos — he sends you (present 3rd sg. enbía + enclitic vos; = os envía)
glossary.reçíbolos: recebir + los — I receive them (present 1st sg. reçibo + enclitic los; = los recibo)
glossary.enbiado: enbiar — sent (past part. masc. sg.; = enviado)
glossary.maravilla: maravilla — wonder, marvel (noun; = maravilla) · also aver a maravilla — to marvel at, hold a wonder (a maravilla lo han 'they marvel at it')
glossary.seremos: seer — we shall be (future 1st pl.; = seremos)
glossary.abiltados: abiltar — shamed, dishonored (past part. masc. pl., from abiltar 'to dishonor', cf. vil; seremos abiltados 'we shall be dishonored'; = envilecidos)
glossary.biltadamientre: biltadamientre — easily, without effort (Pidal 'fácilmente, sin esfuerzo'); literally 'basely, cheaply', adverb in -mientre from the stem of abiltar, 'to debase' (= fácilmente)
glossary.fallasse: fallar — he might find (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = hallase)
glossary.aduzirse: aduzir + se — to bring away for oneself (infinitive + enclitic dative se; aduzirse los cavallos 'to carry off the horses for himself'; = aducir, closest traerse)
glossary.enbargo: enbargo — hindrance, trouble, harm (noun; aver enbargo 'to come to harm, be hindered'; = embargo, closest estorbo, daño)
glossary.mándovos: mandar + vos — I order you (present 1st sg. mando + enclitic vos; = os mando)
glossary.cuorpos: cuerpo — body (masc. pl., old diphthong uo; = cuerpos)
glossary.ondradamientre: ondradamientre — honorably, with honor (adverb in -mientre from ondrado; = honradamente)
glossary.guarnirvos: guarnir + vos — to equip you (infinitive + enclitic vos; guarnir 'to equip, outfit'; = guarneceros)
glossary.dixiéredes: dezir — you shall say (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; = dijereis, tense obsolete)
glossary.parescades: parecer — may you look, appear (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; = parezcáis)
glossary.prendedlos: prender + los — take them! (imperative 2nd pl. prended + enclitic los; = prendedlos, closest tomadlos)
glossary.demandemos: demandar — let us ask for (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortatory; = demandemos, closest pidamos)
glossary.vinien: venir — they were coming, came (imperfect 3rd pl.; = venían)
glossary.garcía: García — García, a personal name (the count García of the poem, Garci Ordóñez; = García)
glossary.pidimos: pedir — we ask, request (present 1st pl., with i for e; merced vos pidimos 'we ask a grace of you'; = pedimos)
glossary.demandedes: demandar — (that) you ask for, request (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending; que nos demandedes fijas 'that you ask for (his) daughters for us', nos the dative of interest; = demandéis, pidáis)
glossary.comidió: comedir — he reflected, pondered (preterite 3rd sg.; penssó e comidió 'he thought and pondered', Pidal 'pensó y meditó'; = meditó)
glossary.eché: echar — I cast out, banished (preterite 1st sg.; = eché)
glossary.faziendo: fazer — doing (gerund; faziendo yo a él mal 'I doing him harm', a gerund clause with its own subject; = haciendo)
glossary.casamiento: casamiento — marriage, match, wedding alliance (= casamiento)
glossary.bos: vos — you (spelling variant with b for v; here subject, bos lo queredes 'you wish it')
glossary.entremos: entrar — let us enter (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortatory; entrar en la razón 'to take up the matter'; = entremos)
glossary.llamó: llamar — he called, summoned (preterite 3rd sg.; = llamó)
glossary.quadra: quadra — chamber, private room (= cuadra, here a side room of the palace)
glossary.apartó: apartar — he drew aside (preterite 3rd sg.; los apartó 'he took them apart'; = apartó)
glossary.sírvem: servir + me — serves me (present 3rd sg. sirve + enclitic me, dative; mio Çid is the subject: sírvem mio Çid 'my Cid serves me'; = me sirve)
glossary.roi: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (spelling variant of Roy; Roi Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
glossary.viniéssem: venir + me — let him come to me (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. viniesse + enclitic me reduced to -m, a wish; viniéssem a vistas, Pidal 'venga a vistas conmigo'; = me viniese, viniese a mí)
glossary.vistas: vistas — meeting, interview of persons (fem. pl. noun; a vistas 'to a meeting'; = vistas, entrevista)
glossary.didago: Didago — Diego (Diego González, one of the two infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
glossary.ferrando: Ferrando — Fernando (Fernando González, the other infante of Carrión; = Fernando)
glossary.ruégovoslo: rogar + vos + lo — I ask it of you (present 1st sg. ruego + enclitics vos, lo; = os lo ruego)
glossary.creçrá: creçer — he will grow, increase (future 3rd sg. with the e dropped; creçrá en onor 'he will grow in estate and lordship'; = crecerá)
glossary.onor: onor — estate, lordship: the lands and rank held of a lord (fem.; creçer en onor 'to grow in lands and lordship'; tollida la onor 'the estate taken away'; = honor in its old sense, heredad, señorío; distinct from ondra 'honour')
glossary.conssagrar: conssagrar — to become kin by marriage, as father-in-law to son-in-law or the reverse (infinitive; por conssagrar con iffantes 'by becoming kin to the infantes'; Pidal 'emparentar con relación de suegro a yerno'; = emparentar)
glossary.dezides: dezir — you say (present 2nd pl., old -des ending; = decís)
glossary.oviere: aver — he shall have (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; lo que oviere sabor 'whatever he may wish'; = hubiere)
glossary.dixiere: dezir — he shall say (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; do elle dixiere 'wherever he names'; = dijere)
glossary.mojón: mojón — boundary marker, landmark (= mojón, here the marker fixing the meeting-place)
glossary.espidiensse: espedir + se — they took (were taking) their leave (imperfect 3rd pl. espidien, -ien = -ían, + enclitic se; espidiensse al rey 'they took leave of the king'; = se despedían)
glossary.reçebirlos: reçebir + los — to receive them (infinitive + enclitic los; = recibirlos)
glossary.reçibió: reçebir — he received, accepted (preterite 3rd sg.; = recibió)
glossary.davos: dar + vos — he gives you (present 3rd sg. da + enclitic vos; = os da)
glossary.conpieçan: conpeçar — they begin (present 3rd pl.; conpieçan la razón 'they begin the talk'; = comienzan, empiezan)
glossary.león: León — León, the kingdom and city (Alfons el de León 'Alfonso of León'; = León) · also león — lion, the animal (masc.; saliós … el león 'the lion broke loose', adeliñó para' león 'he made straight for the lion'; = león), not the kingdom
glossary.connosçie: connosçer — he recognized, acknowledged (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ie; quel connosçie i ondra 'that he saw honour in it for him'; = conocía, reconocía)
glossary.creçrié: creçer — he would grow (conditional 3rd sg., syncopated, -ié ending; = crecería)
glossary.conssejava: conssejar — he was advising (imperfect 3rd sg.; = aconsejaba)
glossary.cristus: Cristus — Christ (nominative form in -us, Latin Christus; = Cristo)
glossary.fu: seer — I was (preterite 1st sg. fu; echado fu 'I was cast out'; = fui)
glossary.tollida: toller — taken away (past participle fem. sg., agreeing with onor; = quitada)
glossary.pidenme: pedir + me — they ask me (present 3rd pl. piden + enclitic me; = me piden)
glossary.natura: natura — birth, lineage (de grand natura 'of high birth'; = linaje, naturaleza)
glossary.çasamiento: casamiento — marriage, match (spelling variant with ç; = casamiento)
glossary.avría: aver — I would have (conditional 1st sg., syncopated; non avría sabor 'I would take no pleasure'; = habría)
glossary.fablemos: fablar — let us speak (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortatory; = hablemos)
glossary.seamos: seer — let us be (present subjunctive 1st pl.; = seamos)
glossary.afé: afé — behold, here is (presentative particle, used before a noun; afé Dios del çielo 'behold God of heaven'; = he aquí; origin uncertain) · also before a que-clause 'behold, (it is so) that' (afé que me plaz 'behold, it pleases me')
glossary.acuerde: acordar — may he bring to agreement, guide (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; que nos acuerde en lo mijor 'that he bring us to agree on the best'; = acuerde)
glossary.vernié: venir — he would come (conditional 3rd sg. in -ié, with n and r changing places: venrié > vernié; = vendría)
glossary.oviéssedes: aver — you might have (imperfect subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; do oviéssedes sabor 'where you might wish'; = hubieseis)
glossary.ye: aver — conditional auxiliary after an infinitive, 3rd sg. (ye = ie, imperfect of aver; querer vos ye 'he would want to see you'; = ía)
glossary.yedes: aver — conditional auxiliary after an infinitive, 2nd pl. (yedes = iedes; acordar vos yedes 'you would agree'; = íais)
glossary.sabidor: sabidor — one who knows, informed, in charge (= sabedor; vos seed sabidor 'you be the judge, the one who decides') · also sabidor de — acquainted with, familiar with (d' aquellos moros yo so sabidor 'I know those Moors well')
glossary.quisiesse: querer — he might wish (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quisiese)
glossary.fallássemos: fallar — we might find (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl.; = halláramos, hallásemos)
glossary.iriemos: ir — we would go (conditional 1st pl., -iemos ending; buscar lo iriemos 'we would go and seek him'; = iríamos)
glossary.darle: dar + le — to give him (infinitive + enclitic le; = darle)
glossary.ayamos: aver — let us have (present subjunctive 1st pl.; ayamos vistas 'let us hold a meeting'; = hayamos)
glossary.escrivien: escrivir — they were writing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ien ending; = escribían)
glossary.echaron: echar — they cast, laid (preterite 3rd pl.; delant le echaron las cartas 'they laid the letters before him'; = echaron)
glossary.paga: pagar — is pleased, is satisfied (present 3rd sg., reflexive se paga; de coraçón se paga 'is heartily pleased'; = se paga, se alegra) · also pagar — pleases, satisfies (present 3rd sg., transitive with object pronoun; los paga mio Çid 'mio Çid pleases/satisfies them'; = los complace)
glossary.saludadme: saludar — greet (imperative 2nd pl. + dative me 'for me, on my behalf'; saludadme a mio Çid 'give my greetings to mio Çid for me'; = saludad de mi parte)
glossary.preçiada: preçiar — prized, valued, precious (past part. as adjective, fem. sg.; tanta mula preçiada 'so many a prized mule'; = preciada)
glossary.palafré: palafré — palfrey, a riding horse for the road, not the warhorse (= palafrén)
glossary.astas: asta — shaft, staff of a lance or banner (fem. pl.; meter en astas 'to set on shafts', i.e. to mount banners; = astas)
glossary.boclados: boclado — bossed, fitted with a boss (past part. as adjective, masc. pl.; Pidal: boclados con oro 'con bloca de oro', with a boss of gold; escudos boclados 'bossed shields'; = blocados, guarnecidos con bloca)
glossary.andriandria: Andriandria — Andros, the Aegean island famed for its sendals (token of A[n]dria[n]dria, the two n's Pidal's; following Crescini, Pidal reads the manuscript's Adria as Andria, a medieval name of Andros, and gives up his earlier A[lexán]dria; the doubled form is unexplained, perhaps a misprint; çendales d' Andriandria 'sendals of Andros')
glossary.conduchos: conducho — provisions, victuals (masc. pl.; conduchos largos 'abundant provisions'; = víveres, provisiones)
glossary.aparejadas: aparejar — made ready, prepared (past part. as predicate, fem. pl.; las vistas son aparejadas 'the meeting is prepared'; = aparejadas, preparadas)
glossary.atantas: atanto — so many (fem. pl.; tanto with a- prefixed; atantas buenas conpañas 'so many good companies'; = tantas)
glossary.adebdan: adebdar — they run into debt, buy on credit (present 3rd pl.; from debda 'debt'; lo uno adebdan e lo otro pagavan 'some they bought on credit and some they paid for'; = adeudan, se endeudan)
glossary.creçer: creçer — to grow, increase (infinitive, first half of a split conditional; creçer les ya la ganançia 'would grow for them'; = crecer)
glossary.quisiessen: querer — they might wish, would wish (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; quantos quisiessen averes 'as many as might want goods'; = quisiesen)
glossary.cuemdes: cuemde — count (noble title; masc. pl., old form of conde spelled with m; in cue[mdes] the mdes is Pidal's; = condes)
glossary.podestades: podestad — magnate, lord holding an office below count (fem. noun in pl., used of people; Pidal: ricos omnes holding the government or tenure of a fortress, city or territory; = potestades)
glossary.leoneses: leonés — man of León, Leonese (masc. pl.; = leoneses)
glossary.gallizianas: galliziano — Galician (fem. pl., agreeing with mesnadas; mesnadas gallizianas 'Galician troops'; = gallegas)
glossary.castellanas: castellano — Castilian (fem. pl., used as a noun, mesnadas understood; las castellanas 'the Castilian ones'; = castellanas)
glossary.adeliñadas: adeliñar — heading straight, set on their way (past part. as predicate, fem. pl., agreeing with the mesnadas; a las vistas se van adeliñadas 'they go straight to the meeting'; = encaminadas, derechas)
glossary.detarda: detardar — he delays (present 3rd sg.; non lo detarda 'he does not delay it'; = tarda)
glossary.adobó: adobar — he prepared himself, got ready (preterite 3rd sg., reflexive se adobó; = se aderezó, se preparó)
glossary.gruessa: gruesso — big, sturdy, heavy-built (fem. sg.; tanta gruessa mula 'so many a stout mule'; = gruesa)
glossary.sazón: sazón — due season, prime condition; de sazón 'in good condition, fit' (palafré de sazón 'a palfrey in prime condition', probably; = sazón) · also sazón — time, season, period (de toda esta sazón 'in all this season'; = tiempo)
glossary.arma: arma — arm, weapon, armor (fem. sg. as collective; tanta buena arma 'so much good armor'; = arma)
glossary.colores: color — colour (pl.; vestidos son de colores 'are dressed in colours', i.e. in bright, fine cloth; = colores)
glossary.á: á — to, at (Pidal's accented spelling of the preposition a; mandó á Mont Mayor 'he held Montemayor'; = a)
glossary.galind: Galind — personal name (Galind Garçiaz, the Cid's knight from Aragon, Galín Garciaz elsewhere; = Galindo)
glossary.garçiaz: Garçiaz — patronymic 'son of García' (Galind Garçiaz; spelling with ç beside garciaz; = Garcés)
glossary.adoban: adobar — they prepare themselves, get ready (present 3rd pl., reflexive se adoban; se adoban por ir 'they get ready to go'; = se aderezan)
glossary.curien: curiar — (that) they guard, look after (present subjunctive 3rd pl. after mandó que; que curien a Valencia 'that they guard Valencia'; = cuiden, guarden)
glossary.corazón: corazón — heart (spelling variant of coraçón; d' alma e de corazón 'with soul and heart', i.e. with all their might; = corazón)
glossary.dessos: de + essos — of, under those (preposition de + demonstrative essos masc. pl.; en poder dessos 'in the power of those'; = de esos)
glossary.recabdado: recabdar — arranged, secured, taken care of (past part. in the perfect recabdado ha; = ha recaudado, ha dispuesto)
glossary.puode: poder — can (present 3rd sg., with the old diphthong uo, the o Pidal's in pu[o]de; una salir non puode 'not one (woman) can go out', Pidal 'que ninguna puede salir'; = puede)
glossary.torne: tornar — (until) he return (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; fata ques torne 'until he returns'; = vuelva)
glossary.salien: salir — they were leaving, came out (imperfect 3rd pl. in -ién; Salien de Valençia 'they were leaving Valencia'; = salían)
glossary.aguijan: aguijar — they spur on, hasten (present 3rd pl.; = aguijan, espolean)
glossary.gañara: gañar — he had won (pluperfect indicative in -ra; se los gañara 'he had won them for himself'; = ganar; se los había ganado)
glossary.ge: ge — to him, to her, to them (old dative pronoun before lo, la, los, las, where modern Spanish has se; non ge los dieran en don 'they had not given them to him as a gift'; = se)
glossary.hyas: hyas — hya + se, now … off (hya = ya with h-, + reflexive se glued on; Hyas va 'now he goes off'; = ya se)
glossary.paró: parar — he agreed, arranged (preterite 3rd sg.; Pidal: 'convino, concertó'; las vistas que con el rey paró 'the meeting he arranged with the king'; = acordó, concertó) · also pararse — to halt, take one's stand (ante mio Çid se paró 'drew up before my Çid'; = se detuvo, se plantó)
glossary.salen: salir — they come out, go out (present 3rd pl.; reçebir lo salen 'they come out to welcome him'; = salen)
glossary.firió: ferir — he struck (preterite 3rd sg.; a tierras firió 'he came down to the ground', dismounted, Pidal 'echó pie a tierra'; = hirió)
glossary.comidía: comedir — he was thinking of, had in mind, planned (imperfect 3rd sg., -ía; commo lo comidía 'as he had planned it', Pidal 'como pensaba', 'como había dispuesto'; = pensaba)
glossary.yerbas: yerba — grass, herbs (pl.; las yerbas del campo 'the grass of the field'; = hierbas)
glossary.dientes: diente — tooth (pl.; a dientes 'with the teeth'; = dientes)
glossary.tomó: tomar — he took (preterite 3rd sg.; a dientes las tomó 'he took them with his teeth'; = tomó)
glossary.omildança: omildança — humility, homage, reverence (dar omildança 'to do homage'; Pidal 'acatamiento'; = humildad, acatamiento)
glossary.levantados: levantar + (v)os — raise yourself, get up (imperative 2nd pl. levantad + enclitic vos, the v lost after -d; Levantados en pie 'rise to your feet'; = levantaos)
glossary.hinojos: hinojo — knee (pl.; hinojos fitos 'on bended knees'; = hinojos; cf. inojos)
glossary.fitos: fito — fixed, planted firm (adj. masc. pl., Latin fictus; hinojos fitos 'knees planted on the ground'; = hincados)
glossary.dédesme: dar + me — (that) you give me (present subjunctive 2nd pl. dedes + enclitic me, optative/request; dédesme vuestra amor 'may you grant me your favour'; = me deis)
glossary.oyan: oír — they hear (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; que lo oyan todos 'so that all may hear it'; = oigan)
glossary.perdono: perdonar — I pardon (present 1st sg.; aquí vos perdono 'here I pardon you'; = perdono)
glossary.ên: e + en — and in (Pidal's circumflex marks the two words run together, as in lâ, lês, mê, âquel; ên todo mio reyno 'and in all my kingdom'; = y en)
glossary.desde: desde — from, since (preposition; desde oy 'from today'; = desde)
glossary.levós: levar + se — he rose, got up (levóse: preterite 3rd sg. levó + enclitic reflexive se, final e dropped; levós en pie 'he got to his feet'; = se levantó)
glossary.bócal: boca + le — the mouth ... him (boca + enclitic dative le, e dropped, the pronoun hung on the noun before the verb; en la bócal saludó 'greeted him on the mouth', Pidal 'le besó en la boca'; = le saludó en la boca)
glossary.valer: valer — to help, avail, protect (infinitive; in the split future valer me a 'will help me', infinitive + me + a = ha; = me valdrá)
glossary.fossedes: seer — (that) you were, would you were (imperfect subjunctive 2nd pl., -sse type, strong stem fo-; Fossedes mio huesped 'would you were my guest'; = fueseis)
glossary.huesped: huesped — guest (also host; mio huesped seredes 'you will be my guest'; = huésped)
glossary.ploguiesse: plazer — it might please (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., strong stem plogu-, -sse; si vos ploguiesse 'if it pleased you'; = pluguiese/placiera)
glossary.llegastes: llegar — you arrived (preterite 2nd pl., -astes; vos agora llegastes 'you have just arrived'; = llegasteis)
glossary.viniemos: venir — we came (strong preterite 1st pl.; nos viniemos anoch 'we came yesterday'; = vinimos)
glossary.otorgó: otorgar — he granted, agreed (preterite 3rd sg.; lo otorgó 'he agreed to it'; = otorgó)
glossary.omillan: omillar — they bow, humble themselves; greet (present 3rd pl., reflexive; se le omillan 'they bow to him, greet him', Pidal omillarse a uno 'saludarle'; = se humillan, saludan)
glossary.omillámosnos: omillar + nos — we bow, we greet you (present 1st pl. omillamos + enclitic reflexive nos, the -s of -mos kept before nos; = nos humillamos, os saludamos)
glossary.andamos: andar — we go about, act (present 1st pl.; andamos en vuestro pro 'we go about in your interest'; = andamos)
glossary.fartar: fartar — to satiate, have enough (infinitive, reflexive; non se puede fartar dél 'he cannot get enough of him'; = hartarse)
glossary.tántol: tanto + le — so much ... him (tanto 'so much' + enclitic le 'him', e dropped; tántol querie de coraçón 'so much he loved him from the heart'; = tanto le quería)
glossary.catándol: catar + le — looking at him / at his (gerund catando + enclitic le, e dropped; catándol sedie la barba 'he sat gazing at his beard', le the person whose beard it is; = mirándole)
glossary.aínal: aína + le — so soon ... on him (aína 'quickly, soon' + enclitic dative le, e dropped; tan aínal creçió 'grew on him so soon', Pidal tan aína 'tan pronto'; = tan pronto le)
glossary.maravíllanse: maravillar — they marvel (present 3rd pl., reflexive se enclitic; maravíllanse de mio Çid 'they marvel at mio Çid'; = se maravillan)
glossary.claro: claro — bright, clear (adj. masc. sg., here predicative; claro salie el sol 'the sun rose bright'; = claro)
glossary.salie: salir — it came out, rose (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie; claro salie el sol 'the sun was rising bright'; = salía)
glossary.adobassen: adobar — they prepare, make ready (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., -sse, after mandar que; que adobassen cozina 'that they should prepare a meal'; = adobasen/prepararan)
glossary.cozina: cozina — cooking, kitchen; here the meal prepared (adobar cozina 'to prepare a meal'; sense 'meal' from context; = cocina)
glossary.acuerdan: acordar — they agree (present 3rd pl.; acuerdan en una razón 'they agree with one voice'; = concuerdan, se ponen de acuerdo)
glossary.comieran: comer — they had eaten (pluperfect indicative in -ra, 3rd pl.; no comieran mejor 'they had not eaten better'; = habían comido)
glossary.cantó: cantar — he sang (preterite 3rd sg.; la missa cantó 'he sang the mass', i.e. celebrated it; = cantó)
glossary.oidme: oír + me — hear me (imperative 2nd pl. oíd + enclitic me, spelt without the accent; Oidme, las escuelas 'hear me, my men'; = oídme)
glossary.ifançones: ifançón — minor nobleman, hidalgo (masc. pl.; cuemdes e ifançones 'counts and lesser nobles'; = infanzones)
glossary.cometer: cometer — to put forward, propose (infinitive; cometer quiero un ruego 'I wish to put forward a request'; Pidal 'proponer'; = proponer, plantear)
glossary.elvira: Elvira — Elvira, one of the Cid's two daughters (doña Elvira, also printed don Elvira; = Elvira)
glossary.semejam: semejar + me — it seems to me (present 3rd sg. semeja + enclitic me reduced to -m, as in quem; Semejam el casamiento ondrado 'the match seems to me honourable'; = me parece)
glossary.piden: pedir — they ask for (present 3rd pl.; ellos vos las piden 'they ask you for them'; = piden)
glossary.mándovoslo: mandar + vos + lo — I order it of you (present 1st sg. mando + enclitic vos + lo, stress accent kept; ellos vos las piden e mándovoslo yo 'they ask you for them and I order it of you'; = os lo mando)
glossary.rogadores: rogador — intercessor, one who asks for the bride on another's behalf (masc. pl.; que sean rogadores 'let them be petitioners'; Pidal: the rogador solemnly interceded and asked for the bride in marriage, received her and handed on the authority over her to the husband; = intercesores)
glossary.dándoslas: dar + nos + las — give them to us (imperative 2nd pl. dad + nos + las, the d and n of dadnos changed round, dadnos > dandos; dándoslas, mio Çid 'give them to us, my Çid'; = dádnoslas)
glossary.hedad: hedad — age (fem. noun; non han grant hedad 'they are not of great age'; = edad)
glossary.pequeñas: pequeño — small, little (fem. pl.; de dias pequeñas son 'they are small in days', i.e. young; = pequeñas, jóvenes)
glossary.perteneçen: pertenecer — they are suited, are fitting (present 3rd pl.; perteneçen pora mis fijas 'they are suited to my daughters'; = pertenecen, here convienen)
glossary.hyo: yo — I (subject pronoun, spelling with h-; hyo las engendré 'I begot them'; = yo)
glossary.engendré: engendrar — I begot (preterite 1st sg.; hyo las engendré 'I begot them'; = engendré)
glossary.criásteslas: criar + las — you brought them up (preterite 2nd pl. criastes, old -stes ending, + enclitic las; criásteslas vos 'you brought them up'; vos is the separate subject; = las criasteis)
glossary.afellas: afe + las — behold them (afe, presentative 'behold, here is' + las; afellas en vuestra mano 'here they are in your hand'; = helas aquí; origin of afe uncertain)
glossary.dadlas: dar + las — give them (imperative 2nd pl. dad + las; dadlas a qui quisiéredes vos 'give them to whom you wish'; = dadlas)
glossary.levantaron: levantar — they rose, got up (preterite 3rd pl.; se levantaron iffantes 'the Infantes got up'; = levantaron)
glossary.camearon: camear — they exchanged (preterite 3rd pl.; camearon las espadas 'they exchanged swords', Pidal 'cambiaron las espadas', in sign of kinship, arms being given as a pledge of friendship; = cambiaron)
glossary.dades: dar — you give (present 2nd pl.; quem dades vuestras fijas 'you give me your daughters'; = dais)
glossary.dólas: dar + las — I give them (present 1st sg. do + enclitic las, with accent; e dólas por veladas 'and I give them as veiled', i.e. as lawfully wed brides; = las doy)
glossary.veladas: velar — veiled, solemnly wed (past part. fem. pl.; por veladas 'as veiled brides', the veiling being part of the church wedding rite, Pidal's el velar 'la ceremonia de las velaciones'; = veladas, casadas por la Iglesia)
glossary.caso: casar — I marry off (present 1st sg.; yo las caso a vuestras fijas 'I give your daughters in marriage'; = caso, doy en matrimonio)
glossary.ende: ende — of it, from it, thence (adverb/pronoun, Latin inde; ayades ende sabor 'may you have pleasure of it'; = de ello)
glossary.afellos: afe + los — behold them (masc. pl.; afellos en vuestras manos ifantes 'here are the Infantes in your hands'; = helos aquí)
glossary.aquén: aquén — on this side, here (adverb, the opposite of allén 'beyond'); d' aquén 'from here' (ca d' aquén me torno yo 'for from here I turn back'; = de aquí, de acá)
glossary.torno: tornar — I turn back, return (present 1st sg., with reflexive me; me torno yo 'I go back'; = vuelvo)
glossary.ayuda: ayuda — help, aid, contribution (fem. noun; en ayuda les do 'I give them as a help'; = ayuda)
glossary.metan: meter — they may put in, spend (present subjunctive 3rd pl., purpose; que metan en sus bodas 'that they spend it on their wedding'; Pidal 'empleen, gasten'; = metan, gasten)
glossary.bodas: boda — wedding, wedding feast (fem. pl.; en sus bodas 'in their wedding'; = bodas)
glossary.dó: dó — where (relative adverb, de + o, = donde; o dó quisiéredes vos 'or wherever you wish')
glossary.fueren: seer — they shall be (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; the form is the same as for ir; pues fueren en vuestro poder 'when they are in your power'; = fueren, tense obsolete, here 'cuando estén')
glossary.fet: fazer — do (imperative 2nd pl., short form fet; dellos fet, Campeador 'do with them as you wish, Campeador'; = haced)
glossary.casades: casar — you marry off (present 2nd pl.; vos casades mis fijas 'you marry my daughters'; = casáis)
glossary.puestas: poner — set, agreed (past part. fem. pl. with son; las palabras son puestas 'the terms are agreed'; = puestas)
glossary.omenajes: omenaje — homage, solemn pledge of fealty (masc. pl.; los omenajes dados son 'the pledges are given'; = homenajes)
glossary.saliesse: salir — (that) it should come out, rise (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse, of the sun; quando saliesse el sol 'when the sun should rise'; = saliese; Pidal restores salie[sse])
glossary.tornasse: tornar + se — (that each) should return (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse, with reflexive se; ques tornasse cada uno 'that each should go back'; = se tornase, se volviera)
glossary.aquís: aquí + se — then + reflexive (aquí 'at this point, then' + se; aquís metió en nuevas, Pidal 'entonces hizo cosa señalada', 'then he did a notable thing'; = aquí se)
glossary.alfaya: alfaya — precious thing, valuable piece (Arabic; d' alfaya 'of great value', Pidal 'de valor'; = alhaja)
glossary.metiólos: meter + los — he put them (preterite 3rd sg. metió + enclitic los; metiólos en poder 'he put them in the power of'; = los metió)
glossary.evad: evad — behold, here are (presentative, imperative-like 2nd pl.; evad aquí vuestros fijos 'here are your sons'; Pidal 'he aquí'; origin uncertain, cf. evades, afe)
glossary.sírvanvos: servir + vos — let them serve you (present subjunctive 3rd pl. sirvan + enclitic vos, n before v kept in spelling, jussive; sírvanvos commo a padre 'may they serve you as a father'; = os sirvan)
glossary.guárdenvos: guardar + vos — let them watch over you, keep faith with you (present subjunctive 3rd pl. guarden + enclitic vos, jussive; guárdenvos cum a señor 'let them keep faith with you as a lord'; = os guarden)
glossary.devos: dar + vos — may (God) give you (present subjunctive 3rd sg. de + enclitic vos, optative; de[vos] dent buen galardon 'may he give you a good reward for it'; = os dé; the vos is Pidal's restoration)
glossary.dad: dar — give! (imperative 2nd pl.; dad manero a qui las dé 'name a proxy to give them away', Pidal 'designad un representante'; = dad)
glossary.manero: manero — representative, proxy, one empowered to act for another (masc. noun; dad manero a qui las dé 'name a proxy to give them away'; Pidal 'designad un representante' o apoderado; more usually dar por manero a uno; = representante, apoderado)
glossary.dé: dar — (who) may give (present subjunctive 3rd sg., in a relative clause of purpose; a qui las dé 'to someone who is to give them'; = dé)
glossary.tomades: tomar — you take (present 2nd pl., old -des ending; quando vos las tomades 'since it is you who take them'; = tomáis)
glossary.alabarán: alabar — they will boast, brag (future 3rd pl., reflexive; dend non se alabarán 'they will not boast of it'; = se alabarán, se jactarán)
glossary.respondió: responder — he answered (preterite 3rd sg.; respondió el rey 'the king answered'; = respondió)
glossary.prendellas: prender + las — take them (imperative 2nd pl. prended + las, the -d- assimilated to l: prended + las > prendellas; prendellas con vuestras manos 'take them with your own hands'; = prendedlas, tomadlas)
glossary.daldas: dar + las — give them (imperative 2nd pl. dad + las, with the d and l changed round, dadlas > daldas; daldas a los ifantes 'give them to the Infantes'; = dadlas)
glossary.daquent: daquent — here, from here (de + aquent, a form of aquende 'on this side'; assí commo yo las prendo daquent 'just as I take them from here'; Pidal 'aquí'; = de aquí)
glossary.sed: seer — be! (imperative 2nd pl.; sed padrino dellas 'be their sponsor'; = sed)
glossary.padrino: padrino — sponsor, the man who stands by the bride and gives her at the wedding (masc. noun; sed padrino dellas 'act as their sponsor'; = padrino)
glossary.velar: velar — the veiling, the nuptial blessing (infinitive used as a noun, el velar; a tod el velar 'through the whole of the veiling'; Pidal 'la ceremonia de las velaciones'; = las velaciones)
glossary.juntáredes: juntar — (when) you meet, join (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; quando vos juntáredes comigo 'when you come together with me'; = juntareis, juntéis)
glossary.verdat: verdat — truth (fem. noun; quem digades la verdat 'that you tell me the truth'; = verdad)
glossary.oviemos: aver — we had (preterite 1st pl., strong; destas vistas que oviemos 'of this meeting that we have had'; = hubimos, tuvimos)
glossary.tomedes: tomar — (that) you take (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending, a polite request; de mí tomedes algo 'take something from me'; = toméis)
glossary.tráyovos: traer + vos — I bring you (present 1st sg. trayo, the old form beside traigo, + enclitic vos; tráyovos treínta palafrés 'I bring you thirty palfreys'; = os traigo)
glossary.enssellados: enssellar — saddled (past part. masc. pl. as adjective; cavallos … bien enssellados 'horses well saddled'; = ensillados)
glossary.enbargado: enbargar — overwhelmed, weighed down (past part.; mucho me avedes enbargado 'you have greatly overwhelmed me', with so many attentions; Pidal embargado 'abrumado' a fuerza de atenciones; = abrumado)
glossary.plazer: plazer — pleasure, favour, kindness (noun; este plazer quem feches 'this favour you do me'; = placer)
glossary.galardonado: galardonar — rewarded (past part. masc. sg. in a subjunctive clause; que bien sea galardonado 'that it be well rewarded'; = galardonado)
glossary.servido: servir — served, well served (past part.; de vos bien so servido 'I am well served by you'; = servido)
glossary.tengon: tener + me — I hold myself (present 1st sg. tengo + enclitic me cut to -m and written n; tengon por pagado 'I hold myself satisfied'; Pidal 'téngome'; = me tengo)
glossary.sediendo: seer — being, while being (gerund of seer 'to be, sit', with -iendo; aun bivo sediendo 'while I am still alive'; = siendo)
glossary.parto: partir — I depart, leave (present 1st sg., reflexive sense with me; destas vistas me parto 'I take my leave of this meeting'; = me parto, me voy)
glossary.ponga: poner — (may) he set, put (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; que lo ponga en buen recabdo 'may he put it in good order'; = ponga)
glossary.sobrel: sobre + el — upon the (the two e's run together; sobrel so cavallo 'upon his horse'; = sobre el)
glossary.daquend: daquend — from here (de + aquend, variant of daquent; daquend vaya comigo 'let him go with me from here'; = de aquí, desde aquí)
glossary.escurra: escurrir — (that) he escort, see off a departing guest some way on the road (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non quiere quel escurra 'he does not want him to see him off', Pidal 'no quiere que salga a despedirle', comp. escurriólos, v. 1067; = acompañe, despida)
glossary.dessí: dessí — thereupon, from there (des + í 'there'; dessí luégo[l] quitó 'right there he parted from him', Pidal 'allí mismo se separó de él'; = desde allí, allí mismo)
glossary.andantes: andante — fortunate (adjective, masc. pl., from andar; bien andantes 'fortunate, prosperous'; = afortunados)
glossary.espedirse: espedirse — to take leave (infinitive with enclitic se; besar las manos, espedirse de rey Alfons 'to kiss his hands, to take leave of King Alfonso'; = despedirse)
glossary.fazednos: fazer + nos — do for us (imperative 2nd pl. fazed + enclitic nos; fazednos este perdón 'forgive us this', Pidal 'perdonadnos esto'; = hacednos)
glossary.hiremos: ir — we shall go (future 1st pl., the h- only a spelling; hiremos en poder de mio Çid 'we shall go under my Çid's command'; = iremos)
glossary.soltó: soltar — he let go, released (preterite 3rd sg.; a todos los soltó 'he let them all go', Pidal 'dejó marchar libremente'; = dejó marchar)
glossary.mengó: menguar — it dwindled, grew smaller (preterite 3rd sg.; la del rey mengó 'the king's (company) dwindled'; = menguó)
glossary.ganó: ganar — he won, conquered (preterite 3rd sg.; la que en buen punto ganó 'which he won in a good hour'; = ganó)
glossary.fernando: Fernando — Fernando, one of the two Infantes of Carrión (also Ferrando; = Fernando)
glossary.diago: Diago — Diego, one of the two Infantes of Carrión (Pidal prints Di[a]go with the a supplied; also Di[da]go; = Diego)
glossary.mañas: maña — quality, trait of character, habit (fem. pl.; sopiessen sus mañas 'they were to learn their ways', the Infantes' character; = mañas, here manera de ser)
glossary.ansuor: Ansuor — Asur (Pidal's form; A[n]su[o]r with letters supplied), Asur González, elder brother of the Infantes of Carrión (Pidal; = Asur)
glossary.gonçálvez: Gonçálvez — González, patronymic 'son of Gonçalo' (Gonçál[v]ez, the v supplied; here Asur González; = González)
glossary.bullidor: bullidor — rowdy, a stirrer, a noisy fellow (adjective as noun, from bullir 'to stir, bustle'; que era bullidor 'who was a stirrer'; Pidal 'bullanguero'; = bullanguero)
glossary.largo: largo — long (adjective; largo de lengua 'long of tongue', a loose talker; = largo)
glossary.lengua: lengua — tongue, speech (fem. noun; largo de lengua 'free with his tongue'; = lengua)
glossary.afelos: afé + los — behold them (afé, presentative 'behold' + los; afelos en Valençia 'there they are in Valencia'; = helos aquí; origin of afé uncertain)
glossary.assomaron: assomar — they appeared, came into view (preterite 3rd pl.; quando a ella assomaron 'when they came in sight of it'; = asomaron)
glossary.mayores: mayor — greater, the greater (comparative adj. of grande, pl.; los gozos son mayores 'the joys are greater'; = mayores)
glossary.reyal: reyal — quarters, lodging (masc. noun; dad les un reyal 'give them quarters'; Pidal 'real, albergue'; = real, alojamiento)
glossary.apuntare: apuntar — (when) it breaks, dawns (future subjunctive 3rd sg., -are; que apuntare el sol 'when the sun comes up'; = apuntare, amanezca)
glossary.esposas: esposa — betrothed, bride (fem. pl.; verán a sus esposas 'they will see their brides'; = esposas)
glossary.veamos: veer — (that) we may see (present subjunctive 1st pl., optative; muchos dias vos veamos 'may we see you for many days'; = veamos)
glossary.adugo: aduzir — I bring (present 1st sg., -go as in digo; yernos vos adugo 'I bring you sons-in-law'; Pidal vos adugo 'os traigo'; = traigo)
glossary.gradídmelo: gradir + me + lo — thank me for it (imperative 2nd pl. gradid + me + lo, stress accent marked; gradídmelo, mis fijas 'thank me for it, my daughters'; me is dative 'to me'; = agradecédmelo)
glossary.servidas: servir — served, waited on (past part. fem. pl.; de quien son servidas 'by whom they are served'; = servidas)
glossary.menguadas: menguar — lacking, wanting, diminished (past part. fem. pl.; non serán menguadas 'they shall never be in want'; = menguadas, closest faltas)
glossary.casáredes: casar — (when) you shall marry (someone) off, give in marriage (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; quando vos nos casáredes 'when you give us in marriage'; = casareis)
glossary.levanté: levantar — I raised, brought about, started (preterite 1st sg.; non lo levanté yo 'I did not bring it about', Pidal 'no lo inicié, no lo hice'; = levanté)
glossary.pedidas: pedir — asked for (past part. fem. pl. agreeing with the object vos; pedidas vos ha 'he has asked for you'; = pedidas)
glossary.rogadas: rogar — requested, entreated (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with vos; pedidas vos ha e rogadas 'he has asked and begged for you'; = rogadas)
glossary.atan: atan — so (a- + tan; atan firme mientre 'so firmly'; = tan)
glossary.cosa: cosa — thing; nulla cosa 'anything' (after a negative, 'nothing'; = cosa)
glossary.sope: saber — I knew (how to), could (strong preterite 1st sg.; nulla cosa nol sope dezir de no 'I could say no to him in nothing', i.e. I could not refuse; = supe)
glossary.metivos: meter + vos — I put you (preterite 1st sg. metí + enclitic vos; Metivos en sus manos 'I put you in his hands'; = os metí)
glossary.ados: a + dos — a dos, two together (amas ados 'both together', 'the two of you'; = ambas a dos; the a and dos run together)
glossary.creades: creer — (that) you believe (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending, here a polite command; bien me lo creades 'believe me well'; = creáis)
glossary.suelo: suelo — floor, ground (Latin solum; por el suelo 'on the floor'; = suelo)
glossary.encortinado: encortinado — hung with hangings (past part. of encortinar, masc. sg.; por el suelo e suso tan bien encortinado 'so well hung with hangings on the floor and above', Pidal 'cubierto de tapices por el suelo y por las paredes'; = entapizado)
glossary.pórpola: pórpola — purple cloth, a costly dyed fabric (fem. noun, Latin purpura; tanta pórpola 'so much purple'; = púrpura)
glossary.xámed: xámed — samite, a rich silk cloth (masc. noun; tanto xámed 'so much samite', Pidal 'tela de seda'; = jamete)
glossary.paño: paño — cloth, fabric; paño preciado 'costly cloth' (= paño)
glossary.preciado: preçiado — valuable, costly (adj. masc. sg., from preçiar; here spelt without the cedilla; paño preciado 'costly cloth'; = preciado)
glossary.abriedes: aver — you would have (conditional 2nd pl., the infinitive aver + the imperfect ending -iedes, Latin habere + habebatis; sabor abriedes 'you would have pleasure'; = habríais)
glossary.seer: seer — to sit (infinitive, Latin sedere; sabor … de seer e de comer 'pleasure in sitting and eating'); also the infinitive of ser 'to be' (= sentarse, estar sentado; ser)
glossary.adeliñavan: adeliñar — they made straight for, headed to (imperfect 3rd pl.; adeliñavan al palaçio 'they made for the hall'; = adeliñaban, closest se dirigían)
glossary.quedos: quedo — quiet, calm, still (adj. masc. pl., used adverbially; qué quedos entraron! 'how quietly they entered!'; = quedos, closest callados, mansos)
glossary.reçibiólos: recebir + los — he received them (preterite 3rd sg. reçibió + enclitic los; = los recibió)
glossary.ssu: su — his, her (spelling with doubled s after a; a ssu mugier 'to his wife'; = su)
glossary.omillaron: omillar — they bowed, did homage (preterite 3rd pl., used with reflexive se; se le omillaron 'they bowed low to him'; = se humillaron, closest se inclinaron)
glossary.preçioso: preçioso — precious, costly (masc. sg.; un preçioso escaño 'a costly bench'; = precioso)
glossary.escaño: escaño — bench, long seat with a back (masc. sg.; = escaño)
glossary.acordados: acordado — prudent, well-schooled, of sound judgment (Pidal 'prudente', of v. 2217: tan bien son acordados 'they are so well-schooled') · also agreed, of one mind (past part. masc. pl. of acordar; assí son acordados 'they are so agreed'; = acordados)
glossary.mientes: mientes — mind, attention (fem. pl., Latin mentes; parar mientes 'to pay heed, consider'; están parando mientes al … 'they are watching the …'; = mientes, closest atención)
glossary.levantado: levantar — risen, raised (past part. masc. sg. with es; es levantado 'has risen, is on his feet'; = levantado)
glossary.imos: ir — we go (present 1st pl.; lo imos tardando 'we are delaying it'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = vamos)
glossary.tardando: tardar — delaying (gerund; lo imos tardando 'we are putting it off'; = tardando, closest demorando)
glossary.amo: amar — I love (present 1st sg.; el que yo quiero e amo 'he whom I want and love'; = amo) · also amo — tutor, guardian of a young man bearing his first arms (noun masc.; a mí por amo non abrán 'they will not have me for their tutor'; Pidal 'ayo'; the same form as amo 'I love')
glossary.affé: affé — behold, here is/are (presentative; affé amas mis fijas 'behold both my daughters'; cf. afé; origin uncertain; = he aquí)
glossary.métolas: meter + las — I put them (present 1st sg. meto + enclitic las, the stress written; métolas en vuestra mano 'I put them in your hand'; = las meto)
glossary.sabedes: saber — you know (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = sabéis)
glossary.fallir: fallir — to fail, to fall short (infinitive; no lo quiero fallir 'I do not wish to fail in it'; = faltar, fallar)
glossary.bendiçiones: bendiçión — blessing (fem. pl.; prendan bendiçiones 'let them receive blessings'; = bendiciones)
glossary.vavamos: ir — let us go (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortative; so printed, where Pidal's note paraphrases vayamos; vavamos recabdando 'let us get on with it'; = vayamos)
glossary.recabdando: recabdar — carrying out, dispatching (gerund; vavamos recabdando 'let us get on with it', Pidal 'vayamos despachando esto'; = despachando)
glossary.estoz: estoz — then, at that moment (variant of estonz, estonçes; Estoz dixo Minaya 'then Minaya said'; = entonces)
glossary.levántanse: levantar + se — they rise, stand up (present 3rd pl. levantan + enclitic se; = se levantan)
glossary.derechas: derecho — upright, straight (adj. fem. pl.; levántanse derechas 'they stand up straight'; = derechas)
glossary.metiógelas: meter + ge + las — he put them (in)to him (preterite 3rd sg. metió + enclitic ge, the old dative 'to him', + las; metiógelas en mano 'he put them into his hand', the Çid handing his daughters to Minaya, Pidal 'las entrega en manos de Minaya'; = se las metió)
glossary.tomassedes: tomar — (that) you take (imperfect subjunctive 2nd pl. in -sse, old -des ending; que las tomassedes por mugieres 'that you take them as wives'; = tomaseis)
glossary.palacio: palacio — hall, palace (spelling variant of palaçio; = palacio)
glossary.adelinnando: adeliñar — making straight for, heading (gerund, spelling with nn = ñ; adelinnando 'heading for'; = adeliñando, closest dirigiéndose)
glossary.eclegia: eclegia — church (variant of eglesia, Latin ecclesia; = iglesia)
glossary.sediellos: seer + los — he was … them (sedie 'he was', imperfect 3rd sg. of seer, + enclitic los, the l written double; sediellos sperando 'he was waiting for them'; = los estaba esperando)
glossary.sperando: esperar — waiting for (gerund, spelt without the initial e; seer + gerund like estar + gerund; = esperando)
glossary.dióles: dar + les — he gave them (preterite 3rd sg. dio + enclitic les, the stress written; dióles bendictiones 'he gave them blessings'; = les dio)
glossary.bendictiones: bendiçión — blessing (fem. pl., learned spelling bendictiones, Latin benedictio; = bendiciones)
glossary.cantado: cantar — sung (past part.; la missa a cantado 'he has sung the mass', i.e. celebrated it; a cantado = ha cantado; = cantado)
glossary.ecclegia: ecclegia — church (learned spelling beside eclegia; = iglesia)
glossary.cavalgaron: cavalgar — they mounted, rode (preterite 3rd pl.; = cabalgaron)
glossary.tovieron: tener — they held, handled (strong preterite 3rd pl.; tovieron armas 'they played at arms' in the games, Pidal 'jugaron las armas'; cf. tenien armas; = tuvieron) · also tener por — to hold as, consider (tovieron por enbaídos 'they held (them) shamed')
glossary.cameó: camear — he changed, exchanged (preterite 3rd sg.; tres cavallos cameó 'he changed horses three times', i.e. rode out three mounts in the games; cf. camearon; = cambió)
glossary.vidie: veer — he saw (imperfect 3rd sg., Pidal's vi[d]ie; de lo que vidie 'of what he saw'; = veía)
glossary.cavalgado: cavalgar — ridden (past part.; bien an cavalgado 'they have ridden well'; = cabalgado)
glossary.alcaçer: alcáçer — citadel, fortress (Pidal's alcaç[er]; en el alcaçer ondrado 'in the honored citadel'; = alcázar)
glossary.entrassen: entrar — they might enter (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. in -sse; antes que entrassen a yantar 'before they went in to dine'; = entrasen)
glossary.crebantaron: crebantar — they broke, smashed (preterite 3rd pl.; Pidal's [cr]ebantaron; todos los crebantaron 'they broke them all', the tablados struck with lances; = quebrantaron)
glossary.duraron: durar — they spent (time), stayed on (preterite 3rd pl.; quinze días … en las bodas duraron 'they spent fifteen days at the weddings', Pidal 'emplearon, gastaron'; = duraron, closest pasaron)
glossary.dones: don — gift (masc. pl.; sos dones avien dados 'had given their gifts'; = dones)
glossary.abastado: abastar — well supplied, provided (past part. masc. sg.; bien era abastado 'he was well provided for'; = abastecido)
glossary.ospedados: ospedado — guest (past part. of ospedar 'to lodge', used as noun, masc. pl.; aquestos ospedados 'these guests'; = huéspedes)
glossary.espidiéndos: espedir + se — taking leave (gerund espidiendo + enclitic se, its e lost; espidiéndos de Roy Díaz 'taking leave of Roy Díaz'; = despidiéndose)
glossary.gonçalvo: Gonçalvo — Gonzalo (Pidal's restored Gonçal[v]o; el conde don Gonçalvo, father of the Infantes of Carrión; = Gonzalo)
glossary.hyernos: hyerno — son-in-law (masc. pl., spelt with hy-, Latin gener; sos hyernos 'his sons-in-law'; = yernos)
glossary.rastados: rastar — remained, stayed behind (past part. masc. pl. with ser as auxiliary; son rastados 'have remained', Pidal 'han quedado'; cf. a rastado 'has remained'; = quedado)
glossary.moran: morar — they dwell, stay (present 3rd pl.; y moran los ifantes 'the Infantes stay there'; = moran)
glossary.cerca: cerca — near, about (adverb, spelt c; cerca de dos años 'nearly two years'; = cerca)
glossary.amores: amor — affection, kindness, attentions (masc. pl.; los amores que les fazen 'the kindnesses they show them', Pidal 'los agasajos'; = agasajos, atenciones)
glossary.âlgo: a + algo — 'at something', in aver a algo 'to hold in some esteem' (Pidal's circumflex marks two words run together; el que lo ovo âlgo 'he who held it in some esteem', Pidal 'el que lo estimó en algo'; the reading is very doubtful, the manuscript being damaged here; = en algo)
glossary.coplas: copla — verse, stanza (fem. pl.; las coplas deste cantar 'the verses of this poem'; = coplas)
glossary.acabando: acabar — coming to an end, finishing (gerund; van acabando 'are coming to an end'; ir + gerund; = acabando)
glossary.sedí: seer — he was (staying), was (imperfect 3rd sg. in -í, beside sedié; Pidal's se[d]í, the d restored; seer 'to sit', here simply 'to be, abide'; = estaba)
glossary.yazies: yazer + se — he was lying (down) (yazie, imperfect 3rd sg., + enclitic se; Pidal 'estábase echado'; = yacía, estaba echado)
glossary.durmie: dormir — he was sleeping (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie ending; = dormía)
glossary.sobrevienta: sobrevienta — sudden mishap, unlooked-for event (noun, from sobrevenir 'to befall'; mala sobrevienta, Pidal 'mala sorpresa'; closest imprevisto, percance)
glossary.cuntió: cuntir — it happened, befell (preterite 3rd sg.; que les cuntió 'that befell them', Pidal 'les aconteció'; = aconteció)
glossary.saliós: salir + se — it got out, broke out (salió, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic reflexive se, its -e dropped; of the lion; = se salió)
glossary.red: red — grating, cage (fem. noun; Pidal 'reja, jaula'; here the lion's cage; modern red 'net')
glossary.desatós: desatar + se — it got loose, broke free (desató, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic reflexive se; of the lion; = se desató)
glossary.çercan: çercar — they surround, encircle (present 3rd pl.; = cercan; ç sounded ts)
glossary.ferrant: Ferrant — Fernando (personal name; Pidal's Ferran[t]; Ferrant Gonçalvez, one of the two Infantes of Carrión; = Fernando)
glossary.gonçalvez: Gonçalvez — González, 'son of Gonçalvo' (patronymic; Ferrant Gonçalvez, Diag Gonçalvez; = González)
glossary.ifant: ifant — infante, young nobleman, son of a noble house (sg., ifante with its final -e dropped; ifant de Carrión, restored by Pidal; = infante)
glossary.alçasse: alçar(se) — (where) he might hide, take cover (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; dos alçasse = do 'where' + se + alçasse, Pidal 'donde se escondiese'; modern alzar 'to lift')
glossary.abierta: abrir — open (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with cámara; = abierta)
glossary.metiós: meter + se — he put himself, got himself in(to), hid (metió, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic reflexive se; = se metió)
glossary.esçaño: escaño — bench, long seat with a back (variant spelling with ç of escaño; masc. sg.; = escaño)
glossary.diag: Diag — Diego (personal name, Diago with its final -o dropped; Pidal's Di[a]g; Diag Gonçalvez, one of the two Infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
glossary.viga: viga — beam, timber (fem. noun; viga lagar 'the beam of a press', the two nouns in apposition; = viga)
glossary.lagar: lagar — wine or oil press, press-house (masc. noun; = lagar); in viga lagar the pair is read as 'press-beam', reading from context
glossary.brial: brial — tunic, long silk garment worn by nobles (masc. noun; no modern word in use, closest túnica)
glossary.çercado: çercar — surrounded (past part. masc. sg., agreeing with escaño; = cercado)
glossary.qués: qué + es — what is (interrogative qué + es, 'is', run together; qués esto 'what is this'; = qué es)
glossary.levantó: levantar — he raised, got up (preterite 3rd sg.; with reflexive se, se levantó 'he stood up'; = levantó)
glossary.cuello: cuello — neck (= cuello; al cuello 'about his neck' of a mantle worn, and 'by the neck', al cuello lo tomó, Pidal 'lo cogió por el cuello')
