glossary.envergonçó: envergonçar — he was abashed, cowed (preterite 3rd sg., read here as intransitive/reflexive without se; closest se avergonzó; sense taken from context)
glossary.premió: premer — it pressed down, lowered (preterite 3rd sg.; la cabeça premió, Pidal 'bajó la cabeza'; Latin premere; closest apretar, bajar; not modern premiar 'to reward')
glossary.liévalo: levar + lo — he leads it, takes it along (lieva, present 3rd sg. of levar, + object lo, the accent marking the stress; = lo lleva)
glossary.adestrando: adestrar — leading (as a horse is led) by the halter (gerund; from diestro 'right hand'; Pidal 'lo lleva como de diestro'; closest llevar del diestro)
glossary.llamando: llamar — calling (gerund; están llamando 'they are calling'; = llamando)
glossary.color: color — colour; sin color 'colourless, pale' (= color)
glossary.juego: juego — game, sport; here jesting, mockery at the Infantes' expense (masc. noun; tal juego commo iva por la cort 'such sport as went round the court', which the Cid forbids; = juego, burla)
glossary.enbaídos: enbaído — shamed, put out of countenance (past part. masc. pl. of enbaír; Pidal 'avergonzados, corridos')
glossary.búcar: Búcar — Búcar, the Moorish king who comes against Valencia (personal name, Arabic; no modern Spanish form beyond Búcar)
glossary.oviestes: aver — you had (strong preterite 2nd pl.; = hubisteis); sil oviestes contar 'if you have heard tell of him', Pidal 'si oísteis de él' (sil = si + le)
glossary.catamos: catar — we looked at, considered (preterite 1st pl., the same form as the present; Pidal 'miramos', of the time of the marriage; = miramos, consideramos)
glossary.bibdas: bibda — widows (fem. pl., with b for v; = viudas)
glossary.remandrán: remaner — they will remain, be left (future 3rd pl., syncopated remanrán with a d grown between n and r; = quedarán)
glossary.desean: desear — they long for, desire (present 3rd pl.; = desean)
glossary.idlos: ir + los — go (id, imperative 2nd pl. of ir; = id) + los, object of the next verb conortar; idlos conortar 'go and comfort them' (= id a consolarlos) · also idlos ensayar — 'go and attack them' (ensayar, Pidal 'acometer'; = id a acometerlos)
glossary.conortar: conortar — to comfort, encourage, cheer (infinitive; = confortar, consolar)
glossary.ayan: aver — (that) they have (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = hayan); non ayan i raçión 'let them have no share in it'
glossary.raçión: raçión — share, portion (fem. noun; non ayan i raçión, Pidal 'no tomen parte en la batalla'; closest parte; not the modern 'ration') · a la raçión — to each share (a la raçión cadie 'to each share fell'; Pidal: the booty was divided into raciones, afterwards shared out in proportion among the fighters)
glossary.vençremos: vençer — we shall defeat, overcome (future 1st pl., syncopated from vençer + emos; = venceremos)
glossary.tenedes: tener — you hold, have (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = tenéis)
glossary.blancas: blanco — white (fem. pl., agreeing with fijas; = blancas)
glossary.desseo: dessear — I desire, long for (present 1st sg.; = deseo)
glossary.folgad: folgar — rest, take your ease, enjoy yourselves (imperative 2nd pl.; = holgad, from holgar)
glossary.trevo: trever(se) — I dare (present 1st sg.; = me atrevo; arrancar me los trevo 'I dare to rout them', Pidal 'me atrevo a vencerlos': me is the reflexive of treverse, set before the infinitive)
glossary.meresca: merecer — may I earn, deserve (of someone) (present subjunctive 1st sg., with -sca; aun vea el ora que vos meresca dos tanto 'may I yet see the hour when I may earn of you twice as much', i.e. repay you twice over; Pidal 'ojalá os lo pueda pagar con creces', literally 'merezca de vos el doble'; = merezca) · also meresca — 3rd sg., 'may he repay (it to you)' (sí vos lo meresca … nuestro padre 'so may our father repay you for it'; = os lo pague)
glossary.otorga: otorgar — he confirms, bears out; grants, consents (present 3rd sg.; assi lo otorga don Pero 'so Don Pero confirms it', of Fernando's claim; = otorga, confirma)
glossary.alaba: alabar + se — he boasts, brags (present 3rd sg. with reflexive se; qu[o]mo se alaba Ferrando 'as Ferrando boasts'; = se alaba, se jacta; not 'to praise' someone else)
glossary.ueste: hueste — host, army (fem. noun, spelt without h; la ueste de los moros 'the Moorish host'; = hueste)
glossary.vieran: veer — they had seen (pluperfect indicative 3rd pl. in -ra, the old value of the ending; ca nunca lo vieran 'for they had never seen it'; = habían visto)
glossary.nuevos: nuevo — new; here 'new to this, unseasoned' (masc. pl.; ca nuevos son llegados 'for they are newly arrived'; = nuevos, closest recién llegados, bisoños)
glossary.maravillan: maravillar + se — they marvel, are amazed (present 3rd pl. with reflexive se; = se maravillan, se asombran)
glossary.díago: Díago — Diego (personal name; Pidal's Dí[a]go; Diego González, one of the two Infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
glossary.serien: seer — they would be (conditional 3rd pl., -ien ending; non serien allí llegados 'they would not have come there (of their own will)'; = serían)
glossary.ala: ala — interjection, 'ho!, hey!' (calling a person to attention; Pidal '¡ola!'; ¡Ala, Per Vermudoz! 'Ho, Per Vermudoz!'; = ¡hola!, ¡eh!)
glossary.caro: caro — dear, beloved (adjective masc. sg.; el mio sobrino caro 'my dear nephew'; = querido; not modern caro 'costly')
glossary.cúriesme: curiar + me — look after, take care of (cúries, present subjunctive 2nd sg. used as a command, the familiar tú, + me, ethic dative 'for me'; cúriesme a Dídago 'look after Diego for me'; = cuídame)
glossary.dídago: Dídago — Diego (personal name, variant of Díago; Pidal's Dí[da]go; Diego González, one of the two Infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
glossary.cúrielos: curiar + los — let (him) look after them, may he guard them (present subjunctive 3rd sg. used as a third-person command, + los; cúrielos qui quier 'let anyone who likes look after them'; = cuídelos)
glossary.quier: querer — (he) wishes (present 3rd sg. without -e, subjunctive in value; qui quier 'whoever, anyone at all', = quienquiera; = quiera) · also si quier — 'would that, if only' (¡Si quier el casamiento fecho non fosse oy! 'would that the match had never been made today', Pidal 'ojalá'; = ojalá)
glossary.fuere: seer — shall be, happens (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si cueta fuere 'if need arise'; = fuere, tense obsolete; closest 'si hubiere'/'si hay')
glossary.leale: leal — loyal (masc. sg.; Pidal's leal[e], with a restored paragogic -e, the -e added for the tirada's á-e assonance; Canpeador leal 'loyal Campeador'; = leal)
glossary.ferave: fazer — he will do, make, bring about (future 3rd sg.: ferá, = hará, with a paragogic -e for the tirada's á-e assonance and a v between the two vowels; the ve is Pidal's restoration, Pidal 'ferave "hará", con -e paragógica'; compare serave, estave; el Criador la ferave 'the Creator will bring it about'; = hará)
glossary.dinno: dinno — worthy (adjective masc. sg., nn sounded ñ; tan dinno 'so worthy'; = digno)
glossary.mandádno: mandar + nos — order us (mandad, imperative 2nd pl., + nos with its -s lost before the following los: mandádno'los ferir 'order us to strike them'; = mandadnos)
glossary.qual: qual — which (relative/interrogative adjective; de qual part 'from whichever side'; = cual)
glossary.semejare: semejar — it seems (good) (future subjunctive 3rd sg., semejar[e], the final -e restored by Pidal; de qual part vos semejare 'from whichever side shall seem good to you', Pidal 'de la parte que os pareciere'; = pareciere, closest parezca)
glossary.conplir: conplir — to fulfil, carry out (infinitive; el debdo … a conplir 'the duty to be fulfilled'; = cumplir)
glossary.serave: seer — will be (future 3rd sg.: será with a paragogic -e and a v between the vowels, as in ferave; the ve is Pidal's restoration; el debdo que ha cada uno a conplir serave 'the duty each one has will be to fulfil', Pidal 'habrá de cumplirse la obligación que cada uno tiene'; = será)
glossary.verlo: veer + lo — to see it (infinitive + enclitic lo, split future with hemos: verlo hemos 'we shall see it'; = lo veremos)
glossary.vagare: vagar — leisure, time, slowness (noun; vagar[e] is Pidal's restoration with paragogic -e for the assonance; ayamos más de vagare 'let us take more time'; de vagar 'at leisure'; = ocio, calma; not modern vagar 'to wander')
glossary.estave: estar — he is (present 3rd sg.: está with a paragogic -e and a v between the vowels, as in ferave, serave; the whole word is Pidal's restoration, [estave]; muy bien armado estave 'he is very well armed'; = está)
glossary.parávas: parar + se — he took his stand, planted himself (imperfect 3rd sg. parava + enclitic se, its -e dropped, in narrative use; parávas delant al Campeador 'he stood before the Campeador'; = se paraba, closest se plantaba)
glossary.dix: dezir — I said (strong preterite 1st sg.; x sounded sh; dix la missa 'I said (sang) mass'; = dije)
glossary.trinidade: Trinidade — Trinity (the manuscript's own form, with paragogic final -e, the model for the e's Pidal restores in this tirada; santa Trinidade 'the Holy Trinity'; = Trinidad)
glossary.vin: venir — I came (strong preterite 1st sg.; vin vos buscar 'I came to seek you'; = vine)
glossary.matare: matar — to kill (infinitive with Pidal's restored paragogic -e, matar[e], for the assonance; de algún moro matare 'to kill some Moor'; = matar)
glossary.orden: orden — order, holy orders, clerical estate (noun; mi orden 'my order', the bishop's calling; = orden)
glossary.corças: corça — roe doe (fem. pl.; pendón a corças 'a pennon with does', painted on it as a device; Pidal: 'Verso dudoso. Parece que el obispo lleva en su pendón pintadas unas corzas por señal o blasón'; = corzas)
glossary.señal: señal — sign, device, painted emblem (armas de señal 'arms with a device', Pidal 'armas con un emblema pintado', by which the knight was known in battle, not yet a fixed hereditary blazon in the Çid's time; = señal, divisa)
glossary.plogiesse: plazer — (if) it pleased (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse, strong stem plog-; si plogiesse a Dios 'if it pleased God'; = placiese, closest pluguiese)
glossary.querríalas: querer + las — I would like (to try) them (conditional 1st sg. querría + enclitic las, object of ensayar; = las querría)
glossary.ensayar: ensayar — to try, use (a weapon) (infinitive; querríalas ensayar 'I should like to try them (the arms) out', Pidal 'probar, usar un arma'); also 'to attack' (idlos ensayar 'go and attack them', Pidal 'acometer'; = probar; acometer)
glossary.pudiesse: poder — (that) might be able, could (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse; que pudiesse folgar 'that it might rest'; = pudiese)
glossary.aquent: aquent — this side, here (adverb, from aquende, final -e dropped; d'aquent 'from this side, from here'; = aquende, de aquí)
glossary.espolonada: espolonada — charge, onset (noun, from espolón 'spur'; priso a espolonada 'he began the attack', Pidal 'comenzó el ataque': the charge a few knights make against the enemy, riding out ahead of their host; = arremetida)
glossary.ívalos: ir + los — he went (to strike) them (imperfect 3rd sg. iva + enclitic los, object of ferir; ívalos ferir 'he went to strike them', ir + bare infinitive; = los iba a herir)
glossary.crebado: crebar — broken (past part. masc. sg., agreeing with astil; Pidal's [cr]ebado; el astil a crebado 'he has broken the shaft', a = ha, auxiliary; = quebrado)
glossary.ensayavas: ensayar + se — he exerted himself in the fight, did deeds of prowess (imperfect 3rd sg. ensayava + enclitic se, its -e dropped, narrative imperfect; Ensayavas el obispo 'the bishop gave his all', Pidal 'esforzarse en la lucha, hacer proezas'; = se esforzaba)
glossary.çercavan: çercar — they were surrounding (imperfect 3rd pl.; derredor le çercavan 'they surrounded him on all sides'; = cercaban; ç sounded ts)
glossary.dávanle: dar + le — they gave him, dealt him (imperfect 3rd pl. davan + enclitic le, stress marked by the accent; dávanle grandes colpes 'they dealt him great blows'; = le daban)
glossary.falssan: falssar — they pierce, break through (armour) (present 3rd pl., the unnamed Moors being the subject; nol falssan las armas 'they do not pierce his armour'; Pidal: falssar las armas defensivas, v. 713; = traspasan, quebrantan)
glossary.enbraçó: enbraçar — he took (the shield) on his arm (preterite 3rd sg.; enbraçó el escudo 'he braced the shield on his arm'; = embrazó)
glossary.abaxó: abaxar — he lowered (preterite 3rd sg.; abaxó el asta 'he lowered the lance'; = bajó)
glossary.abatió: abatir — he struck down, felled (preterite 3rd sg.; abatió a siete 'he struck down seven'; = derribó)
glossary.cade: caer — falls (present 3rd sg., cade with its -d- kept; Pidal's restoration [cade]; cade en alcança 'falls in pursuit', i.e. gives chase, an idiom whose sense is taken from context; = cae) · also caer — falls down, stumbles (literal sense, present 3rd sg.; o comigo non cade 'or does not fall with me'; = cae) · also cade aluon — 'lies far off' (mas ca[d]e aluon 'but it lies far away', of a place's position; = queda lejos)
glossary.cuerdas: cuerda — rope, tent-rope (fem. pl.; = cuerdas; crebar tantas cuerdas 'so many ropes snapping')
glossary.huebras: huebra — work, ornament (fem. pl., Latin opera, = obra; con huebras eran tantas 'so much ornamented were they', Pidal 'tenían muchas labores o adornos', compare tendal obrado, v. 1783; = labores, adornos)
glossary.cáenlos: caer + los — they fall upon them, they pursue them (present 3rd pl. + object los; caer en alcaz 'to fall on in pursuit, give chase', an idiom whose sense is taken from context; cf. cade en alcança)
glossary.caer: caer — to fall (infinitive; veriedes caer 'you would see fall'; = caer)
glossary.migeros: migero — mile (pl.; Pidal's note: 'Siete millas completas duró la persecución'; = millas)
glossary.cadiól: caer + le — he fell upon him, went after him (preterite 3rd sg. cadió, the old form with -d-, + enclitic l(e) 'him'; caer a uno en alcaz 'to fall on someone in pursuit'; = le cayó)
glossary.torna: tornar — turn back, come back (imperative 2nd sg.; acá torna 'turn back here'; = vuelve) · also tornar — he gives back, returns (present 3rd sg.; nol torna recabdo 'gives her no heed, no answer'; = devuelve)
glossary.venist: venir — you came (preterite 2nd sg., -ist ending; = viniste)
glossary.dalent: de + alent — from beyond (de + alent, old alén; dalent mar 'from over the sea'; = de allende)
glossary.veerte: veer + te — to see yourself, to meet (infinitive veer + reflexive te; veerte as con 'you will meet face to face with'; = verte)
glossary.as: aver — you have (present 2nd sg., = has); also the future auxiliary set after infinitive + clitic in the split future (veerte as 'you will see yourself', = te verás)
glossary.saludar: saludar — to greet (infinitive; saludar nos hemos 'we shall greet one another', split future; Pidal's note glosses the exchange as 'nos besaremos', 'we shall kiss'; = saludar)
glossary.tajaremos: tajar — we shall make, conclude (future 1st pl.; tajar amiztat 'to strike a friendship'; Pidal's note: 'pactaremos amistad'; literally 'to cut', sense taken from Pidal; = tajaremos)
glossary.amiztat: amiztad — friendship, pact of friendship (fem. noun, spelling variant with final t; Pidal's amizta[t]; = amistad)
glossary.cofonda: cofonder — may he confound, destroy (present subjunctive 3rd sg. in a curse; cofonda Dios 'may God confound'; = confunda, of confundir)
glossary.veot: veer + te — I see you (present 1st sg. veo + object te, the e of te run into the verb; veot aguijar 'I see you spurring'; = te veo)
glossary.quieres: querer — you want, intend (present 2nd sg.; la quieres ensayar 'you wish to try it out'; = quieres)
glossary.juntarás: juntar — you will join (future 2nd sg.; with reflexive te, juntarse con uno 'to come up with, catch up with someone': non te juntarás comigo 'you will not come up with me'; = (te) juntarás)
glossary.saltos: salto — leap, bound (pl.; grandes saltos faz 'makes great leaps'; = saltos)
glossary.alcançándolo: alcançar + lo — overtaking him, catching up with him (gerund + object lo; alcançándolo va 'goes along overtaking him'; = alcanzándolo)
glossary.alcançólo: alcançar + lo — he overtook him (preterite 3rd sg. alcançó + enclitic lo; = lo alcanzó)
glossary.braças: braça — fathom, an arm-spread measure of length (fem. pl.; a tres braças 'three arm-spans away'; = brazas, now 'fathoms'; exact length uncertain)
glossary.dádol: dar + le — given him (past part. dado + enclitic l(e) 'to him'; dádol ha, the perfect with the participle set before aver, 'he has given him'; = le ha dado)
glossary.tollidas: tollir — cut off, taken away (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with carbonclas; tollidas gelas ha 'has cut them off from him'; = quitadas)
glossary.librado: librar — freed, dispatched, cleared (past part. masc. sg.; librado todo lo al 'all the rest being dispatched/cut through'; sense uncertain)
glossary.tizón: Tizón — Tizón, the sword of King Búcar, won by the Cid (proper name; = Tizón)
glossary.vençió: vençer — he won, defeated (preterite 3rd sg.; vençió la batalla 'he won the battle'; = venció)
glossary.preçiava: preçiar — he valued, prized (imperfect 3rd sg.; = apreciaba)
glossary.vinía: venir — he came, was coming (imperfect 3rd sg., -ía ending; = venía)
glossary.soltado: soltar — loosened, let down (past part. masc. sg.; almófar soltado 'hood of mail thrown back'; = soltado)
glossary.pelos: pelo — hair (masc. pl., of the head; = pelos, cabello)
glossary.yaquanto: yaquanto — somewhat, a little (ya + quanto; Pidal 'algo'; della yaquanto 'somewhat of it'; = algo, un poco)
glossary.alegrós: alegrar + se — he rejoiced, was glad (preterite 3rd sg. alegró + reflexive se cut to s; = se alegró)
glossary.fio: fiar — I trust (present 1st sg.; fiar por Dios 'to trust in God'; = fío)
glossary.espadado: espadado — slashed with swords, hacked (past part. of an old verb espadar, Pidal's espad[ad]o; todo espadado of the shield; Pidal notes the wooden shield kept the marks of sword and lance blows; no modern verb, closest acuchillado)
glossary.logrado: lograr — achieved, got (past part. masc. sg.; non gelo avien logrado 'they had not got their way with it'; Pidal's note: 'no habían logrado su intento', 'no habían salido con la suya'; = logrado)
glossary.matado: matar — killed (past part. masc. sg.; ha moros matado 'has killed Moors', aver + participle; = matado)
glossary.matastes: matar — you killed (preterite 2nd pl., old -stes ending, used respectfully to one person; = matasteis)
glossary.arrancamos: arrancar — we routed, drove off (preterite 1st pl., in form also present; arrancar el canpo 'to rout the enemy from the field', win the battle; = derrotamos)
glossary.bienes: bien — goods, possessions, wealth (masc. pl. noun; todos estos bienes 'all this wealth'; = bienes)
glossary.ensayados: ensayar — having exerted themselves, proved (past part. masc. pl.; ensayarse 'to exert oneself in the fight, do deeds of prowess', with ser as perfect auxiliary: son ensayados 'have distinguished themselves', Pidal 'aquí se han distinguido'; = se han distinguido)
glossary.fartos: farto — sated, having had their fill (adj. masc. pl.; fartos de lidiar 'sated with fighting'; = hartos)
glossary.touieron: tener — they took (it) as, held (preterite 3rd pl., strong; lo touieron a escarnio 'took it as mockery'; = tuvieron)
glossary.escarnio: escarnio — mockery, derision (masc. noun; tener a escarnio 'to take as mockery'; Pidal's restoration [escarnio], the whole word; = escarnio)
glossary.cadie: caer — it fell to, came to (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie ending with -d- kept; Pidal's ca[di]e; a la raçión cadie 'to each share fell'; = caía)
glossary.cuydaron: cuydar — they thought, supposed (preterite 3rd pl.; cuydaron que 'they thought that'; = cuidaron, archaic for 'pensaron')
glossary.minguados: minguar — lacking, in want, diminished (past part. masc. pl.; nunqua serien minguados 'they would never be in want'; = menguados)
glossary.arreados: arrear — equipped, furnished, adorned (past part. masc. pl.; muy bien arreados 'very well furnished'; = arreados)
glossary.sazones: sazón — season, due time (fem. pl.; a sazones, 'in season, at the right times', of provisions; Pidal's page gives no note on this verse, sense taken from context; = sazones, a su tiempo)
glossary.pieles: piel — skin, fur, pelt (fem. pl.; buenas pieles 'good furs'; = pieles)
glossary.vencieron: vençer — they won, defeated (preterite 3rd pl.; = vencieron)
glossary.lidiaran: lidiar — they had fought, they fought (-ra form 3rd pl., from the Latin pluperfect in -(av)erant, keeping its old pluperfect value; = habían lidiado, lidiaron; modern lidiaran is imperfect subjunctive)
glossary.ondrados: ondrar — honored, esteemed (past part. masc. pl.; = honrados)
glossary.prisiessen: prender — (that) they take (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., strong stem pris-; prender so derecho 'to take one's due'; = prendiesen, tomasen)
glossary.cadierónle: caer + le — they fell to him, came to him as his share (preterite 3rd pl. cadieron, the old -d- form, + enclitic le 'to him'; = le cayeron)
glossary.serién: seer — they would be (conditional 3rd pl., imperfect-type ending -ién; = serían)
glossary.minguado: minguar — lacking, in want (past part. masc. sg.; 'diminished, reduced'; = menguado)
glossary.arranco: arrancar — I rout, I win (present 1st sg.; arrancar las lides 'to win battles', arrancar 'to pull out, uproot' hence 'to rout'; = arranco)
glossary.abrám: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl., spelled with b and final -m; abrám de mi salto 'they will have (suffer) my attack', Pidal 'que yo les asalte'; = habrán)
glossary.piensso: pensar — I think, I intend (present 1st sg., spelled with ss; = pienso)
glossary.paguen: pagar — (that) they pay (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = paguen)
glossary.ovier: aver — I/he shall have (future subjunctive 1st or 3rd sg., final -e dropped, = oviere; a qui yo ovier sabor 'to whomever I please', Pidal 'a quien yo quisiere'; = hubiere)
glossary.valía: valía — worth, value (fem. noun; valía de çinco mill marcos 'worth five thousand marks'; = valía, valor)
glossary.crió: criar — he raised, brought up, trained (preterite 3rd sg.; = crió)
glossary.recibiólos: recebir + los — he received them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic los; = los recibió)
glossary.cuñados: cuñado — kinsman by marriage, in-law (masc. pl.; Pidal: in general 'pariente por afinidad', not only 'brother-in-law', so said to the husbands of one's cousins; = parientes políticos, cuñados)
glossary.valemos: valer — we are worth (present 1st pl.; = valemos)
glossary.abraçen: abraçar — (let) them embrace (present subjunctive 3rd pl., jussive; = abracen)
glossary.abredes: aver — you will have (future 2nd pl., contracted from avredes; = habréis)
glossary.honor: honor — honour (spelled with h-; in the sense of ondra 'honour', not onor 'estate, lordship'; = honor, honra)
glossary.lidiado: lidiar — fought (past part.; aver + participle, avemos lidiado 'we have fought'; = lidiado)
glossary.matamos: matar — we killed (preterite 1st pl., same form as the present; = matamos)
glossary.traydor: traidor — traitor (= traidor, old spelling traydor)
glossary.provado: provar — proven, tried and found (past part. as adjective; traydor provado 'proven traitor'; = probado)
glossary.pensad: pensar — think, see to (imperative 2nd pl.; pensar de 'to attend to, take care of', Pidal 'cuidaos de'; = pensad, ocupaos de)
glossary.tenémoslo: tener + lo — we have it, we hold it (present 1st pl. tenemos + enclitic lo; = lo tenemos)
glossary.saluo: salvo — safe, in safety (u spelling for v; en saluo 'in safekeeping'; = salvo)
glossary.sediense: seer + se — they were sitting, they were (imperfect 3rd pl. sedien, unaccented as printed, + enclitic se; with a gerund, 'were (doing)'; = estaban sentados, se estaban)
glossary.lidiara: lidiar — he had fought, he fought (-ra form 3rd sg., from the Latin pluperfect in -(av)erat, keeping its old pluperfect value; quien lidiara mejor 'who had fought best'; = había lidiado, lidió; modern lidiara is imperfect subjunctive)
glossary.juegos: juego — jest, sport, game (masc. pl.; = juegos)
glossary.levantando: levantar — raising, setting up (gerund; ir + gerund ivan levantando 'were going on raising'; = levantando)
glossary.escarmentando: escarmentar — chastising, punishing, teaching a hard lesson (gerund; of mockery that stings; = escarmentando)
glossary.conssejaron: consejar — they took counsel, they advised (preterite 3rd pl., ss spelling; reflexive se conssejaron 'they took counsel together'; = aconsejaron, se aconsejaron) · also conssejar — to plot, scheme (conssejaron traçión 'they plotted treachery'; Pidal 'maquinaron traición'; = tramaron)
glossary.veramientre: veramientre — truly, really (adverb from vera 'true' + -mientre, the old form of -mente; = verdaderamente)
glossary.fáblaron: fablar — they spoke (preterite 3rd pl., f- for h-; = hablaron)
glossary.detardamos: detardar — we delay, we linger (present 1st pl.; = tardamos, nos demoramos)
glossary.pidamos: pedir — let us ask (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; = pidamos)
glossary.digamos: dezir — let us say (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; digamos que 'let us say that'; = digamos)
glossary.llevaremos: llevar (levar) — we shall carry, take (future 1st pl., spelt with ll; = llevaremos)
glossary.enseñar: enseñar — to show, point out (infinitive; also first half of a split future, enseñar las hemos 'we shall show them'; = enseñar, mostrar)
glossary.heredadas: heredar — endowed with an inheritance, provided with lands (past part. fem. pl.; ser heredadas 'to be endowed, have one's estates'; = heredadas, dotadas de heredades)
glossary.retrayan: retraer — they may reproach, cast up against (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; nos retrayan 'they may throw in our faces', Pidal 'nos echen en cara'; = retraigan)
glossary.levaremos: levar — we shall carry, take along (future 1st pl.; = llevaremos)
glossary.valen: valer — they are worth (present 3rd pl.; averes que valen grant valor 'goods of great worth'; = valen)
glossary.escarniremos: escarnir (escarnecer) — we shall mock, dishonour, humiliate (future 1st pl.; = escarneceremos, closest deshonraremos)
glossary.callar: callar — to fall silent, be silent (infinitive; fizo callar la cort 'he made the court fall silent'; = callar)
glossary.arras: arras — dower: the towns and lands the bridegroom gives the bride on marrying her (fem. pl.; Pidal 'las villas y tierras que el varón da a la mujer al casarse con ella'; meter en arras 'to put in possession of the dower', Pidal 'posesionar de las arras'; = arras); distinct from axuvar, the trousseau from the bride's parents
glossary.diemos: dar — we gave (preterite 1st pl., old -ie- form; = dimos)
glossary.veran: ver — they will see (future 3rd pl., unaccented as printed; = verán)
glossary.oviéremos: aver — we may have, shall have (future subjunctive 1st pl.; los fijos que oviéremos 'the sons we may have'; = hubiéremos, now expressed by tengamos)
glossary.avrán: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl.; = habrán)
glossary.partiçión: partiçión — division, share in an inheritance (fem.; aver partiçión 'to have a share'; = partición)
glossary.curiava: curiar — to guard, take care of; reflexive curiarse de 'to be on one's guard against, suspect' (imperfect 3rd sg.; nos curiava de = non se curiava de 'he had no suspicion of', Pidal 'no se recelaba'; = (se) cuidaba, recelaba)
glossary.diestes: dar — you gave (preterite 2nd pl., old -istes; = disteis)
glossary.quiéroles: querer + les — I wish (present 1st sg., with diphthong, + enclitic dative les 'to them'; = les quiero)
glossary.paños: paño — cloth, fabric, garment of cloth (masc. pl.; = paños)
glossary.çiclatones: çiclatón — ciclatón, a rich silk cloth, gold-worked or fine (masc. pl.; = ciclatones)
glossary.levades: levar — you carry off, take away (present 2nd pl., old -ades; = lleváis)
glossary.telas: tela — web, membrane; telas del coraçón 'the membranes of the heart', what is dearest (fem. pl.; = telas)
glossary.enbio: enbiar — I send (present 1st sg., unaccented as printed; = envío)
glossary.servides: servir — you serve (present indicative 2nd pl., old -ides; si bien las servides 'if you serve them well'; = servís)
glossary.rendré: render — I shall give, pay back (future 1st sg., syncopated; vos rendré galardón 'I shall repay you'; = rendiré)
glossary.atorgado: atorgar — granted, agreed to (past part. masc. sg., with lo; atorgado lo han 'they have agreed to it'; = otorgado)
glossary.mandavan: mandar — they were ordering (imperfect 3rd pl.; = mandaban)
glossary.escurren: escurrir — they see off, escort a departing traveller on his way (present 3rd pl.; Pidal 'despiden', comp. v. 1067; = despiden, acompañan)
glossary.cid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (spelt without the cedilla where Pidal restores the word in italics, [Cid]; = Çid)
glossary.espidimiento: espidimiento — leave-taking, farewell (masc.; en espidimiento son 'they are taking their leave'; = despedida)
glossary.pedimos: pedir — we ask (present 1st pl.; merçed vos pedimos 'we ask your favour'; = pedimos)
glossary.engendrastes: engendrar — you begot (preterite 2nd pl., old -astes; = engendrasteis)
glossary.parió: parir — she bore, gave birth to (preterite 3rd sg.; = parió)
glossary.enviades: enviar — you send (present 2nd pl., old -ades; = enviáis)
glossary.cunplir: cunplir — to fulfil, carry out (infinitive; debdo nos es a cunplir 'it is our duty to carry out'; = cumplir)
glossary.mandáredes: mandar — you shall command (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; lo que mandáredes 'whatever you command'; = mandareis, now expressed by mandéis)
glossary.abraçólas: abraçar + las — he embraced them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic object las; = las abrazó)
glossary.saludólas: saludar + las — he greeted them, with the kiss of greeting or farewell (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic object las; Pidal 'las besó'; = las saludó, las besó)
glossary.doblava: doblar — he/she doubled, did as much again (imperfect 3rd sg.; la madre lo doblava 'the mother did it twice over'; = doblaba)
glossary.andad: andar — go, go on (imperative 2nd pl.; = andad, closest id)
glossary.bendixieron: bendezir — they blessed (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = bendijeron)
glossary.diéronles: dar + les — they gave them (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic dative les; = les dieron)
glossary.penssavan: penssar (pensar) — they were thinking (imperfect 3rd pl.; penssar de + inf. 'to set about, make ready to'; = pensaban)
glossary.clara: claro — bright, fair, illustrious (fem. sg.; Valençia la clara 'Valencia the fair'; = clara)
glossary.avueros: agüero — omen, augury (masc. pl.; en los avueros 'in the omens', by observing omens; = agüeros)
glossary.tacha: tacha — flaw, blemish, stain on one's honour (fem.; non … sin alguna tacha 'not without some blemish'; = tacha)
glossary.repentir: repentir — to repent, go back on (infinitive, used reflexively: nos puede repentir = non se puede repentir 'he cannot go back on it'; = arrepentirse)
glossary.primo: primo — cousin (masc. sg.; primo eres de mis fijas 'you are cousin to my daughters'; = primo)
glossary.mándot: mandar + te — I order you (present 1st sg. + enclitic te, e dropped; mándot que vayas 'I order you to go'; = te mando)
glossary.vayas: ir — you go, may you go (present subjunctive 2nd sg.; mándot que vayas 'I bid you go'; = vayas)
glossary.verás: veer — you will see (future 2nd sg.; = verás)
glossary.dadas: dar — given (past participle fem. pl., agreeing with heredades; a mis fijas dadas son 'are given to my daughters'; = dadas)
glossary.vernás: venir — you will come (future 2nd sg., syncopated, with -r- for -dr-; = vendrás)
glossary.tornémosnos: tornar + nos — let us go back (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative, with reflexive nos kept after the full -mos ending; = volvámonos)
glossary.veder: veer — to see (infinitive, the old full form, its de restored by Pidal in italics, ve[de]r; ir las hemos veder 'we will go to see them'; = ver)
glossary.acomendamos: acomendar — we entrust, commend (present 1st pl.; = encomendamos)
glossary.atales: atal — such (pl.; a- + tal; atales cosas 'such things'; = tales)
glossary.respondien: responder — they answered (imperfect 3rd pl., -ién ending; = respondían)
glossary.departiçión: departiçión — parting, separation (fem.; a la departiçión 'at the parting'; = despedida, separación)
glossary.lloran: llorar — they weep (present 3rd pl.; lloran de coraçón 'they weep from the heart'; = lloran)
glossary.fazían: fazer — they did, acted (imperfect 3rd pl.; assí fazían 'so did, likewise'; = hacían)
glossary.oyas: oír — hear! (present subjunctive 2nd sg. used as an exhortation, probably; Oyas, sobrino 'Listen, nephew'; = oigas, in sense 'oye')
glossary.iredes: ir — you will go (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = iréis)
glossary.yazredes: yazer — you will lie, lodge (future 2nd pl., syncopated yazr- for yazer-, old -edes; i yazredes una noch 'you will spend one night there'; = yaceréis)
glossary.saludad: saludar — greet (imperative 2nd pl., d kept; saludad a mio amigo 'give my greetings to my friend'; = saludad)
glossary.reciba: recebir — let him receive (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive; reciba a mios yernos 'let him welcome my sons-in-law'; = reciba)
glossary.pudier: poder — he can, may be able (future subjunctive 3rd sg., final -e dropped; commo ell pudier mejor 'as best he can'; = pudiere)
glossary.dil: dezir + le — tell him (imperative 2nd sg. di + enclitic le, e dropped; = dile)
glossary.ovieren: aver — they may have (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; de lo que ovieren huebos 'of what they may have need'; = hubieren)
glossary.sírvalas: servir + las — let him serve them (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive, + enclitic las; = sírvalas)
glossary.escúrralas: escurrir + las — let him escort them, see them on their way (present subjunctive 3rd sg., jussive, + enclitic las; no modern verb of this sense; = que las acompañe)
glossary.fiziere: fazer — he may do (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; de quanto él fiziere 'for all he does'; = hiciere)
glossary.yol: yo + le — I (to) him (subject yo + enclitic dative le, e dropped; yol daré 'I shall give him'; = yo le)
glossary.partidos: partir — parted, separated (past participle masc. pl., with son 'they are parted'; = partidos)
glossary.nasçió: nasçer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg.; en buen ora nasçió, part of the poem's birth-formula 'born in a good hour'; = nació)
glossary.alvarrazín: Alvarrazín — Albarracín (Teruel), named for the Muslim family of the Aben Razín who held it (Pidal, note to v. 1462); Santa María d'Alvarrazín, the Infantes' halt on the road from Valencia towards Molina (= Albarracín)
glossary.félos: fe + los — behold them (fe an interjection of presentation, + enclitic los; félos en Molina 'there they are at Molina'; = helos aquí / ahí los tenéis)
glossary.recebir: recebir — to receive, welcome (infinitive; saliólos recebir 'went out to welcome them'; = recibir)
glossary.avorozes: avoroz — rejoicing, festivity (masc. pl. avorozes; Pidal 'alborozos, regocijos'; con grandes avorozes 'with great rejoicing'; = alborozos)
glossary.sirvió: servir — he served, treated well (preterite 3rd sg.; bien los sirvió 'he served them well'; = sirvió)
glossary.escurrir: escurrir — to escort, see off (infinitive; escurrir los mandó 'he ordered (them) to escort'; no modern verb of this sense; = acompañar)
glossary.luzón: Luzón — Luzón, a village of the province of Guadalajara between Medinaceli and Molina (Pidal, note to v. 1491); los montes de Luzón, the 'wild and high mountains' of v. 1491, crossed on the road between Molina and the Jalón (= Luzón)
glossary.anssarera: Anssarera — a place unknown today, which must have lain between Medinaceli and the river Jalón (Pidal, el Ansarera); where the party lodged after crossing Arbuxuelo (el Anssarera, with the article)
glossary.posados: posar — lodged, encamped (past participle masc. pl., with son; ellos posados son 'they are lodged'; = posados, alojados)
glossary.vedien: veer — they were seeing, saw (imperfect 3rd pl., -ié ending, with the old -d- restored in ve[d]ien; = veían)
glossary.entramos: entramos — both (masc. pl., from Latin inter ambos; entramos hermanos 'both brothers'; = entrambos, ambos)
glossary.pudiéssemos: poder — we could (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl., in a conditional clause; si pudiéssemos matar 'if we could kill'; = pudiésemos)
glossary.quanta: quanto — as much as, all that (fem. sg., agreeing with riquiza; quanta riquiza tiene 'all the wealth he has'; = cuanta)
glossary.yemos: aver — would (conditional ending -iemos, 1st pl., written apart after the infinitive and a pronoun in a split conditional; aver la yemos 'we would have it'; = la habríamos; -iemos = -íamos)
glossary.latinado: latinado — one who knows 'Latin', i.e. the Romance tongue of the Christians (adjective used as noun; Pidal 'ladino, que sabe la lengua romance'; moro latinado 'a Romance-speaking Moor'; = ladino)
glossary.entendió: entender — he understood (preterite 3rd sg., here 'overheard, took in'; gelo entendió 'understood it'; = entendió)
glossary.díxolo: dezir + lo — he said it, told it (strong preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = lo dijo)
glossary.acáyaz: acáyaz — governor, commander of a fortress (Pidal 'alcaide', the same as alcáyaz, v. 1502; = alcaide)
glossary.cúriate: curiar + te — guard yourself, beware (imperative 2nd sg. + enclitic te; cúriate destos 'beware of these men'; = cuídate)
glossary.odi: oír — I heard (preterite 1st sg., with the old -d- restored in o[d]i; = oí)
glossary.conssejar: conssejar — to counsel, plot (infinitive, ss spelling; tu muert odi conssejar 'I heard (them) plotting your death'; = aconsejar; tramar)
glossary.barragán: barragán — brave young man, stout fellow, warrior (masc. sg.; Pidal 'buen mozo', 'esforzado'; mucho era buen barragán 'was a right valiant man'; = barragán)
glossary.parós: parar + se — he stopped, took his stand (preterite 3rd sg. paró + reflexive se; parós ante los ifantes 'he halted before the Infantes'; = se paró)
glossary.dexás: dexar — (if) I left alone, held back (imperfect subjunctive 1st sg., dexasse with the final -e dropped, as desenparás v. 1471, probably; si no lo dexás por mio Çid 'if I did not hold back for my Çid's sake'; = dejase)
glossary.faría: fazer — I would do (conditional 1st sg.; tal cosa vos faría 'I would do you such a thing'; = haría)
glossary.sonás: sonar — it should resound, be talked of (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., sonasse with the final -e dropped, as dexás, probably; que por el mundo sonás 'that it would resound through the world'; = sonase)
glossary.levaría: levar — I would carry off, take (conditional 1st sg.; levaría sus fijas al Campeador 'I would take his daughters back to the Campeador'; = llevaría)
glossary.entrariedes: entrar — you would enter (conditional 2nd pl., -iedes ending; = entraríais)
glossary.jamás: jamás — ever; nunqua … jamás 'never ever, never again' (= jamás)
glossary.fiz: fazer — I did (preterite 1st sg., strong stem; qué vos fiz 'what did I do to you'; = hice)
glossary.sirviéndovos: servir + vos — serving you (gerund + enclitic vos; yo sirviéndovos sin art 'I serving you without guile'; = sirviéndoos)
glossary.conssejastes: consejar — you plotted, advised (preterite 2nd pl., -astes ending, ss spelling; vos conssejastes mi muort 'you plotted my death'; = aconsejasteis, here tramasteis)
glossary.muort: muerte — death (fem. noun, apocopated; Pidal's mu[o]rt, with the diphthong; mi muort 'my death'; = muerte)
glossary.aquim: aquí + me — here I (aquí + enclitic me, e dropped; aquim parto de vos 'here I part from you'; = aquí me)
glossary.traydores: traidor — traitor (masc. pl.; de malos e de traydores 'from wicked men and traitors'; = traidores)
glossary.grade: gradar + se — may he be glad, take pleasure (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative, the se in que[s]; d' aqueste casamiento que[s] grade el Campeador 'may the Campeador be glad of this marriage'; as Grádanse v. 172; = se alegre)
glossary.quommo: commo — as, like (spelling variant with quo-, Pidal's qu[o]mmo; quommo de buen seso 'like one of good sense'; = como)
glossary.movieron: mover — they set out, moved off (preterite 3rd pl., strong; movieron del Anssarera 'they set out from the Anssarera'; = movieron)
glossary.acójense: acoger + se — they set about, betake themselves (present 3rd pl. + enclitic se; acójense a andar 'they set about travelling'; = se acogen)
glossary.ssiniestro: siniestro — left (hand, side), noun use (a ssiniestro 'on the left'; double s is a spelling; = izquierda)
glossary.passáronla: passar + la — they crossed it (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic la; la sierra de Miedes passáronla 'the range of Miedes they crossed'; = la pasaron)
glossary.assiniestro: a + siniestro — on the left (a written together with siniestro; assiniestro dexan 'on the left they leave'; = a la izquierda)
glossary.griza: Griza — a place on the Infantes' left between the Montes Claros and San Esteban, said to have been settled by Álamos (a Griza que Álamos pobló); Pidal gives no note here; otherwise unidentified
glossary.álamos: Álamos — a man's name, the settler or founder of Griza (que Álamos pobló 'which Álamos founded'); otherwise unidentified here
glossary.pobló: poblar — he settled, founded (preterite 3rd sg.; Griza que Álamos pobló 'Griza, which Álamos settled'; = pobló)
glossary.caños: caño — conduit, cavern, perhaps 'caves, grottoes' (masc. pl.; allí son caños 'there are caverns'; sense inferred from context, uncertain)
glossary.elpha: Elpha — a woman's name (Elfa), the person shut away at Griza (do a Elpha ençerró 'where he shut up Elpha'; a = personal a; otherwise unidentified)
glossary.ençerró: encerrar — he shut in, confined (preterite 3rd sg.; do a Elpha ençerró 'where he shut Elpha up'; = encerró)
glossary.asant: a + Sant — San (a before a place-name object of dexan, as a Griza v. 2694, + apocopated Sant before Estevan; a diestro dexan aSant Estevan 'on the right they leave San Esteban'; = a San)
glossary.aluon: alueñe — far, at a distance (adverb, Pidal's alu[o]n; mas ca[d]e aluon 'but it lies far off'; = lejos)
glossary.robredo: robredo — oak wood, oak grove (masc.; el robredo de Corpes 'the oak wood of Corpes'; = robledo, robledal)
glossary.corpes: Corpes — the oak wood where the daughters are abandoned (robredo de Corpes); Pidal: it has disappeared today, and lay south-west of San Esteban de Gormaz
glossary.altos: alto — high, tall (masc. pl.; los montes son altos 'the woods are high'; = altos)
glossary.ramas: rama — branch (fem. pl.; las ramas pujan 'the branches climb'; = ramas)
glossary.pujan: pujar — they rise, climb (present 3rd pl.; las ramas pujan con las nuoves 'the branches climb up to the clouds'; = suben)
glossary.nuoves: nube — cloud (fem. pl., Pidal's nu[ov]es with the diphthong; = nubes)
glossary.aderredor: aderredor — around, round about (adverb, a- + derredor; que andan aderredor 'that range around'; = alrededor)
glossary.vergel: vergel — orchard, pleasant garden (masc.; un vergel con una linpia fuont 'a garden with a clear spring'; = vergel)
glossary.fuont: fuente — spring (fem., apocopated, Pidal's fu[o]nt with the diphthong; linpia fuont 'a clear spring'; = fuente)
glossary.mandan: mandar — they order (present 3rd pl.; mandan fincar la tienda 'they order the tent pitched'; = mandan)
glossary.demuéstranles: demostrar + les — they show them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic les; demuéstranles amor 'they show them love'; = les demuestran)
glossary.cunplieron: cumplir — they carried out, fulfilled (preterite 3rd pl.; mal gelo cunplieron 'ill they carried it out for them', apparently ironic; = cumplieron)
glossary.mandaron: mandar — they ordered (preterite 3rd pl.; assí lo mandaron 'so they ordered'; = mandaron)
glossary.albergaron: albergar — they lodged, took shelter (preterite 3rd pl.; do albergaron de noch 'where they lodged by night'; = albergaron)
glossary.criazón: criazón — household, those reared in a lord's house (fem. collective; los de criazón 'the household folk', Pidal 'sus familiares, las personas criadas en su casa'; = criados)
glossary.fincás: fincar — (that) he should remain (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., -ás by apocope for fincasse; que non i fincás ninguno 'that none should stay there'; = quedase)
glossary.comidieron: comedir — they planned, intended (preterite 3rd pl.; tanto mal comidieron 'so much harm they plotted'; Pidal 'meditaron'; = meditaron, tramaron; modern comedirse means 'to be obliging')
glossary.escarnidas: escarnir — mocked, dishonored (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with the daughters; seredes escarnidas 'you will be shamed'; = escarnecidas)
glossary.fieros: fiero — wild, rugged, dread (masc. pl.; fieros montes 'wild woods'; = fieros)
glossary.daxadas: dexar — abandoned, left (past part. fem. pl., a-spelling for dexadas; daxadas seredes de nos 'you will be abandoned by us'; = dejadas)
glossary.vengaremos: vengar — we shall avenge (future 1st pl.; nos vengaremos aquesta por la del león 'we shall avenge this for the lion affair'; = vengaremos)
glossary.páranlas: parar + las — they leave them, set them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; páranlas en cuerpos 'they leave them in their shifts only'; = las dejan, las ponen)
glossary.camisas: camisa — shift, undergarment (fem. pl.; en camisas 'in their shifts'; = camisas)
glossary.espuelas: espuela — spur (fem. pl.; espuelas tienen calçadas 'they have spurs on'; = espuelas)
glossary.calçadas: calçar — put on, fitted (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with espuelas; espuelas tienen calçadas 'they have their spurs on'; = calzadas)
glossary.çinchas: çincha — girth, saddle strap (fem. pl.; spelling variant of cinchas; = cinchas)
glossary.duradores: durador — lasting, tough (adjective pl., one form for both genders, here with fem. çinchas; çinchas fuertes e duradores 'strong, tough girths'; = duraderas)
glossary.rogamos: rogar — we beg (present 1st pl.; por Dios vos rogamos 'we beg you for God's sake'; = rogamos)
glossary.tajadores: tajador — cutting, keen (adjective pl., one form for both genders, here with fem. espadas; espadas fuertes e tajadores 'strong, sharp swords'; = cortantes)
glossary.cortandos: cortar + nos — cut for us (imperative 2nd pl. cortad + enclitic nos with the d and n transposed; cortandos las cabeças 'cut off our heads'; as dándoslas v. 2081, indos v. 832; = cortadnos)
glossary.mártires: mártir — martyr (masc. pl.; mártires seremos 'we shall be martyrs'; = mártires)
glossary.departirán: departir — they will discuss, talk over (future 3rd pl.; departirán desta razón 'will talk about this matter'; = departirán, hablarán; modern departir 'to converse')
glossary.mereçemos: merecer — we deserve (present 1st pl.; por lo que nos mereçemos 'for what we deserve'; = merecemos)
glossary.prendemos: prender — we receive, get (present 1st pl.; no lo prendemos nos 'we do not receive it'; = recibimos; sense 'suffer' perhaps)
glossary.enssienplos: enssienplo — notable deed, act (Pidal 'hecho notable, acción'; masc. pl., Latin exemplum; atan malos enssienplos non fagades sobre nos 'do not do such wicked deeds upon us'; = ejemplos, here hechos)
glossary.fuéremos: seer — we may be, if we are (future subjunctive 1st pl.; si nos fuéremos majadas 'if we are beaten'; = fuéremos)
glossary.majadas: majar — beaten, battered (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with nos; fuéremos majadas 'we are beaten'; = majadas; modern majar 'to pound')
glossary.abiltaredes: abiltar — you will dishonor (future 2nd pl., -edes; abiltaredes a vos 'you will dishonor yourselves'; = envileceréis)
glossary.retraer: retraer — to reproach, cast up (infinitive; retraer vos lo an 'they will reproach you with it', split future with an 'they will'; = reprochar)
glossary.cortes: corte — court, royal assembly (fem. pl.; en vistas o en cortes 'at meetings or at courts'; = cortes)
glossary.ruegan: rogar — they beg (present 3rd pl., with the diphthong; lo que ruegan las dueñas 'what the ladies beg'; = ruegan)
glossary.corredizas: corredizo — running, slip (fem. pl.; çinchas corredizas 'running girths', perhaps loose-ended or slipping straps; = corredizas, modern 'sliding'; nuance uncertain)
glossary.májanlas: majar + las — they beat them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; májanlas tan sin sabor 'they beat them so without mercy'; = las majan)
glossary.agudas: agudo — sharp (fem. pl.; espuelas agudas 'sharp spurs'; = agudas)
glossary.ronpien: romper — they were tearing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ie ending; ronpien las camisas 'they were tearing the shifts'; = rompían)
glossary.carnes: carne — flesh (fem. pl.; las camisas e las carnes 'the shifts and the flesh'; = carnes)
glossary.sienten: sentir — they feel (present 3rd pl.; ya lo sienten 'now they feel it'; = sienten)
glossary.assomasse: assomar — (that) he might appear (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; que assomasse essora el Çid 'that the Cid might appear just then'; = asomase)
glossary.majaron: majar — they beat (preterite 3rd pl.; tanto las majaron 'so much they beat them'; = majaron)
glossary.cosimente: cosimente — (sin cosimente) probably 'without strength, exhausted' (Pidal: probablemente 'sin fuerzas, agotadas'; noun, rare; sin cosimente son 'they have no strength left'; no modern equivalent, closest sin fuerzas)
glossary.sangrientas: sangriento — bloody, blood-stained (fem. pl.; sangrientas en las camisas 'bloody on the shifts'; = sangrientas)
glossary.ciclatones: çiclatón — ciclatón, a rich silk cloth (masc. pl.; spelling variant with c-; = ciclatones)
glossary.canssados: cansar — tired, weary (past part. masc. pl., ss spelling; canssados son de ferir 'they are tired of striking'; = cansados)
glossary.ensayandos: ensayar + se — exerting themselves (Pidal 'esforzándose', as at v. 2388) (gerund + enclitic se, e dropped; ensayandos amos quál dará mejores colpes 'both vying as to who will give the better blows'; = ensayándose)
glossary.muertas: muerto — dead (past part. fem. pl.; por muertas las dexaron 'they left them for dead'; = muertas)
glossary.dexaron: dexar — they left (preterite 3rd pl.; por muertas las dexaron 'they left them for dead'; = dejaron)
glossary.leváronles: levar + les — they took from them (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic les, dative of removal; leváronles los mantos 'they took their cloaks from them'; = les llevaron)
glossary.armiñas: armiño — of ermine (adjective, fem. pl.; pieles armiñas 'ermine furs'; = de armiño)
glossary.déxanlas: dexar + las — they leave them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; déxanlas marridas 'they leave them fainting'; = las dejan)
glossary.marridas: marrido — afflicted, grieved; here fainting, in a swoon (fem. pl.; Pidal: generalmente 'afligido, apenado'; aquí 'desmayado'; déxanlas marridas 'they leave them fainting'; = desmayadas)
glossary.briales: brial — tunic, a close-fitting robe of rich cloth (masc. pl.; Pidal: la camisa y el brial o ciclatón, note to v. 2721; en briales y en camisas 'in their tunics and shifts'; = briales)
glossary.bivas: bivo — alive (fem. pl.; non por bivas 'not as living'; = vivas)
glossary.assomas: assomar — (if) he might appear (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., apocopated -ás for -asse, assomás; serie si assomas essora el Çid 'what fortune it would be if the Cid appeared then'; = asomase)
glossary.ívanse: ir + se — they went (on) (imperfect 3rd pl. + enclitic se, the se belonging to alabando: ívanse alabando 'they went boasting', = iban alabándose; = se iban)
glossary.alabando: alabar — praising, boasting (gerund; ellos ívanse alabando 'they went off boasting'; = alabándose)
glossary.vengados: vengar — avenged (past part. masc. pl.; somos vengados 'we are avenged'; = vengados)
glossary.deviemos: dever — we ought (imperfect 1st pl., old -iemos ending = -íamos; non las deviemos tomar 'we ought not to have taken them'; = debíamos)
glossary.varraganas: barragana — concubine, a woman kept without marriage (fem. pl.; tomar por varraganas 'to take as concubines'; = barraganas)
glossary.fossemos: seer — we were (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl., -ssemos, Pidal's f[o]ssemos; si non fossemos rogados 'unless we were asked'; = fuésemos)
glossary.rogados: rogar — asked, begged (past part. masc. pl.; si non fossemos rogados 'unless we were asked'; = rogados)
glossary.parejas: pareja — equal, peer, match (fem. pl.; nuestras parejas 'our equals', Pidal 'iguales nuestras', the noun later 'lawful wife'; = parejas, iguales)
glossary.desondra: desondra — dishonor, outrage (fem., des- + onra; la desondra del león 'the dishonor of the lion'; = deshonra)
glossary.assís: assí + se — thus (assí + reflexive/impersonal se; assís irá vengando 'so it will be avenged'; = así se)
glossary.vengando: vengar — avenging, being avenged (gerund; irá vengando 'it will go on being avenged'; ir + gerund; = vengando)
glossary.alabandos: alabar + se — boasting (of themselves) (gerund alabando + enclitic se, -se reduced to -s as in tornós; Alabandos ivan 'they went about boasting'; ir + gerund; = alabándose)
glossary.alabándos: alabar + se — boasting (gerund + enclitic se reduced to -s; Alabándos se[d]ían 'they were boasting'; = alabándose)
glossary.sedían: seer — they were (imperfect 3rd pl., -ía ending, Pidal's restoration se[d]ían; seer + gerund, 'were (busy) doing': Alabándos sedían 'they were boasting'; = estaban, eran)
glossary.diré: dezir — I shall tell (future 1st sg., contracted dir-é; yo vos diré 'I shall tell you'; = diré)
glossary.mandáronle: mandar + le — they ordered him (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic dative le; mandáronle ir adelante 'they ordered him to go on ahead'; = le mandaron)
glossary.doliól: doler + le — it pained him; doliól el coraçón 'his heart misgave him' (preterite 3rd sg. dolió + enclitic le reduced to -l; Pidal 'le dió una corazonada, tuvo un presentimiento'; = le dolió)
glossary.espesso: espesso — thick, dense (adj. masc. sg., ss spelling; un monte espesso 'a thick wood'; = espeso)
glossary.primas: prima — cousin (fem. pl.; sus primas 'his cousins'; = primas)
glossary.víolos: ver + los — he saw them (preterite 3rd sg. vío + enclitic los; Víolos venir 'he saw them coming'; = los vio)
glossary.vidien: ver — they saw, were seeing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ie ending, printed unaccented, Pidal's vi[di]en; ellos nol vidien 'they did not see him'; = veían)
glossary.sabien: saber — they knew (imperfect 3rd pl., -ie ending, printed unaccented; ni dend sabien ración 'nor knew anything of it'; = sabían)
glossary.ración: ración — portion, share (fem.; ni dend sabien ración 'nor did they know any part of it', i.e. nothing at all; sense from context, Pidal gives no note; = ración, here nada)
glossary.vidiessen: ver — they might see (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., Pidal's vi[d]iessen; si ellos le vidiessen 'if they had seen him'; = viesen)
glossary.escapara: escapar — he would have escaped (3rd sg. -ra form, here with pluperfect-indicative / conditional sense, apodosis after si ... vidiessen; non escapara de muort 'he would not have escaped death'; = habría escapado)
glossary.amorteçidas: amorteçer — in a faint, swooned (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with primas; amorteçidas amas a dos 'both in a faint'; = amortecidas, desmayadas)
glossary.descavalgó: descavalgar — he dismounted (preterite 3rd sg.; luego descavalgó 'at once he got down'; = descabalgó)
glossary.arrendó: arrendar — he tied (a horse) by the rein (preterite 3rd sg.; arrendó el cavallo 'he tied up the horse', Pidal 'lo ató por la rienda'; = ató por la rienda)
glossary.ensayaron: ensayar + se — they exerted themselves, did a feat (preterite 3rd pl. with reflexive se; mal se ensayaron 'an evil feat they did', Pidal 'mala proeza hicieron', cf. ensayarse v. 2388; = se esforzaron)
glossary.valas: ir + las — he goes (…ing) them (present 3rd sg. va + enclitic object las; ir + gerund; Valas tornando 'he goes on bringing them round', Pidal 'las va haciendo volver en su acuerdo'; Valas conortando 'he goes on comforting them'; = las va)
glossary.traspuestas: traspuesto — overcome, in a swoon (past part. fem. pl. of trasponer, used as adjective; tanto son de traspuestas 'so far gone are they'; sense from context; = traspuestas)
glossary.puoden: poder — they can (present 3rd pl., Pidal's pu[o]den with the diphthong; nada dezir non puoden 'they cannot say anything'; = pueden)
glossary.partiéronsele: partir + se + le — were broken (for him) (preterite 3rd pl. + reflexive/passive se + dative le; Partiéronsele las telas 'the membranes of his heart were rent'; = se le partieron)
glossary.despertedes: despertar — wake up! (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending, used as exhortation; Despertedes, primas 'wake, cousins'; = despertéis, here despertad)
glossary.coman: comer — let them eat, lest they eat (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; non nos coman 'let them not eat us'; = coman)
glossary.recordando: recordar — waking up, coming to (gerund; Van recordando 'they are coming to'; = despertando, recobrando el sentido)
glossary.esforçadvos: esforçar + vos — take heart (imperative 2nd pl. + enclitic vos, -d- kept; Esforçadvos, primas 'take heart, cousins'; = esforzaos)
glossary.fallaren: fallar — they find (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; de que non me fallaren 'when they do not find me'; = hallaren)
glossary.morremos: morir — we shall die (future 1st pl., syncopated stem morr-; aquí morremos nos 'here we shall die'; = moriremos)
glossary.dandos: dar + nos — give us (imperative 2nd pl. dad + nos, with metathesis dadnos > dandos; dandos del agua 'give us some water'; = dadnos)
glossary.sombrero: sombrero — hat (masc.; un sombrero 'a hat'; = sombrero)
glossary.nuevo: nuevo — new (masc. sg.; nuevo era e fresco 'it was new and fresh'; = nuevo)
glossary.fresco: fresco — fresh, clean (masc. sg.; nuevo era e fresco 'new it was, and fresh'; = fresco)
glossary.valençial: Valençia + l — Valençia + the object pronoun cut to -l (le, or lo; 'it', the hat, repeating the relative que); que de Valençial sacó 'which he had brought out of Valencia' (preterite sacó, pluperfect sense; = que lo sacó de Valencia)
glossary.cogió: coger — he scooped up, gathered (preterite 3rd sg.; cogió del agua 'he took up some water'; = cogió)
glossary.lazradas: lazrar — suffering, worn out (past part. fem. pl. used as adjective; mucho son lazradas 'they are greatly worn out'; cf. lacerado; = laceradas, here agotadas)
glossary.fartó: fartar — he satisfied, gave their fill (preterite 3rd sg.; amas las fartó 'he gave them both their fill'; = las hartó)
glossary.rogó: rogar — he begged (preterite 3rd sg.; tanto las rogó 'so much he begged them'; = rogó)
glossary.assentó: assentar — he seated (preterite 3rd sg.; fata que las assentó 'until he had seated them'; = asentó, sentó)
glossary.conortando: conortar — comforting, cheering (gerund; Valas conortando 'he went comforting them'; Pidal 'las va confortando'; = confortando, consolando)
glossary.metiendo: meter — putting in, instilling (gerund; metiendo coraçón 'putting heart into them'; = infundiendo)
glossary.esfuerçan: esforçar — they take heart, revive (present 3rd pl.; fata que esfuerçan 'until they take heart'; = se esfuerzan, cobran ánimo)
glossary.cubrió: cobrir — he covered (preterite 3rd sg., -ió; a amas las cubrió 'he covered both'; = cubrió)
glossary.partió: partir — he led away, took off (preterite 3rd sg., Pidal's parti[ó]; dent las partió 'he took them away from there'; = las apartó, se las llevó)
glossary.señeros: señero — alone, unaccompanied (masc. pl.; todos tres señeros 'all three alone'; = señeros, solos)
glossary.robredos: robredo — oak wood (masc. pl.; los robredos de Corpes 'the oak woods of Corpes'; = robledos)
glossary.arribados: arribar — arrived (past part. masc. pl., with son as auxiliary of an intransitive; ellos arribados son 'they have arrived'; = arribados, llegados)
glossary.urraca: Urraca — a woman's name (la torre de don Urraca 'Doña Urraca's tower', don before a woman's name as with don Elvira; Pidal: the tower probably stood where the place now called La Torre is, seven kilometres west of San Esteban de Gormaz, near the Llano de Urraca on the Duero)
glossary.díag: Díag — Diego (Pidal's Dí[a]g Téllez, with the restored a; = Diego)
glossary.téllez: Téllez — patronymic 'son of Tello' (Díag Téllez, a vassal of Álvar Fáñez; = Téllez)
glossary.hiva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg., h- spelling; hiva reçebir 'he went to receive'; = iba)
glossary.mesurados: mesurado — courteous, restrained, well-mannered (past part. as adj., masc. pl.; siempre mesurados son 'ever courteous are they'; = mesurados)
glossary.pesóles: pesar + les — it grieved them (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic dative les; pesóles de coraçón 'it grieved them at heart'; = les pesó)
glossary.enffurçión: enfurçión — tribute in kind (food, grain and wine) paid by a tenant to his lord for his holding; here provisions given in hospitality (Pidal, note to v. 2822; a las fijas del Çid danles enffurçión 'they furnish the Çid's daughters with provision'; grant enffurçión 'a great store of provision'; = infurción)
glossary.sovieron: seer — they stayed (strong preterite 3rd pl. of seer 'to be, stay'; allí sovieron ellas 'there they stayed'; = estuvieron)
glossary.sabidas: saber — known (past part. fem. pl., passive with son; estas nuevas sabidas son 'these tidings are known'; = sabidas)
glossary.dada: dar — given (past part. fem. sg., agreeing with ondra; tal ondra me an dada 'such honour they have given me'; = dada)
glossary.par: por — by (par for por in an oath; par aquesta barba 'by this beard'; = por)
glossary.messó: messar — he plucked, tore at (preterite 3rd sg.; barba que nadi non messó 'beard that no one has plucked'; = mesó)
glossary.lograrán: lograr — to enjoy the fruit of, have joy of (future 3rd pl.; non la lograrán 'they shall not have joy of it', la the 'honour' (the outrage) of v. 2831; Pidal 'no lograrán el fruto de la deshonra', esto es, 'no lograrán deshonrarme'; = lograrán)
glossary.casaré: casar — I shall marry off (future 1st sg.; bien las casaré yo 'I shall marry them well'; = casaré)
glossary.quales: qual — those whom (relative, masc. pl.; dozientos cavalleros, quales mio Çid mandó 'two hundred knights, those my Çid ordered', Pidal 'los que'; = los que, cuales)
glossary.dixoles: dezir — he told them (strong preterite 3rd sg. dixo + enclitic les; dixoles fuertemientre 'he charged them strictly', Pidal 'les dijo encarecidamente'; = les dijo)
glossary.andidiessen: andar — they should travel (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., in indirect command; que andidiessen de dia e de noch 'that they should travel day and night'; = anduviesen)
glossary.aduxiessen: aduzir — they should bring (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., strong stem; aduxiessen a ssus fijas 'that they bring his daughters'; = trajesen; modern aducir means 'adduce')
glossary.ssus: su — his (spelling with initial double s; ssus fijas 'his daughters'; = sus)
glossary.gormaz: Gormaz — Gormaz, castle on the Duero (Pidal: its great castle is from the Arab period and was of capital importance in the tenth-century reconquest; un castiello tan fuort 'a castle so strong'; = Gormaz)
glossary.í: í — there (adverb, Latin ibi; í albergaron 'there they lodged'; = allí; survives in the 'y' of hay)
glossary.proes: pro — worthy, valiant (pl.; Pidal's pro[e]s; a guisa de muy proes 'in the manner of very worthy men'; = prohombres, de pro)
glossary.presentan: presentar — they present, offer (present 3rd pl.; presentan a Minaya grant enffurçión 'they present Minaya with great gifts of provisions'; = presentan)
glossary.gradió: gradir — he thanked (preterite 3rd sg.; mucho gelo gradió 'he thanked them much for it'; = agradeció)
glossary.coñosçedores: coñosçedor — understanding, prudent, discerning (masc. pl.; que sodes coñosçedores 'who are men of good understanding', Pidal 'entendido, prudente'; = conocedores, entendidos)
glossary.ffago: fazer — I do (present 1st sg., ff- spelling; assí lo ffago yo 'so do I'; = hago)
glossary.estó: estar — I am (present 1st sg.; aquí estó 'here I am'; = estoy)
glossary.çielos: çielo — heaven (masc. pl.; Dios de los çielos 'God of the heavens'; = cielos)
glossary.gradeçen: gradeçer — they thank (present 3rd pl.; todos gelo gradeçen 'all thank him for it'; = agradecen)
glossary.gradimos: gradir — we thank (present 1st pl.; vos lo gradimos 'we thank you for it'; = agradecemos)
glossary.viéssemos: veer — we should see (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl.; commo si viéssemos al Criador 'as if we were seeing the Creator'; = viésemos)
glossary.gradid: gradir — thank (imperative 2nd pl.; vos a él lo gradid 'you thank him for it'; = agradeced)
glossary.rencura: rencura — grievance, sorrow, complaint (fem.; toda nuestra rencura 'all our grievance'; = rencor, queja)
glossary.sabremos: saber — we shall be able, we shall know how to (future 1st pl., syncopated; sabremos contar 'we shall be able to tell'; = sabremos)
glossary.cuydado: cuydado — care, worry, anxiety (noun; cuydado non ayades 'have no worry'; = cuidado)
glossary.perdiestes: perder — you lost (preterite 2nd pl., -stes ending; Buen casamiento perdiestes 'you lost a good marriage'; = perdisteis)
glossary.podamos: poder — we may be able (present subjunctive 1st pl.; que vos podamos vengar 'that we may be able to avenge you'; = podamos)
glossary.vengar: vengar — to avenge (infinitive; vos podamos vengar 'we may avenge you'; = vengar)
glossary.escurriéndolos: escurrir + los — escorting them (gerund + enclitic los; escurriéndolos van 'they go escorting them', ir + gerund; escurrir of an escort on the road, as Pidal 'acompáñelas' at v. 2640; no modern verb of this sense; = acompañándolos)
glossary.rio: río — river; Rio d'amor, a place Pidal says is unknown today, which must have lain east of San Esteban de Gormaz (= río)
glossary.dándoles: dar + les — giving them (gerund + enclitic dative les; dándoles solaz 'giving them cheer, comfort'; = dándoles)
glossary.espidieron: espedirse — they took leave (preterite 3rd pl., with the reflexive se before it: se espidieron dellos 'they took leave of them'; = se despidieron)
glossary.alcoçeva: Alcoçeva — the Alcoceba; Pidal: today the 'barranco de Alcoceba', a ravine that drains at the very tip of the great bend the Duero makes around the castle of Gormaz (Troçieron Alcoçeva 'they crossed the Alcoceba'; = Alcoceba)
glossary.adiestro: adiestro — on the right hand, to the right (adverb, Latin ad dextrum; adiestro dexan Gormaz 'they leave Gormaz on their right'; = a diestra, a la derecha)
glossary.bado: vado — ford (Bado de Rey, spelling b for v; Pidal: today Vadorrey, depopulated, on the left bank of the Duero on the road from Berlanga to Gormaz; = vado)
glossary.berlanga: Berlanga — Berlanga, a town and castle on the left of the Duero, 13 km from Gormaz and 30 from San Esteban (Pidal; a la casa de Berlanga 'at the town of Berlanga'; = Berlanga)
glossary.métense: meter + se — they set themselves (present 3rd pl. + reflexive; métense a andar 'they set out on their way'; = se ponen a andar)
glossary.cena: cena — supper, the evening meal (rica cena 'a rich supper'; = cena)
glossary.adeliñechos: adeliñar — straight on, heading straight (irregular past participle masc. pl., Pidal's headword adeliñeche, a synonym of adeliñado, Pidal 'en derechura'; adeliñechos van 'they go straight on'; = derechos, en derechura)
glossary.ívalas: ir + las — he went (to embrace) them (imperfect 3rd sg. iva + enclitic las, the pronoun of the infinitive drawn up onto iva; ívalas abraçar 'he went to embrace them'; ir + bare infinitive; = las iba a abrazar)
glossary.besándolas: besar + las — kissing them (gerund + enclitic las; = besándolas)
glossary.tomé: tomar — I took, accepted (preterite 1st sg.; Yo tomé el casamiento 'I accepted the match'; = tomé)
glossary.osé: osar — I dared (preterite 1st sg.; non osé dezir al 'I dared say nothing else'; = osé)
glossary.besaron: besar — they kissed (preterite 3rd pl.; besaron las manos 'they kissed his hands'; = besaron)
glossary.entráronse: entrar + se — they went in (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic se; entráronse a la cibdad 'they went into the city'; = se entraron)
glossary.cibdad: cibdad — city (here Valencia; Latin civitatem; = ciudad)
glossary.tardar: tardar — to delay, linger (infinitive; non quiso tardar 'he did not wish to delay'; = tardar)
glossary.fablós: fablar + se — he spoke, conferred (preterite fabló + enclitic -s(e), as in tornós; fablós con los sos 'he spoke with his men'; = habló)
glossary.crié: criar — I brought up, reared (preterite 1st sg.; en buen ora te crié 'I reared you in a good hour'; = crié)
glossary.lieves: levar — carry, take (2nd sg. command, present subjunctive form with -ie- diphthong, as imperative; Lieves el mandado 'carry the message'; = lleva, lleves)
glossary.bésale: besar + le — kiss his (imperative 2nd sg. + dative le of the possessor; por mí bésale la mano 'kiss his hand for me'; = bésale)
glossary.pese: pesar — may it grieve (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; quel pese al buen rey 'that it may grieve the good king'; Pidal 'ruégale que le pese'; = pese)
glossary.casó: casar — he married (off) (preterite 3rd sg.; casó mies fijas 'he married off my daughters'; = casó)
glossary.mies: mio — my (fem. pl., Pidal's restoration mi[es]; mies fijas 'my daughters'; = mis)
glossary.di: dar — I gave (strong preterite 1st sg.; non gelas di yo 'I did not give them (to them)'; = di)
glossary.desonor: desonor — dishonour, shame (fem. here, la otra desonor, a grant desonor; des- + onor; = deshonor)
glossary.cabe: caber — there lies, there is room (present 3rd sg., 'there falls (to us)'; desondra y cabe 'if there is dishonour in this'; = cabe)
glossary.poca: poco — little, small (fem. sg. used as a noun; la poca e la grant 'the small and the great (part of the dishonour)'; = poca)
glossary.levado: levar — taken away (past part. masc. sg.; se me an levado 'they have carried off from me'; = llevado)
glossary.adúgamelos: aduzir + me + los — let him bring them to me (present subjunctive 3rd sg. used as a command, + dative me + object los; Adúgamelos a vistas 'let him bring them to me at a meeting'; = tráigamelos, que me los traiga)
glossary.juntas: junta — assembly (fem. pl.; a vistas, o a juntas o a cortes 'to a meeting, or an assembly, or a court'; Pidal (note to 2733) the judicial district assemblies, less solemn than the cortes; = juntas)
glossary.asturias: Asturias — Asturias (de las Asturias bien a San Çalvador 'of the Asturias right to Oviedo'; = Asturias)
glossary.çalvador: Salvador — San Çalvador, i.e. Oviedo, capital of Asturias, so called from its cathedral dedicated to the Saviour (Pidal; = San Salvador)
glossary.yaguo: Yaguo — Santi Yaguo, Santiago, i.e. the city of Santiago de Galicia (Pidal; = Santiago)
glossary.gallizanos: gallizano — Galician (masc. pl. adj.; comdes gallizanos 'Galician counts'; = gallegos)
glossary.omillós: omillar + se — he bowed down, saluted reverently (preterite omilló + enclitic -s(e); omillós a los santos 'he bowed to the saints'; Pidal 'saludó reverentemente'; = se humilló)
glossary.aguardan: aguardar — they attend, escort, serve (present 3rd pl.; quel aguardan cum a sseñor 'who attend him as their lord'; = aguardan, here closest sirven, acompañan)
glossary.sseñor: señor — lord (ss spelling for the s sound at the start of the word; cum a sseñor 'as to a lord'; = señor)
glossary.coñosció: conoscer — he recognized (preterite 3rd sg., ñ for n; = conoció, reconoció)
glossary.levantós: levantar + se — he rose (preterite levantó + enclitic -s(e); levantós el rey 'the king rose'; = se levantó)
glossary.besábale: besar + le — he was kissing (imperfect 3rd sg. + dative le, of a possessor; besábale los piedes 'he kissed his feet'; = le besaba)
glossary.reynos: reyno — kingdom (masc. pl.; de largos reynos 'of many kingdoms'; = reinos)
glossary.besa: besar — he kisses (present 3rd sg.; vos besa las manos 'he kisses your hands'; = besa)
glossary.casastes: casar — you married (off) (preterite 2nd pl., -stes ending, said to the king; Casastes sus fijas 'you married off his daughters'; = casasteis)
glossary.quisiestes: querer — you wished (strong preterite 2nd pl., -stes; ca lo quisiestes vos 'since you wished it'; = quisisteis)
glossary.cuntida: cuntir — befallen, come (past part. fem., with ser as auxiliary; la ondra que es cuntida a nos 'the honour that has befallen us', Pidal 'cuánta honra nos ha proporcionado ese casamiento'; = acontecida)
glossary.infantes: infante — Infante, young nobleman of a great house (pl.; infantes de Carrión, spelled with n here beside the usual ifantes; = infantes)
glossary.desenparadas: desenparar — abandoned (past part. fem. pl.; desenparadas las dexaron 'they left them abandoned'; = desamparadas)
glossary.afélas: afé + las — behold them, there they are (afé, a presentative 'behold', + enclitic las; Afélas sus fijas en Valençia 'here are his daughters in Valencia'; no modern verb, = helas aquí)
glossary.desondrado: desondrar — dishonoured (past part. masc. sg.; tienes por desondrado 'he holds himself dishonoured'; = deshonrado)
glossary.calló: callar — he fell silent (preterite 3rd sg.; calló e comidió 'he fell silent and pondered'; = calló)
glossary.dizes: dezir — you say (present 2nd sg.; verdad dizes 'you speak the truth'; = dices)
glossary.casé: casar — I married (off) (preterite 1st sg.; yo casé sus fijas 'I married off his daughters'; = casé)
glossary.fizlo: fazer + lo — I did it (strong preterite 1st sg. fiz + enclitic lo; fizlo por bien 'I did it for the best'; = lo hice)
glossary.ffosse: seer — it might be (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; ff- an initial spelling of f, the o Pidal's: ff[o]sse; que ffosse a su pro 'that it might be to his advantage'; = fuese)
glossary.pésanos: pesar + nos — it grieves us (present 3rd sg. + enclitic dative nos; Entre yo e mio Çid pésanos 'it grieves us both, me and my Cid'; = nos pesa)
glossary.lê: le + he — him + I shall (Pidal's circumflex marks the two words run together, as lâ, lês, mê; ayudar lê = ayudar le he, the split future, 'I shall help him'; Ayudar lê a derecho 'I shall help him to his right'; = le ayudaré)
glossary.sín: sí + me (?) — so … me (the optative sí, as in sí el Criador vos salve, with an enclitic pronoun, most likely me written n; sín salve el Criador 'so may the Creator save me'; Pidal gives no note and the reading is uncertain; = así me salve el Creador)
glossary.cuydava: cuydar — I thought, intended (imperfect 1st sg.; Lo que non cuydava fer 'what I had no thought of doing', the king speaking; = cuidaba, pensaba)
glossary.andarán: andar — they will go about, travel (future 3rd pl.; andarán mios porteros 'my officers will go about'; = andarán)
glossary.porteros: portero — the king's officer (masc. pl.; Pidal, note to 2963: the one charged with summoning the proclaimed court, cf. v. 1380; not a door-keeper here; andarán mios porteros 'my officers will go about'; = porteros, oficiales del rey)
glossary.toledo: Toledo — Toledo, where the king will hold the court he proclaims (pora dentro en Toledo 'for within Toledo'; = Toledo)
glossary.pregonarán: pregonar — they will proclaim, announce publicly (future 3rd pl.; pregonarán mie cort 'they will cry my court'; Pidal: corte pregonada is a solemn court; = pregonarán)
glossary.podiéndolo: poder + lo — being able (to prevent) it (gerund + enclitic lo; podiéndolo veda[r] yo 'I being able to prevent it', i.e. as far as I can; = pudiéndolo)
